2025-10.title: LightMem: Lightweight and Efficient Memory-Augmented Generation
2025-10.summary: LightMem, a memory system inspired by human memory, enhances LLMs by efficiently managing historical interaction information, improving accuracy and reducing computational costs.

2025-10.summary: DeepAgent, an end-to-end deep reasoning agent, autonomously performs thinking, tool discovery, and action execution using memory folding and reinforcement learning, outperforming baselines in various tool-use and application tasks.

2025-08.title: Beyond Fixed: Variable-Length Denoising for Diffusion Large Language Models

2025-07.title: Test-Time Scaling with Reflective Generative Model

2025-07.title: nablaNABLA: Neighborhood Adaptive Block-Level Attention
2025-07.summary: NABLA, a Neighborhood Adaptive Block-Level Attention mechanism, enhances video diffusion transformers by reducing computational overhead without significantly impacting generative quality or visual fidelity.

2025-03.title: Video-R1: Reinforcing Video Reasoning in MLLMs

2025-03.title: AdaptiVocab: Enhancing LLM Efficiency in Focused Domains through Lightweight Vocabulary Adaptation

2025-03.title: UI-R1: Enhancing Action Prediction of GUI Agents by Reinforcement Learning

2025-01.title: FilmAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for End-to-End Film Automation in Virtual 3D Spaces
2025-01.summary: FilmAgent, a multi-agent collaborative framework based on LLMs, automates film production processes including scriptwriting, cinematography, and actor positioning, outperforming other models in human evaluations.

2025-01.title: Inference-Time Scaling for Diffusion Models beyond Scaling Denoising Steps
2025-01.summary: Inference-time scaling of diffusion models improves sample quality beyond increasing denoising steps through better noise selection and verification.

2025-01.title: VideoRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Video Corpus
2025-01.summary: VideoRAG dynamically retrieves relevant videos based on queries and utilizes both visual and textual information for output generation, outperforming existing methods in response accuracy.

2025-01.title: Qwen2.5-1M Technical Report
2025-01.summary: The Qwen2.5-1M series models extend context length to 1 million tokens with enhanced long-context capabilities, employing techniques like long data synthesis and progressive pre-training, and are supported by an open-source inference framework with sparse attention and kernel optimizations.

2025-01.title: SRMT: Shared Memory for Multi-agent Lifelong Pathfinding
2025-01.summary: Shared Recurrent Memory Transformer (SRMT) enhances cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning through implicit information exchange, outperforming baselines in navigation tasks and generalizing to unseen scenarios.

2025-01.title: Demons in the Detail: On Implementing Load Balancing Loss for Training Specialized Mixture-of-Expert Models
2025-01.summary: Calculating Load-Balancing Loss using a global-batch instead of a micro-batch improves performance and domain specialization in MoE-based large language models.

2025-01.title: LlamaV-o1: Rethinking Step-by-step Visual Reasoning in LLMs
2025-01.summary: A framework for evaluating and improving step-by-step visual reasoning in large language models using a specialized benchmark and a novel multimodal model trained with curriculum learning.

2025-01.title: UI-TARS: Pioneering Automated GUI Interaction with Native Agents
2025-01.summary: UI-TARS, a native GUI agent model using screenshots as input, outperforms commercial models in various benchmarks through enhanced perception, unified action modeling, system-2 reasoning, and iterative training with reflective online traces.

2025-01.title: Enhancing Human-Like Responses in Large Language Models
2025-01.summary: Advancements in enhancing natural language understanding, conversational coherence, and emotional intelligence in large language models improve user interactions and expand AI applications, while future research will address ethical implications and biases.

2025-01.title: Thoughts Are All Over the Place: On the Underthinking of o1-Like LLMs
2025-01.summary: A new decoding strategy addresses underthinking in large language models by penalizing frequent thought switching, improving accuracy without fine-tuning.

2025-01.title: Baichuan-Omni-1.5 Technical Report
2025-01.summary: Baichuan-Omni-1.5 is an omni-modal model with end-to-end audio generation, featuring a comprehensive data pipeline, audio-tokenizer, and multi-stage training strategy for superior performance across multimodal tasks.

2025-01.title: Test-Time Preference Optimization: On-the-Fly Alignment via Iterative Textual Feedback
2025-01.summary: TPO refines LLM outputs in real-time using textual critiques, achieving preference alignment without retraining.

2025-01.summary: Many AI companies are training their large language models (LLMs) on data without the permission of the copyright owners. 2025-01.title: MangaNinja: Line Art Colorization with Precise Reference Following
2025-01.summary: MangaNinjia, a diffusion model-based approach, enhances line art colorization with patch shuffling and point-driven control for precise detail and color matching.

2025-01.title: Chain-of-Retrieval Augmented Generation
2025-01.summary: CoRAG, a multi-step retrieval and reasoning approach, enhances RAG models by dynamically refining queries and using rejection sampling to improve performance, especially in multi-hop question answering.

2025-01.title: Critique Fine-Tuning: Learning to Critique is More Effective than Learning to Imitate
2025-01.summary: Critique Fine-Tuning (CFT) improves language model performance by training them to critique noisy responses, showing better reasoning ability than standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).

2025-01.title: OmniManip: Towards General Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric Interaction Primitives as Spatial Constraints
2025-01.summary: A novel object-centric representation bridges the gap between Vision-Language Models' high-level reasoning and the low-level precision needed for robotic manipulation tasks, enabling zero-shot generalization across diverse tasks.

2025-01.title: Transformer^2: Self-adaptive LLMs
2025-01.summary: A self-adaptive framework for large language models uses reinforcement learning to dynamically adjust task-specific components during inference, enhancing adaptability and performance with efficiency.

2025-01.title: Enabling Scalable Oversight via Self-Evolving Critic
2025-01.summary: SCRIT, a self-evolving critique framework, enhances LLMs' critique capabilities using synthetic data and self-validation, achieving significant improvements in critique-correction and error identification benchmarks.

2025-01.title: BIOMEDICA: An Open Biomedical Image-Caption Archive, Dataset, and Vision-Language Models Derived from Scientific Literature
2025-01.summary: BIOMEDICA is a scalable framework that creates a large, publicly accessible dataset of image-text pairs from PubMed Central, enabling state-of-the-art performance across various biomedical tasks with efficient CLIP-style models.

2025-01.title: MinMo: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Seamless Voice Interaction
2025-01.summary: MinMo, a multimodal large language model, integrates speech and text processing to achieve state-of-the-art performance in voice comprehension and generation, while enabling full-duplex conversation and instruction-following capabilities.

2025-01.title: PaSa: An LLM Agent for Comprehensive Academic Paper Search
2025-01.summary: A quality Paper Search agent, PaSa, uses reinforcement learning on synthetic and real academic queries, outperforming Google and GPT-4-based systems.

2025-01.title: STAR: Spatial-Temporal Augmentation with Text-to-Video Models for Real-World Video Super-Resolution
2025-01.summary: A novel approach using text-to-video models with local information enhancement and dynamic frequency loss improves spatio-temporal quality in real-world video super-resolution.

2025-01.title: EnerVerse: Envisioning Embodied Future Space for Robotics Manipulation
2025-01.summary: EnerVerse enhances robotic manipulation by generating future space using convolutional and bidirectional attention, sparse memory, and generated multi-camera data.

2025-01.title: CodeElo: Benchmarking Competition-level Code Generation of LLMs with Human-comparable Elo Ratings
2025-01.summary: CodeElo is a standardized code generation benchmark based on CodeForces contests, providing comprehensive evaluation of LLMs' coding abilities with reliable Elo ratings.

2025-01.title: VideoAnydoor: High-fidelity Video Object Insertion with Precise Motion Control
2025-01.summary: VideoAnydoor is a zero-shot framework for object insertion in videos that preserves detail and controls motion using a text-to-video model, ID extractor, box sequence, pixel warper, and diffusion U-Net.

2025-01.title: LLaVA-Mini: Efficient Image and Video Large Multimodal Models with One Vision Token
2025-01.summary: LLaVA-Mini, a unified large multimodal model, significantly reduces computational cost and latency by compressing vision tokens to a single token before feeding them to the LLM backbone, outperforming previous models.

2025-01.title: LTX-Video: Realtime Video Latent Diffusion
2025-01.summary: LTX-Video, a transformer-based latent diffusion model, integrates Video-VAE and denoising transformer for efficient high-resolution video generation with temporal consistency.

2025-01.title: Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation
2025-01.summary: Hunyuan3D 2.0, an advanced 3D synthesis system, uses flow-based diffusion transformers for shape generation and diffusion priors for texture synthesis, outperforming existing models in geometry, condition alignment, and texture quality.

2024-12.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
2024-12.summary: Qwen2.5, an enhanced series of large language models, demonstrates superior performance across various benchmarks and use cases through extensive pre-training and advanced post-training techniques.

2024-12.title: Expanding Performance Boundaries of Open-Source Multimodal Models with Model, Data, and Test-Time Scaling
2024-12.summary: InternVL 2.5, an advanced multimodal large language model, showcases competitive performance across various benchmarks, including multimodal reasoning and understanding, and is the first open-source model to surpass 70% on the MMMU benchmark using Chain-of-Thought reasoning.

2024-12.title: Smarter, Better, Faster, Longer: A Modern Bidirectional Encoder for Fast, Memory Efficient, and Long Context Finetuning and Inference
2024-12.summary: ModernBERT, an optimized encoder-only transformer model, demonstrates superior performance and efficiency in diverse classification and retrieval tasks compared to previous models.

2024-12.title: Apollo: An Exploration of Video Understanding in Large Multimodal Models
2024-12.summary: A comprehensive study reveals effective design principles for video understanding in Large Multimodal Models, introducing Apollo, which achieves superior performance across different model sizes.

2024-12.title: PaliGemma 2: A Family of Versatile VLMs for Transfer
2024-12.summary: PaliGemma 2 integrates a SigLIP-So400m vision encoder with Gemma 2 models of varying sizes and resolutions, advancing transfer performance across diverse vision-language tasks, including OCR and captioning.

2024-12.title: Phi-4 Technical Report
2024-12.summary: A 14-billion parameter language model surpasses its teacher model in STEM-focused QA through strategic use of synthetic data, improved data quality, and enhanced training techniques.

2024-12.title: VisionZip: Longer is Better but Not Necessary in Vision Language Models
2024-12.summary: VisionZip reduces visual token redundancy and enhances efficiency in vision-language models, improving performance and inference speed across various tasks.

2024-12.title: HuatuoGPT-o1, Towards Medical Complex Reasoning with LLMs
2024-12.summary: The proposed approach enhances medical reasoning in large language models using verifiable problems, guided search, and reinforcement learning to achieve superior performance in medical problem-solving.

2024-12.title: Byte Latent Transformer: Patches Scale Better Than Tokens
2024-12.summary: A Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) matches tokenization-based LLM performance at scale with improved inference efficiency and robustness, using entropy-based byte patching.

2024-12.title: SNOOPI: Supercharged One-step Diffusion Distillation with Proper Guidance
2024-12.summary: SNOOPI framework improves one-step text-to-image diffusion models with Proper Guidance-SwiftBrush and Negative-Away Steer Attention, enhancing both training stability and negative prompt support.

2024-12.title: GenEx: Generating an Explorable World
2024-12.summary: GenEx generates 3D environments from a single image, enabling AI agents to explore and interact with a consistent, expansive space through guided generative imagination.

2024-12.title: Training Large Language Models to Reason in a Continuous Latent Space
2024-12.summary: A new reasoning paradigm, Coconut, utilizes continuous representations in latent space to enhance LLM performance on complex reasoning tasks, particularly those requiring backtracking.

2024-12.title: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
2024-12.summary: A 3D generation method using a unified SLAT representation and rectified flow transformers achieves high-quality results across different formats and conditions.

2024-12.title: Are Your LLMs Capable of Stable Reasoning?
2024-12.summary: G-Pass@k and LiveMathBench assess Large Language Models' reasoning capabilities and consistency using complex mathematical problems.

2024-12.title: InternLM-XComposer2.5-OmniLive: A Comprehensive Multimodal System for Long-term Streaming Video and Audio Interactions
2024-12.summary: A framework combining disentangled perception, reasoning, and memory mechanisms enables real-time interaction for long-term multimodal AI systems.

2024-12.title: ProcessBench: Identifying Process Errors in Mathematical Reasoning
2024-12.summary: ProcessBench evaluates models' ability to identify errors in mathematical reasoning steps, showing that existing process reward models struggle with difficult problems and underperform compared to critic models and a fine-tuned PRM.

2024-12.title: 1.58-bit FLUX
2024-12.summary: 1.58-bit quantization of the FLUX.1-dev text-to-image model achieves comparable generation quality with reduced storage and inference overhead using self-supervised methods.

2024-12.title: FastVLM: Efficient Vision Encoding for Vision Language Models
2024-12.summary: FastVLM, using FastViTHD, optimizes Vision Language Models by scaling image resolution to reduce latency and token count, improving time-to-first-token and maintaining performance.

2024-12.title: Progressive Multimodal Reasoning via Active Retrieval
2024-12.summary: AR-MCTS enhances multimodal large language models' reasoning capabilities through active retrieval, Monte Carlo Tree Search, and a process reward model, improving performance across multimodal reasoning tasks.

2024-12.title: Unraveling the Complexity of Memory in RL Agents: an Approach for Classification and Evaluation
2024-12.summary: The paper provides a framework for understanding and evaluating different types of memory in reinforcement learning agents, using cognitive science-inspired definitions and a standardized experimental methodology.

2024-12.title: Aguvis: Unified Pure Vision Agents for Autonomous GUI Interaction
2024-12.summary: Aguvis is a unified, vision-based framework for autonomous GUI agents that integrates language grounding and explicit planning, enabling cross-platform generalization and outperforming existing methods.

2024-12.title: YuLan-Mini: An Open Data-efficient Language Model
2024-12.summary: YuLan-Mini, a 2.42B parameter base model, achieves top-tier performance with efficient pre-training techniques, including a data pipeline with cleaning and scheduling, robust optimization, and annealing with targeted data selection.

2024-12.title: Florence-VL: Enhancing Vision-Language Models with Generative Vision Encoder and Depth-Breadth Fusion
2024-12.summary: Florence-VL enhances multimodal language models with improved visual features from Florence-2, achieving state-of-the-art results across various benchmarks through depth-breath fusion and a novel training recipe.

2024-12.title: NVILA: Efficient Frontier Visual Language Models
2024-12.summary: NVILA, a family of VLMs, optimizes efficiency and accuracy through a scale-then-compress approach, enhancing performance across various benchmarks while reducing computational costs.

2024-12.title: Critical Tokens Matter: Token-Level Contrastive Estimation Enhence LLM's Reasoning Capability
2024-12.summary: The proposed cDPO approach identifies and rewards critical tokens to improve the reasoning accuracy of LLMs by utilizing contrastive estimation between positive and negative models.

2024-12.title: Explanatory Instructions: Towards Unified Vision Tasks Understanding and Zero-shot Generalization
2024-12.summary: An auto-regressive vision-language model trained with explanatory instructions achieves instruction-level zero-shot capabilities and strong zero-shot generalization in computer vision tasks.

2024-12.title: MegaPairs: Massive Data Synthesis For Universal Multimodal Retrieval
2024-12.summary: MegaPairs, a data synthesis method using vision language models and open-domain images, generates high-quality multimodal retrieval data, outperforming larger existing datasets and achieving state-of-the-art zero-shot performance.

2024-12.title: VideoGen-of-Thought: A Collaborative Framework for Multi-Shot Video Generation
2024-12.summary: VGoT generates high-quality, coherent multi-shot videos by structuring the process into script, keyframe, and shot-level generation, using IP embeddings and smoothing mechanisms for consistency and narrative flow.

2024-12.title: AniDoc: Animation Creation Made Easier
2024-12.summary: AniDoc uses video diffusion models to automate colorization and in-betweening in 2D animation, improving efficiency by leveraging correspondence matching.

2024-12.title: Euclid: Supercharging Multimodal LLMs with Synthetic High-Fidelity Visual Descriptions
2024-12.summary: A benchmark called Geoperception is introduced to evaluate MLLMs' geometric description accuracy, leading to the development of Euclid, a model optimized for low-level geometric perception using synthetic data and a data curriculum.

2024-12.title: How to Synthesize Text Data without Model Collapse?
2024-12.summary: The use of synthetic data in language model training leads to model collapse, which is mitigated by token-level editing of human-produced data to create semi-synthetic data.

2024-12.title: Next Token Prediction Towards Multimodal Intelligence: A Comprehensive Survey
2024-12.summary: A comprehensive taxonomy unifies multimodal understanding and generation through Next Token Prediction, covering aspects like tokenization, model architectures, task representation, datasets, and open challenges.

2024-12.title: Parallelized Autoregressive Visual Generation
2024-12.summary: A parallel generation strategy for autoregressive models improves inference speed without significantly compromising quality in visual generation tasks.

2024-12.title: TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks
2024-12.summary: A benchmark platform evaluates AI agents' autonomy in performing professional tasks in a simulated workplace environment, showing that a significant portion of simpler tasks can be automated but complex, long-term tasks remain challenging.

2024-12.title: EXAONE 3.5: Series of Large Language Models for Real-world Use Cases
2024-12.summary: EXAONE 3.5 language models, available in three configurations, demonstrate exceptional instruction following, long-context comprehension, and competitive performance across various benchmarks.

2024-12.title: Multimodal Latent Language Modeling with Next-Token Diffusion
2024-12.summary: LatentLM integrates continuous and discrete data using causal Transformers, VAEs, and next-token diffusion, achieving superior performance in multimodal tasks like image generation, large language model integration, and text-to-speech synthesis.

2024-12.title: DiffSensei: Bridging Multi-Modal LLMs and Diffusion Models for Customized Manga Generation
2024-12.summary: DiffSensei, a diffusion-based framework with a multimodal large language model, enhances manga generation by precisely controlling multi-character appearances and interactions using masked cross-attention and text cues.

2024-12.title: Evaluating Language Models as Synthetic Data Generators
2024-12.summary: AgoraBench evaluates language models' data generation abilities, revealing their distinct strengths and demonstrating various factors that impact effectiveness.

2024-12.title: Evaluating and Aligning CodeLLMs on Human Preference
2024-12.summary: A human-curated benchmark (CodeArena) and a large synthetic instruction corpus (SynCode-Instruct) are introduced to evaluate code LLMs based on human preference alignment, revealing performance differences between open-source and proprietary models.

2024-12.title: LiFT: Leveraging Human Feedback for Text-to-Video Model Alignment
2024-12.summary: LiFT fine-tunes text-to-video generative models using human feedback to improve video alignment with text descriptions, demonstrating superior performance over a larger model.

2024-12.title: MAmmoTH-VL: Eliciting Multimodal Reasoning with Instruction Tuning at Scale
2024-12.summary: A large-scale multimodal instruction-tuning dataset with intermediate rationales improves reasoning capabilities in large language models, achieving state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks.

2024-12.title: MALT: Improving Reasoning with Multi-Agent LLM Training
2024-12.summary: Multi-agent LLM training improves performance on reasoning tasks by assigning specialized roles and utilizing joint outcome-based rewards to enhance collaboration among models.

2024-12.title: FLOAT: Generative Motion Latent Flow Matching for Audio-driven Talking Portrait
2024-12.summary: FLOAT method generates high-quality, temporally consistent, and emotion-enhanced talking portraits using flow matching in a learned motion latent space with a transformer-based vector field predictor.

2024-12.title: Token-Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning
2024-12.summary: A token-budget-aware framework dynamically estimates and allocates token budgets for LLM reasoning, reducing costs with minimal performance loss.

2024-12.title: B-STaR: Monitoring and Balancing Exploration and Exploitation in Self-Taught Reasoners
2024-12.summary: B-STaR framework autonomously adjusts configurations to enhance exploration and exploitation, improving performance in self-improving models.

2024-12.title: LAION-SG: An Enhanced Large-Scale Dataset for Training Complex Image-Text Models with Structural Annotations
2024-12.summary: A new dataset with structural scene graph annotations improves text-to-image generation performance on complex scenes, benchmarked by CompSG-Bench.

2024-12.title: o1-Coder: an o1 Replication for Coding
2024-12.summary: O1-CODER integrates reinforcement learning and Monte Carlo Tree Search to enhance coding capabilities, focusing on pseudocode and full code generation through iterative fine-tuning and standardized code testing.

2024-12.title: Lyra: An Efficient and Speech-Centric Framework for Omni-Cognition
2024-12.summary: As Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) evolve, expanding beyond single-domain capabilities is essential to meet the demands for more versatile and efficient AI. However, previous omni-models have insufficiently explored speech, neglecting its integration with multi-modality. We introduce Lyra, an efficient MLLM t…

2024-12.title: GRAPE: Generalizing Robot Policy via Preference Alignment
2024-12.summary: GRAPE improves vision-language-action models' performance by aligning policies via preference modeling, enhancing generalizability and allowing customization of objectives like safety and efficiency.

2024-12.title: On the Compositional Generalization of Multimodal LLMs for Medical Imaging
2024-12.summary: Compositional generalization aids multimodal large language models in understanding and generalizing to unseen medical images across various domains and tasks.

2024-11.title: LLaVA-CoT: Let Vision Language Models Reason Step-by-Step
2024-11.summary: LLaVA-CoT is a vision-language model that achieves improved reasoning performance through structured multistage processing and test-time scaling, outperforming larger models with a smaller training dataset.

2024-11.title: OpenCoder: The Open Cookbook for Top-Tier Code Large Language Models
2024-11.summary: OpenCoder is a top-tier open-access code LLM that provides comprehensive reproducible resources, including data, pipelines, and protocols, to advance code AI research.

2024-11.title: ShowUI: One Vision-Language-Action Model for GUI Visual Agent
2024-11.summary: ShowUI is a vision-language-action model that enhances GUI assistants by using UI-guided token selection and interleaved vision-language-action streaming, achieving high accuracy and efficiency in zero-shot screenshot grounding across different environments.

2024-11.title: ROICtrl: Boosting Instance Control for Visual Generation
2024-11.summary: ROICtrl, an adapter for diffusion models using ROI-Align and ROI-Unpool, improves regional instance control in text-based visual generation with lower computational costs.

2024-11.title: Enhancing the Reasoning Ability of Multimodal Large Language Models via Mixed Preference Optimization
2024-11.summary: A preference optimization process enhances multimodal reasoning, particularly Chain-of-Thought performance, in large language models through automated data construction and mixed preference optimization, demonstrating significant improvements on benchmarks.

2024-11.title: Unpacking SDXL Turbo: Interpreting Text-to-Image Models with Sparse Autoencoders
2024-11.summary: Sparse autoencoders are applied to learn interpretable features from intermediate updates in text-to-image diffusion models, such as SDXL Turbo, enhancing understanding of these models' internal mechanisms.

2024-11.title: MagicQuill: An Intelligent Interactive Image Editing System
2024-11.summary: MagicQuill integrates an interface with a multimodal large language model and diffusion prior to enable efficient and precise real-time image editing through minimal user input.

2024-11.title: LLaMA-Mesh: Unifying 3D Mesh Generation with Language Models
2024-11.summary: The work demonstrates the capability of LLMs to generate 3D meshes from text by introducing a novel approach to tokenize 3D mesh data, allowing the unification of 3D and text modalities without expanding the model's vocabulary.

2024-11.title: Generative World Explorer
2024-11.summary: Generative World Explorer (Genex) enables agents to mentally explore 3D environments using imagined observations, updating their beliefs without physical exploration to improve decision-making.

2024-11.title: HtmlRAG: HTML is Better Than Plain Text for Modeling Retrieved Knowledge in RAG Systems
2024-11.summary: HtmlRAG enhances Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems by using HTML instead of plain text, improving knowledge modeling and reducing information loss through HTML cleaning, compression, and pruning.

2024-11.title: TÜLU 3: Pushing Frontiers in Open Language Model Post-Training
2024-11.summary: T\"ULU 3, an open-source family of post-trained language models, introduces transparent training data, recipes, and advanced techniques to match or surpass proprietary models in performance.

2024-11.title: Large Language Models Orchestrating Structured Reasoning Achieve Kaggle Grandmaster Level
2024-11.summary: Agent K v1.0 automates data science tasks across various domains using structured reasoning and Bayesian optimization, achieving performance comparable to Expert-level Kaggle users.

2024-11.title: What Happened in LLMs Layers when Trained for Fast vs. Slow Thinking: A Gradient Perspective
2024-11.summary: Investigating gradient patterns in LLMs during fast vs. slow training reveals that slow thinking (chain-of-thoughts) enhances learning stability and distinguishes correct reasoning paths.

2024-11.title: OminiControl: Minimal and Universal Control for Diffusion Transformer
2024-11.summary: OminiControl, a parameter-efficient framework, integrates image conditions into Diffusion Transformer models using a parameter reuse mechanism, excelling in subject-driven and spatially-aligned conditional generation.

2024-11.title: Marco-o1: Towards Open Reasoning Models for Open-Ended Solutions
2024-11.summary: Marco-o1 extends reasoning models to open-ended domains without clear standards using Chain-of-Thought fine-tuning, Monte Carlo Tree Search, reflection mechanisms, and innovative reasoning strategies.

2024-11.title: ReCapture: Generative Video Camera Controls for User-Provided Videos using Masked Video Fine-Tuning
2024-11.summary: ReCapture generates new videos with different camera trajectories from a user-provided video using multiview diffusion models and masked video fine-tuning.

2024-11.title: Large Language Models Can Self-Improve in Long-context Reasoning
2024-11.summary: A novel method enables LLMs to self-improve in long-context reasoning through sampling, scoring with Minimum Bayes Risk, and supervised fine-tuning, outperforming expert-annotated data approaches.

2024-11.title: BitNet a4.8: 4-bit Activations for 1-bit LLMs
2024-11.summary: BitNet a4.8 enhances the efficiency of large language models through 4-bit quantization and sparsification, achieving equivalent performance to BitNet b1.58 with reduced inference costs.

2024-11.title: CAT4D: Create Anything in 4D with Multi-View Video Diffusion Models
2024-11.summary: CAT4D is a method that uses a multi-view video diffusion model to generate 4D dynamic scenes from monocular video by optimizing a deformable 3D Gaussian representation.

2024-11.title: RedPajama: an Open Dataset for Training Large Language Models
2024-11.summary: The RedPajama datasets are introduced to address core challenges for open-source language models by providing transparent data curation, large volumes of high-quality text, and quality signals for web data analysis.

2024-11.title: SageAttention2 Technical Report: Accurate 4 Bit Attention for Plug-and-play Inference Acceleration
2024-11.summary: SageAttention2 improves attention computation speed with 4-bit matrix multiplication and adaptive quantization, achieving significant OPS increases without compromising accuracy.

2024-11.title: "Give Me BF16 or Give Me Death"? Accuracy-Performance Trade-Offs in LLM Quantization
2024-11.summary: A comprehensive study evaluates quantization formats for LLMs, showing that FP8 W8A8-FP is lossless, W8A8-INT incurs minimal accuracy loss, and W4A16-INT is cost-efficient, providing guidelines for optimal deployment.

2024-11.title: Star Attention: Efficient LLM Inference over Long Sequences
2024-11.summary: Star Attention improves inference efficiency of large language models on long sequences by using block-sparse approximation, reducing memory and time without significant accuracy loss.

2024-11.title: Add-it: Training-Free Object Insertion in Images With Pretrained Diffusion Models
2024-11.summary: Add-it extends diffusion models with a weighted extended-attention mechanism to seamlessly integrate objects into images based on text instructions, achieving state-of-the-art results on real and generated image insertion benchmarks.

2024-11.title: Cut Your Losses in Large-Vocabulary Language Models
2024-11.summary: Cut Cross-Entropy reduces the memory footprint of large language models during training by efficiently computing cross-entropy loss without materializing logits for all tokens.

2024-11.title: AndroidLab: Training and Systematic Benchmarking of Android Autonomous Agents
2024-11.summary: AndroidLab provides a systematic framework for training and evaluating Android agents, supporting both large language models and multimodal models, and improves their task success rates.

2024-11.title: OS-ATLAS: A Foundation Action Model for Generalist GUI Agents
2024-11.summary: OS-Atlas improves GUI agent performance through a large open-source GUI grounding dataset and model innovations.

2024-11.title: Material Anything: Generating Materials for Any 3D Object via Diffusion
2024-11.summary: Material Anything is a unified diffusion framework that generates physically-based materials for 3D objects using a pre-trained image diffusion model with enhancements for stability and quality.

2024-11.title: Hymba: A Hybrid-head Architecture for Small Language Models
2024-11.summary: Hymba, a family of small language models with a hybrid-head architecture combining transformer attention and state space models, achieves state-of-the-art performance with improved efficiency and reduced cache size.

2024-11.title: OmniEdit: Building Image Editing Generalist Models Through Specialist Supervision
2024-11.summary: An omnipotent image editor trained on multisource supervision, importance sampling, and a versatile architecture excels in multiple tasks with diverse aspect ratios and high data quality.

2024-11.title: DimensionX: Create Any 3D and 4D Scenes from a Single Image with Controllable Video Diffusion
2024-11.summary: DimensionX leverages video diffusion with spatial-temporal decoupling and trajectory-aware mechanisms to generate high-quality 3D and 4D scenes from single images.

2024-11.title: Mixture-of-Transformers: A Sparse and Scalable Architecture for Multi-Modal Foundation Models
2024-11.summary: Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) reduces pretraining computational costs for multi-modal large language models by decoupling non-embedding parameters by modality, enabling efficient processing and competitive performance across text, image, and speech.

2024-11.title: Both Text and Images Leaked! A Systematic Analysis of Multimodal LLM Data Contamination
2024-11.summary: A framework called MM-Detect is introduced to detect data contamination in multimodal large language models, demonstrating sensitivity across different contamination levels and identifying potential contamination stages during pre-training and fine-tuning.

2024-11.title: Multimodal Autoregressive Pre-training of Large Vision Encoders
2024-11.summary: AIMV2, a multimodal vision encoder paired with an autoregressive decoder, achieves superior performance in vision benchmarks and multimodal image understanding tasks compared to contrastive models.

2024-11.title: BlueLM-V-3B: Algorithm and System Co-Design for Multimodal Large Language Models on Mobile Devices
2024-11.summary: BlueLM-V-3B optimizes the deployment of multimodal large language models on mobile platforms through redesigned dynamic resolution and hardware-aware system optimizations, achieving high performance with a small model size and fast generation speed.

2024-11.title: O1 Replication Journey -- Part 2: Surpassing O1-preview through Simple Distillation, Big Progress or Bitter Lesson?
2024-11.summary: Knowledge distillation from O1 model combined with fine-tuning achieves superior performance on complex mathematical reasoning and generalizes to open-ended QA tasks, promoting transparency in AI research.

2024-11.title: GMAI-VL & GMAI-VL-5.5M: A Large Vision-Language Model and A Comprehensive Multimodal Dataset Towards General Medical AI
2024-11.summary: GMAI-VL, a vision-language model trained on the GMAI-VL-5.5M dataset, achieves top performance in multimodal medical tasks by integrating visual and textual information.

2024-11.title: Large-Scale Text-to-Image Model with Inpainting is a Zero-Shot Subject-Driven Image Generator
2024-11.summary: Diptych Prompting is a zero-shot text-to-image generation method that enhances subject alignment and attention between panels during inpainting, resulting in visually preferable images across various applications.

2024-11.title: Style-Friendly SNR Sampler for Style-Driven Generation
2024-11.summary: The Style-friendly SNR sampler modifies the noise level distribution during fine-tuning to improve style alignment in diffusion models, enabling better capture of unique artistic styles.

2024-11.title: Stronger Models are NOT Stronger Teachers for Instruction Tuning
2024-11.summary: The Larger Models' Paradox reveals that larger models are not always better teachers for fine-tuning smaller models, and a new metric, Compatibility-Adjusted Reward (CAR), is introduced to measure and improve the effectiveness of response generators.

2024-11.title: DynaSaur: Large Language Agents Beyond Predefined Actions
2024-11.summary: A new LLM agent framework enables dynamic action creation and reuse by generating and executing programs, offering greater flexibility and improved performance in complex, real-world scenarios.

2024-11.title: Identity-Preserving Text-to-Video Generation by Frequency Decomposition
2024-11.summary: ConsisID is a tuning-free, DiT-based IPT2V model that uses frequency-aware identity control to generate high-quality, identity-preserving videos by decomposing facial features into low and high-frequency elements.

2024-11.title: From Generation to Judgment: Opportunities and Challenges of LLM-as-a-judge
2024-11.summary: A survey of LLM-based judgment and assessment explores definitions, taxonomy, benchmarks, challenges, and future directions for the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm.

2024-11.title: M-Longdoc: A Benchmark For Multimodal Super-Long Document Understanding And A Retrieval-Aware Tuning Framework
2024-11.summary: A benchmark and framework named M-LongDoc evaluates and improves large multimodal models for document reading, focusing on open-ended solutions and retrieval tasks over lengthy documents.

2024-11.title: LLM2CLIP: Powerful Language Model Unlock Richer Visual Representation
2024-11.summary: LLM2CLIP leverages large language models to enhance CLIP's multimodal representation learning, enabling better handling of complex image captions by fine-tuning the LLM and using contrastive learning.

2024-11.title: Pathways on the Image Manifold: Image Editing via Video Generation
2024-11.summary: Image editing is improved using pretrained video models to ensure accurate edits and preserve image fidelity by reformulating the process as a smooth temporal transition.

2024-11.title: OpenScholar: Synthesizing Scientific Literature with Retrieval-augmented LMs
2024-11.summary: OpenScholar, a specialized language model, enhances scientific query synthesis by retrieving relevant passages and providing citation-backed answers, outperforming existing models in correctness and citation accuracy.

2024-11.title: Language Models are Hidden Reasoners: Unlocking Latent Reasoning Capabilities via Self-Rewarding
2024-11.summary: LaTent Reasoning Optimization (LaTRO) enhances LLMs' reasoning capabilities through variational optimization of latent distributions, improving zero-shot accuracy on complex reasoning tasks.

2024-11.title: Critic-V: VLM Critics Help Catch VLM Errors in Multimodal Reasoning
2024-11.summary: The Critic-V framework leverages an Actor-Critic paradigm to enhance multimodal reasoning in vision-language models by decoupling reasoning and critique processes, significantly improving performance and reliability.

2024-11.title: Chinese SimpleQA: A Chinese Factuality Evaluation for Large Language Models
2024-11.summary: Chinese SimpleQA is a comprehensive benchmark focusing on evaluating the factuality of LLMs for Chinese short questions through diverse and high-quality data.

2024-10.title: CLEAR: Character Unlearning in Textual and Visual Modalities
2024-10.summary: CLEAR benchmark evaluates multimodal unlearning methods across textual and visual data, highlighting challenges and demonstrating the effectiveness of $\ell_1$ regularization on LoRA weights in mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

2024-10.title: Differential Transformer
2024-10.summary: Diff Transformer improves large language models by selectively focusing attention on relevant context and reducing noise, leading to better performance in scaling, long-context modeling, key information retrieval, and in-context learning.

2024-10.title: Addition is All You Need for Energy-efficient Language Models
2024-10.summary: A new integer addition-based algorithm reduces energy consumption in floating point tensor multiplications with comparable precision across various tasks.

2024-10.title: Aria: An Open Multimodal Native Mixture-of-Experts Model
2024-10.summary: Aria is an open multimodal native AI model with best-in-class performance across various tasks, designed with a mixture-of-experts architecture and pre-trained through a four-stage pipeline.

2024-10.title: Movie Gen: A Cast of Media Foundation Models
2024-10.summary: Movie Gen, a suite of foundation models, generates high-quality videos with synchronized audio, excelling in various tasks through architectural, training, and technical innovations.

2024-10.title: Breaking the Memory Barrier: Near Infinite Batch Size Scaling for Contrastive Loss
2024-10.summary: A tile-based computation strategy optimizes contrastive loss by partitioning calculations, enabling large batch sizes without significant memory or speed sacrifices.

2024-10.title: GPT-4o System Card
2024-10.summary: GPT-4o is an omnimodal autoregressive model trained to handle text, audio, image, and video inputs, offering high-performance outputs across these modalities, with particular strengths in vision and audio.

2024-10.title: GLEE: A Unified Framework and Benchmark for Language-based Economic Environments
2024-10.summary: A benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models in strategic, language-based games provides insights into their rationality, mimicry of human behavior, and impact of economic characteristics on performance and outcome.

2024-10.title: FrugalNeRF: Fast Convergence for Few-shot Novel View Synthesis without Learned Priors
2024-10.summary: FrugalNeRF addresses few-shot NeRF challenges by using weight-sharing voxels and a cross-scale adaptation scheme, improving quality and reducing training time.

2024-10.title: Baichuan-Omni Technical Report
2024-10.summary: Baichuan-Omni, a 7B open-source Multimodal Large Language Model, excels in processing image, video, audio, and text, showcasing competitive performance across multimodal benchmarks.

2024-10.title: MixEval-X: Any-to-Any Evaluations from Real-World Data Mixtures
2024-10.summary: MixEval-X is a benchmark designed to optimize and standardize multi-modal evaluations, addressing issues of inconsistency and bias in real-world applications.

2024-10.title: Pixtral 12B
2024-10.summary: Pixtral-12B, a 12-billion-parameter multimodal language model, excels in both natural language and image understanding, surpassing larger models and introducing an open-source benchmark for evaluation.

2024-10.title: Personalized Visual Instruction Tuning
2024-10.summary: A new framework called Personalized Visual Instruction Tuning (PVIT) enhances multimodal large language models to recognize and engage with specific individuals in images, utilizing a curated dataset and benchmarks for evaluation.

2024-10.title: SAM2Long: Enhancing SAM 2 for Long Video Segmentation with a Training-Free Memory Tree
2024-10.summary: SAM2Long enhances SAM 2's video segmentation by using a memory module and constrained tree search to improve accuracy in complex, long-term videos.

2024-10.title: CompassJudger-1: All-in-one Judge Model Helps Model Evaluation and Evolution
2024-10.summary: CompassJudger-1 is an open-source, all-in-one judge LLM that evaluates LLMs through unitary scoring, model comparisons, critiques, and various tasks, supported by the JudgerBench benchmark.

2024-10.title: UCFE: A User-Centric Financial Expertise Benchmark for Large Language Models
2024-10.summary: A user-centric framework evaluates LLMs in financial tasks through human feedback and task-specific interactions, achieving high correlation with human preferences.

2024-10.title: AutoTrain: No-code training for state-of-the-art models
2024-10.summary: AutoTrain, an open-source tool, streamlines training and fine-tuning of various machine learning models across multiple tasks and modalities using best practices.

2024-10.title: PUMA: Empowering Unified MLLM with Multi-granular Visual Generation
2024-10.summary: PUMA, a unified multimodal large language model, addresses varying granularity demands in visual content generation tasks through the integration of multi-granular visual features.

2024-10.title: Animate-X: Universal Character Image Animation with Enhanced Motion Representation
2024-10.summary: Animate-X, based on latent diffusion models, generates high-quality videos for various character types by enhancing motion representation through the Pose Indicator and a new benchmark, demonstrating superior performance.

2024-10.title: LOKI: A Comprehensive Synthetic Data Detection Benchmark using Large Multimodal Models
2024-10.summary: LOKI is a benchmark for evaluating the synthetic data detection capabilities of large multimodal models across various modalities.

2024-10.title: Law of the Weakest Link: Cross Capabilities of Large Language Models
2024-10.summary: LLMs show suboptimal performance in cross-capability tasks, constrained by their weakest individual capabilities, as demonstrated by the CrossEval benchmark.

2024-10.title: LLaMA-Berry: Pairwise Optimization for O1-like Olympiad-Level Mathematical Reasoning
2024-10.summary: LLaMA-Berry enhances LLMs for mathematical reasoning by combining Monte Carlo Tree Search with Self-Refine and leveraging a Pairwise Preference Reward Model to optimize search efficiency and problem-solving capability.

2024-10.title: Revisit Large-Scale Image-Caption Data in Pre-training Multimodal Foundation Models
2024-10.summary: A study examines the use of synthetic and AltText captions in multimodal models, finding that a hybrid approach using both types improves alignment and performance across various models.

2024-10.title: MM1.5: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Multimodal LLM Fine-tuning
2024-10.summary: MM1.5 enhances multimodal language models with a data-centric approach, supporting diverse tasks like text-rich image understanding and video comprehension through careful data curation and training strategies.

2024-10.title: Meissonic: Revitalizing Masked Generative Transformers for Efficient High-Resolution Text-to-Image Synthesis
2024-10.summary: Meissonic, a non-autoregressive masked image model, achieves high-quality image generation by incorporating advanced techniques and outperforms existing models like SDXL.

2024-10.title: Baichuan Alignment Technical Report
2024-10.summary: Baichuan Alignment provides comprehensive insights into alignment methodologies used in Baichuan models, detailing improvements through Prompt Augmentation System, Supervised Fine-Tuning, and Preference Alignment across various benchmarks.

2024-10.title: MMIE: Massive Multimodal Interleaved Comprehension Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models
2024-10.summary: MMIE is a large-scale benchmark for evaluating interleaved multimodal comprehension and generation in Large Vision-Language Models using diverse data and reliable automated evaluation metrics.

2024-10.title: CORAL: Benchmarking Multi-turn Conversational Retrieval-Augmentation Generation
2024-10.summary: CORAL is a large-scale benchmark for evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in multi-turn conversational settings, addressing challenges like open-domain coverage, knowledge intensity, free-form responses, and topic shifts.

2024-10.title: ROCKET-1: Master Open-World Interaction with Visual-Temporal Context Prompting
2024-10.summary: Visual-temporal context prompting integrates object segmentation and visual observations to enhance VLMs in embodied decision-making, enabling complex spatial tasks.

2024-10.title: VidEgoThink: Assessing Egocentric Video Understanding Capabilities for Embodied AI
2024-10.summary: VidEgoThink, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating egocentric video understanding capabilities, highlights the need for advancements in Multi-modal Large Language Models for effective application in Embodied AI.

2024-10.title: Your Mixture-of-Experts LLM Is Secretly an Embedding Model For Free
2024-10.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs can serve as effective embedding models without finetuning, with their routing weights and hidden states complementing each other to enhance performance.

2024-10.title: WALL-E: World Alignment by Rule Learning Improves World Model-based LLM Agents
2024-10.summary: A neurosymbolic approach aligns large language models with their environment through rule learning, improving model-based agent performance in open-world tasks.

2024-10.title: MathCoder2: Better Math Reasoning from Continued Pretraining on Model-translated Mathematical Code
2024-10.summary: A novel method for generating mathematical code with reasoning steps enhances mathematical reasoning abilities in large language models using a comprehensive dataset named MathCode-Pile.

2024-10.title: F5-TTS: A Fairytaler that Fakes Fluent and Faithful Speech with Flow Matching
2024-10.summary: F5-TTS, a fully non-autoregressive text-to-speech system, improves E2 TTS by leveraging ConvNeXt and Sway Sampling for better performance and efficiency.

2024-10.title: Can Knowledge Editing Really Correct Hallucinations?
2024-10.summary: HalluEditBench benchmarks knowledge editing methods in correcting hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) using a comprehensive dataset and evaluation framework.

2024-10.title: Toward General Instruction-Following Alignment for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2024-10.summary: VIF-RAG-QA and FollowRAG Benchmark enhance Instruction-Following alignment in RAG systems through automated instruction synthesis, verification, and evaluation.

2024-10.title: A Survey of Small Language Models
2024-10.summary: A survey of small language models covers their architectures, training methods, and model compression techniques, with a taxonomy for optimization, benchmark datasets, evaluation metrics, and open challenges.

2024-10.title: JudgeBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-based Judges
2024-10.summary: JudgeBench is a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based judges using objective correctness for challenging tasks like knowledge, reasoning, math, and coding.

2024-10.title: LLMs Know More Than They Show: On the Intrinsic Representation of LLM Hallucinations
2024-10.summary: LLMs internally encode detailed truthfulness information about their outputs, which can be used to detect and predict errors but shows variability across datasets and does not always align with the final output.

2024-10.title: StructRAG: Boosting Knowledge Intensive Reasoning of LLMs via Inference-time Hybrid Information Structurization
2024-10.summary: StructRAG enhances LLMs by identifying optimal structure types, reconstructing documents into these structures, and inferring answers for knowledge-intensive reasoning tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

2024-10.title: Towards World Simulator: Crafting Physical Commonsense-Based Benchmark for Video Generation
2024-10.summary: PhyGenBench and PhyGenEval assess text-to-video models' understanding of physical commonsense, revealing shortcomings that cannot be fully addressed by scaling models or prompt engineering.

2024-10.title: PyramidDrop: Accelerating Your Large Vision-Language Models via Pyramid Visual Redundancy Reduction
2024-10.summary: PyramidDrop, a novel strategy for reducing visual token redundancy in large vision-language models, enhances training and inference efficiency with minimal performance loss.

2024-10.title: Pangea: A Fully Open Multilingual Multimodal LLM for 39 Languages
2024-10.summary: Pangea, a multilingual multimodal LLM, is trained on a diverse 6M instruction dataset across 39 languages and evaluated using PangeaBench, demonstrating superior performance in multilingual and cross-cultural settings.

2024-10.title: SageAttention: Accurate 8-Bit Attention for Plug-and-play Inference Acceleration
2024-10.summary: A new quantization method for attention mechanisms, named SageAttention, enhances inference speed and accuracy without significant loss in performance across various models.

2024-10.title: Web Agents with World Models: Learning and Leveraging Environment Dynamics in Web Navigation
2024-10.summary: A World-model-augmented web agent improves decision-making by simulating action outcomes, overcoming training challenges with free-form natural language descriptions of state differences.

2024-10.title: IterComp: Iterative Composition-Aware Feedback Learning from Model Gallery for Text-to-Image Generation
2024-10.summary: IterComp, a novel framework aggregating preferences from multiple diffusion models using iterative feedback learning, significantly improves compositional text-to-image generation across various metrics.

2024-10.title: Depth Pro: Sharp Monocular Metric Depth in Less Than a Second
2024-10.summary: Depth Pro is a fast and accurate zero-shot monocular depth estimation model that generates high-resolution depth maps using a multi-scale transformer and a combined real-synthetic training protocol.

2024-10.title: LOGO -- Long cOntext aliGnment via efficient preference Optimization
2024-10.summary: LOGO, a preference optimization strategy, enhances LCM generation performance and context window size by efficiently training with limited data.

2024-10.title: SpectroMotion: Dynamic 3D Reconstruction of Specular Scenes
2024-10.summary: SpectroMotion improves upon 3D Gaussian Splatting by integrating physical-based rendering and deformation fields, incorporating a residual correction technique and deformable environment map to accurately reconstruct and synthesize dynamic specular scenes.

2024-10.title: DocLayout-YOLO: Enhancing Document Layout Analysis through Diverse Synthetic Data and Global-to-Local Adaptive Perception
2024-10.summary: DocLayout-YOLO improves document layout analysis speed and accuracy using mesh-candidate bestfit pre-training and global-to-local controllable receptive modules.

2024-09.title: Qwen2.5-Coder Technical Report
2024-09.summary: Qwen2.5-Coder series demonstrates state-of-the-art code generation, completion, reasoning, and repair capabilities using the Qwen2.5 architecture with over 5.5 trillion tokens of training data.

2024-09.title: Training Language Models to Self-Correct via Reinforcement Learning
2024-09.summary: The multi-turn online reinforcement learning approach SCoRe improves LLM self-correction using self-generated data and regularization, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

2024-09.title: Molmo and PixMo: Open Weights and Open Data for State-of-the-Art Multimodal Models
2024-09.summary: Molmo, a new family of open-weight VLMs, excels through a high-quality human-annotated image caption dataset and a diverse fine-tuning dataset, outperforming both proprietary and open models in benchmark and human evaluations.

2024-09.title: OmniGen: Unified Image Generation
2024-09.summary: OmniGen is a unified diffusion model for image generation that supports diverse tasks without additional modules, emphasizing simplicity, knowledge transfer, and reasoning capabilities.

2024-09.title: Emu3: Next-Token Prediction is All You Need
2024-09.summary: Emu3, a transformer-based multimodal model trained exclusively with next-token prediction, outperforms existing diffusion and compositional models in generation and perception tasks.

2024-09.title: Loopy: Taming Audio-Driven Portrait Avatar with Long-Term Motion Dependency
2024-09.summary: An audio-only conditioned video diffusion model, Loopy, improves natural and high-quality human video generation without auxiliary spatial signals.

2024-09.title: Guide-and-Rescale: Self-Guidance Mechanism for Effective Tuning-Free Real Image Editing
2024-09.summary: A modified diffusion sampling process using self-guidance and noise rescaling achieves high-quality image editing with preserved structure and appearance without requiring diffusion model fine-tuning.

2024-09.title: Qwen2-VL: Enhancing Vision-Language Model's Perception of the World at Any Resolution
2024-09.summary: The Qwen2-VL Series uses Naive Dynamic Resolution and Multimodal Rotary Position Embedding to enhance visual processing and achieves competitive performance on multimodal benchmarks.

2024-09.title: General OCR Theory: Towards OCR-2.0 via a Unified End-to-end Model
2024-09.summary: GOT, a unified OCR model with 580M parameters, handles various types of characters and OCR tasks and offers advanced features like region-level recognition and dynamic resolution.

2024-09.title: OLMoE: Open Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
2024-09.summary: A sparse Mixture-of-Experts language model with 7 billion parameters achieves superior performance by using only 1 billion parameters per input token and outperforms larger models in various experiments.

2024-09.title: Attention Heads of Large Language Models: A Survey
2024-09.summary: This survey explores the interpretability and underlying mechanisms of attention heads within Large Language Models to understand their reasoning processes.

2024-09.title: NVLM: Open Frontier-Class Multimodal LLMs
2024-09.summary: NVML 1.0, a family of multimodal large language models, achieves state-of-the-art results in vision-language tasks by combining text-only and multimodal training, utilizing a new architecture and dataset strategy.

2024-09.title: Towards a Unified View of Preference Learning for Large Language Models: A Survey
2024-09.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit remarkably powerful capabilities. One of the crucial factors to achieve success is aligning the LLM's output with human preferences. This alignment process often requires only a small amount of data to efficiently enhance the LLM's performance. While effective, research in this area…

2024-09.title: Kvasir-VQA: A Text-Image Pair GI Tract Dataset
2024-09.summary: Kvasir-VQA is a dataset with question-and-answer annotations for GI diagnostics, supporting image captioning, VQA, synthetic image generation, object detection, and classification.

2024-09.title: Imagine yourself: Tuning-Free Personalized Image Generation
2024-09.summary: Imagine yourself is a tuning-free diffusion model for personalized image generation that enhances identity preservation, text alignment, and visual quality through synthetic data generation, parallel attention architecture, and multi-stage fine-tuning.

2024-09.title: PingPong: A Benchmark for Role-Playing Language Models with User Emulation and Multi-Model Evaluation
2024-09.summary: A benchmark evaluates language models' role-playing abilities using automated components to simulate and judge dialogues.

2024-09.title: DSBench: How Far Are Data Science Agents to Becoming Data Science Experts?
2024-09.summary: DSBench evaluates large language and vision-language models on realistic data science tasks, revealing significant performance gaps that indicate the need for improved autonomous agents.

2024-09.title: Programming Every Example: Lifting Pre-training Data Quality like Experts at Scale
2024-09.summary: ProX, a novel framework treating data refinement as a programming task, enhances large language model pre-training by generating fine-grained operations for each example, outperforming traditional human-crafted rule-based methods significantly across various benchmarks and domains.

2024-09.title: LLaMA-Omni: Seamless Speech Interaction with Large Language Models
2024-09.summary: LLaMA-Omni integrates a speech encoder, adaptor, LLM, and decoder for low-latency and high-quality speech interaction with LLMs, outperforming previous models in both content and style.

2024-09.title: MEDIC: Towards a Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating LLMs in Clinical Applications
2024-09.summary: MEDIC framework evaluates Large Language Models across five clinical dimensions to guide model selection in healthcare applications, identifying performance trade-offs and ensuring practical implementation.

2024-09.title: Seed-Music: A Unified Framework for High Quality and Controlled Music Generation
2024-09.summary: Seed-Music generates high-quality music with style control using a unified framework combining auto-regressive language modeling and diffusion approaches, supporting vocal music generation and post-production editing.

2024-09.title: LongLLaVA: Scaling Multi-modal LLMs to 1000 Images Efficiently via Hybrid Architecture
2024-09.summary: LongLLaVA, a hybrid MLLM combining Mamba and Transformer blocks, enhances video and image understanding with improved efficiency and throughput.

2024-09.title: MIO: A Foundation Model on Multimodal Tokens
2024-09.summary: MIO, a novel foundation model, achieves competitive performance in multimodal tasks through an end-to-end, autoregressive approach using causal multimodal modeling.

2024-09.title: Mini-Omni: Language Models Can Hear, Talk While Thinking in Streaming
2024-09.summary: Mini-Omni is an end-to-end audio-based conversational model enabling real-time speech interaction and efficient speech generation.

2024-09.title: YesBut: A High-Quality Annotated Multimodal Dataset for evaluating Satire Comprehension capability of Vision-Language Models
2024-09.summary: Current Vision-Language models struggle with satirical image detection, understanding, and completion tasks on a newly released high-quality dataset called YesBut.

2024-09.title: InfiMM-WebMath-40B: Advancing Multimodal Pre-Training for Enhanced Mathematical Reasoning
2024-09.summary: InfiMM-WebMath-40B, a large multimodal dataset, significantly improves mathematical reasoning capabilities in LLMs, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multimodal benchmarks.

2024-09.title: LongCite: Enabling LLMs to Generate Fine-grained Citations in Long-context QA
2024-09.summary: A new pipeline and dataset enable long-context LLMs to generate responses with precise sentence-level citations, improving their trustworthiness and outperforming existing models.

2024-09.title: Prithvi WxC: Foundation Model for Weather and Climate
2024-09.summary: Prithvi WxC, a 2.3 billion parameter foundation model using an encoder-decoder architecture with transformer concepts, addresses weather forecasting, downscaling, and extreme events estimation with a mixed masked reconstruction and forecasting objective.

2024-09.title: MMEvol: Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models with Evol-Instruct
2024-09.summary: MMEvol, a multimodal instruction data evolution framework, enhances the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models by generating diverse and complex image-text instruction datasets, leading to improved performance across various vision-language tasks.

2024-09.title: MaskLLM: Learnable Semi-Structured Sparsity for Large Language Models
2024-09.summary: MaskLLM introduces a learnable pruning method using Gumbel Softmax sampling to achieve N:M sparsity in LLMs, improving inference efficiency and transferability across tasks.

2024-09.title: Windows Agent Arena: Evaluating Multi-Modal OS Agents at Scale
2024-09.summary: Windows Agent Arena provides a general, reproducible environment for evaluating multi-modal agent performance on Windows OS tasks, with scalability and parallelizability features.

2024-09.title: A Controlled Study on Long Context Extension and Generalization in LLMs
2024-09.summary: A controlled evaluation protocol for long-context models reveals that exact fine-tuning methods are effective, while approximate attention methods underperform, and extrapolation remains challenging.

2024-09.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer
2024-09.summary: The Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer replaces MLP layers with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network layers to enhance transformers, overcoming challenges related to inference speed, computation efficiency, and weight initialization through rational basis, group learning, and variance-preserving techniques.

2024-09.title: FuzzCoder: Byte-level Fuzzing Test via Large Language Model
2024-09.summary: A framework uses fine-tuned large language models to guide input mutation in fuzzing, improving the detection of software vulnerabilities.

2024-09.title: RetrievalAttention: Accelerating Long-Context LLM Inference via Vector Retrieval
2024-09.summary: RetrievalAttention is a training-free method that accelerates attention computation in Transformer-based LLMs by using attention-aware vector search to reduce retrieval costs and GPU memory usage.

2024-09.title: Can LLMs Generate Novel Research Ideas? A Large-Scale Human Study with 100+ NLP Researchers
2024-09.summary: LLM-generated research ideas are perceived as more novel than those from human experts but are deemed slightly less feasible, based on blind evaluations by NLP researchers.

2024-09.title: LongRecipe: Recipe for Efficient Long Context Generalization in Large Languge Models
2024-09.summary: LongRecipe extends the context window of large language models efficiently with reduced resources and preserved performance, achieving a 16-fold increase from 8k to 128k context size.

2024-09.title: MinerU: An Open-Source Solution for Precise Document Content Extraction
2024-09.summary: MinerU is an open-source tool that enhances document content extraction using fine-tuned models and pre/postprocessing rules across diverse document types.

2024-09.title: HelloBench: Evaluating Long Text Generation Capabilities of Large Language Models
2024-09.summary: A comprehensive benchmark, HelloBench, and evaluation method, HelloEval, are introduced to assess the long text generation capabilities of Large Language Models, revealing limitations and providing human-aligned evaluations.

2024-09.title: EMOVA: Empowering Language Models to See, Hear and Speak with Vivid Emotions
2024-09.summary: EMOVA integrates speech, vision, and language capabilities, achieving top performance in benchmarks and enabling emotive spoken dialogue using a disentangled speech tokenizer and style module.

2024-09.title: To CoT or not to CoT? Chain-of-thought helps mainly on math and symbolic reasoning
2024-09.summary: Chain-of-thought prompting enhances large language model performance primarily in math or logic tasks by improving symbolic reasoning, but it is less beneficial in other domains and can be selectively applied to save inference costs.

2024-09.title: VisionTS: Visual Masked Autoencoders Are Free-Lunch Zero-Shot Time Series Forecasters
2024-09.summary: The VisionTS model, leveraging a visual masked autoencoder pre-trained on ImageNet, achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot and fine-tuned forecasting performance in time series forecasting without adapting specifically to the time-series domain.

2024-09.title: MMSearch: Benchmarking the Potential of Large Models as Multi-modal Search Engines
2024-09.summary: MMSearch-Engine enables multimodal search capabilities in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) using a comprehensive benchmark and demonstrates improved performance over commercial products.

2024-09.title: DepthCrafter: Generating Consistent Long Depth Sequences for Open-world Videos
2024-09.summary: DepthCrafter generates temporally consistent depth sequences for open-world videos using a video-to-depth model derived from a pre-trained image-to-video diffusion model.

2024-09.title: SciLitLLM: How to Adapt LLMs for Scientific Literature Understanding
2024-09.summary: A hybrid approach combining continual pre-training and supervised fine-tuning creates specialized LLMs for scientific literature, addressing challenges in constructing corpora and generating instructions.

2024-09.title: A Preliminary Study of o1 in Medicine: Are We Closer to an AI Doctor?
2024-09.summary: OpenAI's o1 demonstrates strong performance in medical tasks but shows weaknesses in reasoning, multilinguality, and evaluation metrics compared to GPT-4.

2024-09.title: LLMs + Persona-Plug = Personalized LLMs
2024-09.summary: A novel model constructs user-specific embeddings using a lightweight plug-in module to personalize LLM outputs without fine-tuning, improving performance on various tasks.

2024-09.title: jina-embeddings-v3: Multilingual Embeddings With Task LoRA
2024-09.summary: jina-embeddings-v3, a large-scale text embedding model, achieves state-of-the-art performance in multilingual and long-context retrieval tasks using Low-Rank Adaptation and Matryoshka Representation Learning.

2024-09.title: InstantDrag: Improving Interactivity in Drag-based Image Editing
2024-09.summary: InstantDrag, an optimization-free pipeline with two networks, performs fast, photo-realistic drag-based image editing without requiring masks or text prompts.

2024-09.title: LLaVA-3D: A Simple yet Effective Pathway to Empowering LMMs with 3D-awareness
2024-09.summary: LLaVA-3D enhances 2D models with 3D scene understanding by integrating 3D Patch representations and joint 2D/3D instruction tuning, achieving fast convergence and superior performance across tasks.

2024-08.title: Transformer Explainer: Interactive Learning of Text-Generative Models
2024-08.summary: Transformer Explainer is an interactive visualization tool that allows non-experts to understand the inner workings of the GPT-2 model through real-time experimentation and visualization in a web browser.

2024-08.title: Writing in the Margins: Better Inference Pattern for Long Context Retrieval
2024-08.summary: Writing in the Margins (WiM) enhances Large Language Models' performance on long input sequences and retrieval tasks by using chunked prefill and marginal information, improving accuracy and F1-score without fine-tuning.

2024-08.title: Building and better understanding vision-language models: insights and future directions
2024-08.summary: A comprehensive tutorial on building vision-language models, detailing the development of Idefics3-8B with an improved dataset enhancing document understanding.

2024-08.title: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines
2024-08.summary: GameNGen, a neural model-powered game engine, simulates high-quality gameplay in real-time using a diffusion model conditioned on past frames and actions.

2024-08.title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
2024-08.summary: The AI Scientist is a framework that enables independent scientific research through automatic idea generation, experimentation, and paper writing using large language models.

2024-08.title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
2024-08.summary: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2) uses a transformer architecture with streaming memory to achieve high performance in image and video segmentation, requiring fewer interactions and faster processing than previous models.

2024-08.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
2024-08.summary: Llama 3, a multilingual and multi-modal language model with 405B parameters, achieves competitive performance across tasks including image, video, and speech recognition when integrated through a compositional approach.

2024-08.title: xGen-MM (BLIP-3): A Family of Open Large Multimodal Models
2024-08.summary: xGen-MM, an extension of Salesforce's xGen initiative, provides a framework for developing Large Multimodal Models with pre-trained, instruction-tuned, and safety-tuned variants.

2024-08.title: MiniCPM-V: A GPT-4V Level MLLM on Your Phone
2024-08.summary: MiniCPM-V presents a series of efficient Multimodal Large Language Models optimized for end-side deployment, offering high performance and practical usability compared to larger models.

2024-08.title: Law of Vision Representation in MLLMs
2024-08.summary: Correlation between cross-modal alignment and vision representation improves performance in multimodal large language models, enabling identification and training of optimal vision representation with reduced computational cost.

2024-08.title: Sapiens: Foundation for Human Vision Models
2024-08.summary: Sapiens, a family of vision models for human-centric tasks, achieves superior performance with self-supervised pretraining and can be easily fine-tuned for 2D pose estimation, body-part segmentation, depth estimation, and surface normal prediction.

2024-08.title: Eagle: Exploring The Design Space for Multimodal LLMs with Mixture of Encoders
2024-08.summary: Mixture of vision encoders and resolutions in multimodal large language models improves performance through concatenation of visual tokens and a Pre-Alignment mechanism, leading to superior results on benchmarks.

2024-08.title: GMAI-MMBench: A Comprehensive Multimodal Evaluation Benchmark Towards General Medical AI
2024-08.summary: GMAI-MMBench is a comprehensive general medical AI benchmark that evaluates large vision-language models across multiple medical domains and perceptual granularities, identifying key insufficiencies and highlighting areas for improvement.

2024-08.title: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
2024-08.summary: Gemma 2 introduces improvements in the Transformer architecture through interleaving local-global attentions and group-query attention, showcasing superior performance relative to its size.

2024-08.title: Mutual Reasoning Makes Smaller LLMs Stronger Problem-Solvers
2024-08.summary: rStar enhances small language models' reasoning capabilities through a self-play mutual generation-discrimination process without fine-tuning, improving accuracy across various reasoning tasks.

2024-08.title: LongWriter: Unleashing 10,000+ Word Generation from Long Context LLMs
2024-08.summary: AgentWrite enables long context LLMs to generate outputs exceeding 20,000 words by decomposing tasks into subtasks, using a new dataset to train models with extended output capabilities.

2024-08.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
2024-08.summary: Research on scaling test-time computation in LLMs finds that compute-optimal strategies can enhance performance and efficiency beyond larger base models.

2024-08.title: Controllable Text Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
2024-08.summary: Controllable Text Generation techniques for Large Language Models ensure predefined control conditions and high-quality text output, covering content and attribute control through various methods like retraining, fine-tuning, and latent manipulation.

2024-08.title: Open-FinLLMs: Open Multimodal Large Language Models for Financial Applications
2024-08.summary: Open-FinLLMs, a series of financial LLMs, enhance performance through comprehensive pre-training and instruction fine-tuning, demonstrating superior results in both zero-shot and few-shot evaluations, and excels in understanding tables and charts.

2024-08.title: DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5: Harnessing Proof Assistant Feedback for Reinforcement Learning and Monte-Carlo Tree Search
2024-08.summary: DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5 improves theorem proving by optimizing training and inference, utilizing reinforcement learning, and proposing RMaxTS for diverse proof paths, achieving state-of-the-art results on miniF2F and ProofNet benchmarks.

2024-08.title: Transfusion: Predict the Next Token and Diffuse Images with One Multi-Modal Model
2024-08.summary: Transfusion combines language modeling and diffusion training to develop a multi-modal transformer model that scales effectively across text and image data, matching the performance of specialized models.

2024-08.title: SwiftBrush v2: Make Your One-step Diffusion Model Better Than Its Teacher
2024-08.summary: Enhancements to SwiftBrush through improved weight initialization, efficient LoRA training, and novel clamped CLIP loss achieve state-of-the-art image quality while maintaining generative diversity.

2024-08.title: LLM Pruning and Distillation in Practice: The Minitron Approach
2024-08.summary: Models Llama 3.1 8B and Mistral NeMo 12B are compressed using pruning and distillation, achieving state-of-the-art performance in a reduced parameter setting.

2024-08.title: Imagen 3
2024-08.summary: Imagen 3, a latent diffusion model, generates high-quality images from text prompts and outperforms state-of-the-art models while addressing safety and representation issues.

2024-08.title: LLaVA-OneVision: Easy Visual Task Transfer
2024-08.summary: LLaVA-OneVision is a unified multimodal model that advances performance across single-image, multi-image, and video scenarios with strong transfer learning capabilities.

2024-08.title: MMIU: Multimodal Multi-image Understanding for Evaluating Large Vision-Language Models
2024-08.summary: The Multimodal Multi-image Understanding (MMIU) benchmark assesses LVLMs across various multi-image tasks, highlighting challenges in spatial understanding.

2024-08.title: Hermes 3 Technical Report
2024-08.summary: Hermes 3, a neutrally-aligned instruct and tool use model with strong reasoning and creative capabilities, achieves top performance on public benchmarks.

2024-08.title: CogVLM2: Visual Language Models for Image and Video Understanding
2024-08.summary: The CogVLM2 family of visual language models, including CogVLM2, CogVLM2-Video, and GLM-4V, advances image and video understanding with enhanced architectures and training methods.

2024-08.title: TWLV-I: Analysis and Insights from Holistic Evaluation on Video Foundation Models
2024-08.summary: The study introduces TWLV-I, a novel video foundation model that outperforms existing models in video comprehension by constructing robust representations for both motion and appearance.

2024-08.title: BaichuanSEED: Sharing the Potential of ExtensivE Data Collection and Deduplication by Introducing a Competitive Large Language Model Baseline
2024-08.summary: A data processing pipeline and open-sourced details for training a large language model achieve competitive performance with commercial models.

2024-08.title: ControlNeXt: Powerful and Efficient Control for Image and Video Generation
2024-08.summary: ControlNeXt is a computationally efficient method for controllable image and video generation with a streamlined architecture and minimal parameters, using Cross Normalization for fast training convergence.

2024-08.title: TableBench: A Comprehensive and Complex Benchmark for Table Question Answering
2024-08.summary: TableLLM, trained on TableInstruct, benchmarks performance in tabular data reasoning and highlights the need for improvement in real-world applications.

2024-08.title: LongVILA: Scaling Long-Context Visual Language Models for Long Videos
2024-08.summary: LongVILA, a full-stack solution for long-context vision-language models, introduces Multi-Modal Sequence Parallelism for efficient training and inference, and a five-stage training pipeline that enhances long video processing and captioning performance.

2024-08.title: Med42-v2: A Suite of Clinical LLMs
2024-08.summary: Med42-v2 enhances Llama3 with clinical data to improve performance in healthcare settings, outperforming generic models across medical benchmarks.

2024-08.title: Medical SAM 2: Segment medical images as video via Segment Anything Model 2
2024-08.summary: MedSAM-2 extends the SAM 2 framework for 2D and 3D medical image segmentation, offering one-prompt segmentation across multiple images and outperforming existing models in various medical imaging tasks.

2024-08.title: Show-o: One Single Transformer to Unify Multimodal Understanding and Generation
