2024-08.summary: Show-o, a unified transformer model, combines autoregressive and diffusion modeling for versatile vision-language tasks, achieving competitive performance.

2024-08.title: WavTokenizer: an Efficient Acoustic Discrete Codec Tokenizer for Audio Language Modeling
2024-08.summary: WavTokenizer provides extreme audio compression and state-of-the-art quality by expanding the VQ space, contextual windows, attention networks, and using a multi-scale discriminator and inverse Fourier transform.

2024-08.title: VITA: Towards Open-Source Interactive Omni Multimodal LLM
2024-08.summary: VITA, an open-source Multimodal Large Language Model, excels in processing Video, Image, Text, and Audio with seamless interaction, showcasing advancements in multimodal understanding and human-computer interaction.

2024-08.title: To Code, or Not To Code? Exploring Impact of Code in Pre-training
2024-08.summary: The inclusion of code data during pre-training significantly improves LLMs' performance across various natural language and world knowledge tasks, beyond code generation.

2024-08.title: JPEG-LM: LLMs as Image Generators with Canonical Codec Representations
2024-08.summary: Using canonical codec representations (JPEG, AVC) as a direct modeling approach for image and video generation outperforms pixel-based and vector quantization methods, facilitating multi-modal LLMs.

2024-08.title: Foundation Models for Music: A Survey
2024-08.summary: A review of foundation models in music, including large language models and latent diffusion models, highlights their impact, architectural choices, and the need for ethical considerations in music applications.

2024-08.title: The Mamba in the Llama: Distilling and Accelerating Hybrid Models
2024-08.summary: Large-scale Transformer models can be distilled into linear RNNs using attention layer weights, achieving competitive performance with enhanced deployment efficiency.

2024-08.title: Gemma Scope: Open Sparse Autoencoders Everywhere All At Once on Gemma 2
2024-08.summary: Gemma Scope is an open suite of JumpReLU SAEs trained on various layers of Gemma 2 models to facilitate safety and interpretability research.

2024-08.title: Dolphin: Long Context as a New Modality for Energy-Efficient On-Device Language Models
2024-08.summary: Dolphin, a novel decoder-decoder architecture, enables efficient processing of long contexts in language models by distilling contextual information into memory embeddings, thereby improving energy efficiency and latency without sacrificing accuracy.

2024-08.title: Diversity Empowers Intelligence: Integrating Expertise of Software Engineering Agents
2024-08.summary: A DEI framework enhances software engineering problem-solving by leveraging a collective of LLM agents, achieving higher resolve rates compared to individual agents and closed-source solutions.

2024-08.title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
2024-08.summary: A new research area, Automated Design of Agentic Systems (ADAS), uses a meta agent to automatically create powerful agentic system designs, demonstrating superior performance and robustness across various domains.

2024-08.title: RAG Foundry: A Framework for Enhancing LLMs for Retrieval Augmented Generation
2024-08.summary: RAG Foundry is an open-source framework integrating data creation, training, inference, and evaluation to facilitate the augmentation of large language models for RAG use cases, demonstrating improved performance across diverse datasets.

2024-08.title: Language Model Can Listen While Speaking
2024-08.summary: A novel listening-while-speaking language model (LSLM) enhances real-time, full-duplex speech interaction by integrating speech generation and real-time audio input with an optimal fusion strategy.

2024-08.title: An Object is Worth 64x64 Pixels: Generating 3D Object via Image Diffusion
2024-08.summary: Object Images convert 3D models into a manageable 2D format using image generation models like Diffusion Transformers, providing realistic 3D shapes and PBR materials.

2024-08.title: CogVideoX: Text-to-Video Diffusion Models with An Expert Transformer
2024-08.summary: CogVideoX is a large-scale diffusion transformer model using a 3D Variational Autoencoder and expert transformer for generating high-quality, coherent videos from text prompts.

2024-07.title: Qwen2 Technical Report
2024-07.summary: The Qwen2 series, comprising 0.5 to 72 billion parameter models, surpasses prior open models across language understanding, generation, multilingualism, coding, math, and reasoning, with exceptional performance in benchmarks like MMLU, GPQA, HumanEval, GSM8K, BBH, MT-Bench, Arena-Hard, and LiveCodeBench.

2024-07.title: SpreadsheetLLM: Encoding Spreadsheets for Large Language Models
2024-07.summary: SpreadsheetLLM introduces SheetCompressor and Chain of Spreadsheet to enhance LLMs' performance on spreadsheet tasks through efficient encoding and understanding.

2024-07.title: Scaling Synthetic Data Creation with 1,000,000,000 Personas
2024-07.summary: Persona-driven synthetic data creation using a large language model and 1 billion diverse personas for various applications demonstrates versatility, scalability, and flexibility.

2024-07.title: InternLM-XComposer-2.5: A Versatile Large Vision Language Model Supporting Long-Contextual Input and Output
2024-07.summary: A large-vision language model with long-contextual capabilities supports various comprehension and composition tasks, achieving GPT-4V level performance using 7B parameters.

2024-07.title: OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
2024-07.summary: OpenDevin is a platform for developing AI agents that interact with the world by writing code, using command lines, and browsing the web, with support for multiple agents and evaluation benchmarks.

2024-07.title: Summary of a Haystack: A Challenge to Long-Context LLMs and RAG Systems
2024-07.summary: The SummHay task evaluates LLMs and RAG systems on summarizing long-context documents by identifying relevant insights and citing sources, revealing challenges even for systems with document relevance signals.

2024-07.title: We-Math: Does Your Large Multimodal Model Achieve Human-like Mathematical Reasoning?
2024-07.summary: WE-MATH benchmark evaluates Large Multimodal Models in visual mathematical reasoning, focusing on knowledge acquisition and generalization principles beyond end-to-end performance.

2024-07.title: Vision language models are blind
2024-07.summary: State-of-the-art large language models with vision capabilities perform poorly on simple visual tasks, indicating limitations in their visual understanding.

2024-07.title: Spectra: A Comprehensive Study of Ternary, Quantized, and FP16 Language Models
2024-07.summary: The Spectra LLM suite provides insights into the performance and characteristics of low-bitwidth models through comprehensive training and evaluation of FloatLMs, QuantLMs, and TriLMs across various benchmarks and datasets.

2024-07.title: PaliGemma: A versatile 3B VLM for transfer
2024-07.summary: PaliGemma, a versatile Vision-Language Model based on SigLIP-So400m and Gemma-2B, demonstrates strong performance across numerous open-world tasks, including specialized areas like remote sensing and segmentation.

2024-07.title: Qwen2-Audio Technical Report
2024-07.summary: Qwen2-Audio, a large-scale audio-language model, enhances instruction-following and audio analysis through natural language prompts and DPO optimization.

2024-07.title: Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
2024-07.summary: Agentless, a two-phase approach to software development automation, achieves high performance and low cost compared to complex autonomous agents on the SWE-bench Lite benchmark.

2024-07.title: Human-like Episodic Memory for Infinite Context LLMs
2024-07.summary: EM-LLM enhances LLMs by integrating human episodic memory principles, enabling efficient handling of extensive contexts through coherent event segmentation and retrieval.

2024-07.title: HuatuoGPT-Vision, Towards Injecting Medical Visual Knowledge into Multimodal LLMs at Scale
2024-07.summary: The refinement of medical image-text pairs using multimodal large language models enhances medical multimodal capabilities and data quality, leading to superior performance in benchmarks.

2024-07.title: ROS-LLM: A ROS framework for embodied AI with task feedback and structured reasoning
2024-07.summary: A framework enables non-experts to program robots using natural language prompts and contextual information from the Robot Operating System (ROS), supported by large language models and offering various behavior modes, imitation learning, and feedback mechanisms.

2024-07.title: CoD, Towards an Interpretable Medical Agent using Chain of Diagnosis
2024-07.summary: Chain-of-Diagnosis (CoD) enhances interpretability in LLM-based medical diagnostics by providing a transparent reasoning pathway and developing DiagnosisGPT, which diagnoses a wide range of diseases with high accuracy and controllable rigor.

2024-07.title: Scaling Laws with Vocabulary: Larger Models Deserve Larger Vocabularies
2024-07.summary: Investigating the impact of vocabulary size on the scaling of large language models reveals that larger vocabularies improve performance when considering compute budgets, and current models often use suboptimal vocabulary sizes.

2024-07.title: GoldFinch: High Performance RWKV/Transformer Hybrid with Linear Pre-Fill and Extreme KV-Cache Compression
2024-07.summary: A hybrid Linear Attention/Transformer model, GoldFinch, efficiently generates a compressed KV-Cache for large context lengths with linear time and space complexity, outperforming previous models.

2024-07.title: Inference Performance Optimization for Large Language Models on CPUs
2024-07.summary: The paper presents a performance optimization solution for deploying large language models on CPUs by reducing KV cache size and implementing distributed inference, open-sourced for use.

2024-07.title: Unveiling Encoder-Free Vision-Language Models
2024-07.summary: EVE is an encoder-free vision-language model that achieves competitive performance on multiple benchmarks using a unified decoder and extra supervision.

2024-07.title: OpenVid-1M: A Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset for Text-to-video Generation
2024-07.summary: The paper introduces OpenVid-1M and OpenVidHD-0.4M datasets, along with MVDiT, a Multi-modal Video Diffusion Transformer, to enhance text-to-video generation by leveraging high-quality data and comprehensive text information.

2024-07.title: MJ-Bench: Is Your Multimodal Reward Model Really a Good Judge for Text-to-Image Generation?
2024-07.summary: MJ-Bench evaluates multimodal judges across alignment, safety, image quality, and bias for text-to-image models and confirms close-source VLMs generally provide better feedback.

2024-07.title: AgentPoison: Red-teaming LLM Agents via Poisoning Memory or Knowledge Bases
2024-07.summary: AgentPoison, a novel red teaming approach, introduces a backdoor attack targeting LLM agents by poisoning their memory or knowledge base, ensuring high attack success rates with minimal impact on normal performance.

2024-07.title: Skywork-Math: Data Scaling Laws for Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models -- The Story Goes On
2024-07.summary: Skywork-Math model series achieves high performance in math reasoning by fine-tuning on a large and diverse dataset, demonstrating that data quantity significantly enhances LLM mathematical capabilities.

2024-07.title: ColPali: Efficient Document Retrieval with Vision Language Models
2024-07.summary: The ColPali retrieval model uses Vision Language Models to create embeddings from images of document pages, improving performance and speed in visually rich document retrieval tasks.

2024-07.title: AgentInstruct: Toward Generative Teaching with Agentic Flows
2024-07.summary: AgentInstruct, an agentic framework, generates high-quality synthetic data for post-training language models, leading to significant performance improvements across various benchmarks.

2024-07.title: SeaLLMs 3: Open Foundation and Chat Multilingual Large Language Models for Southeast Asian Languages
2024-07.summary: SeaLLMs 3 is a large language model optimized for Southeast Asian languages, offering state-of-the-art performance in various tasks while addressing safety and cultural considerations.

2024-07.title: TabReD: A Benchmark of Tabular Machine Learning in-the-Wild
2024-07.summary: TabReD is a new collection of industry-grade tabular datasets that address temporal dynamics and feature engineering, revealing that simpler models outperform more complex deep learning architectures in these settings.

2024-07.title: Video Diffusion Alignment via Reward Gradients
2024-07.summary: Utilizing pre-trained reward models to adapt video diffusion models with gradient-based feedback enhances efficiency and performance compared to gradient-free methods.

2024-07.title: SaulLM-54B & SaulLM-141B: Scaling Up Domain Adaptation for the Legal Domain
2024-07.summary: Two large legal language models, SaulLM-54B and SaulLM-141B, based on the Mixtral architecture, are introduced for domain-specific adaptation in the legal sector using continued pretraining, specialized protocols, and preference alignment with synthetic data.

2024-07.title: LazyLLM: Dynamic Token Pruning for Efficient Long Context LLM Inference
2024-07.summary: LazyLLM dynamically selects important prompt tokens to accelerate the prefilling stage in transformer-based language models without sacrificing accuracy.

2024-07.title: Let the Expert Stick to His Last: Expert-Specialized Fine-Tuning for Sparse Architectural Large Language Models
2024-07.summary: Research on parameter-efficient fine-tuning for Large Language Models with Mixture-of-Experts architecture reveals that task-specific expert tuning can enhance performance and efficiency.

2024-07.title: KAN or MLP: A Fairer Comparison
2024-07.summary: A comprehensive comparison of KAN and MLP models across diverse tasks reveals that MLP generally outperforms KAN except in symbolic formula representation where KAN's B-spline activation function provides advantage, and KAN exhibits more severe forgetting issues in class-incremental continual learning.

2024-07.title: Multimodal Self-Instruct: Synthetic Abstract Image and Visual Reasoning Instruction Using Language Model
2024-07.summary: A multi-modal self-instruct benchmark using large language models and code capabilities enhances understanding and reasoning for abstract images and visual tasks, improving performance metrics like chart understanding and map navigation.

2024-07.title: EVLM: An Efficient Vision-Language Model for Visual Understanding
2024-07.summary: A multi-modal language model using cross-attention, hierarchical ViT features, and Mixture of Experts mechanism achieves competitive performance in image and video captioning tasks with reduced computational costs.

2024-07.title: E5-V: Universal Embeddings with Multimodal Large Language Models
2024-07.summary: E5-V, a novel framework, utilizes multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to achieve universal multimodal embeddings with strong performance and reduced costs through single modality training.

2024-07.title: LLaVA-NeXT-Interleave: Tackling Multi-image, Video, and 3D in Large Multimodal Models
2024-07.summary: LLaVA-NeXT-Interleave addresses multi-image, multi-frame, multi-view, and multi-patch scenarios in LMMs using the M4-Instruct dataset and LLaVA-Interleave Bench to achieve leading results while maintaining single-image performance.

2024-07.title: NeedleBench: Can LLMs Do Retrieval and Reasoning in 1 Million Context Window?
2024-07.summary: NeedleBench and the Ancestral Trace Challenge evaluate the long-context retrieval and reasoning capabilities of large language models, highlighting their limitations in practical applications.

2024-07.title: Diffusion Forcing: Next-token Prediction Meets Full-Sequence Diffusion
2024-07.summary: Diffusion Forcing trains diffusion models to denoise tokens with independent noise levels, combining next-token prediction and full-sequence diffusion strengths for sequence generation and decision-making tasks.

2024-07.title: Theia: Distilling Diverse Vision Foundation Models for Robot Learning
2024-07.summary: Theia, a vision foundation model for robot learning, outperforms existing models with less data and smaller sizes by distilling knowledge from multiple vision foundation models.

2024-07.title: VILA^2: VILA Augmented VILA
2024-07.summary: A novel data augmentation approach iteratively improves visual language model data quality and performance using self-augmentation and specialist-augmentation, leading to state-of-the-art results on MMMU tasks.

2024-07.title: RegMix: Data Mixture as Regression for Language Model Pre-training
2024-07.summary: RegMix automatically identifies optimal data mixtures for pre-training large language models by formulating it as a regression task, significantly improving performance with reduced computational cost.

2024-07.title: LiteSearch: Efficacious Tree Search for LLM
2024-07.summary: A guided tree search algorithm with dynamic node selection and budget calculation improves LLM mathematical reasoning performance while reducing computational costs.

2024-07.title: Very Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation in AgentScope
2024-07.summary: Enhancements to the AgentScope platform improve scalability, efficiency, and ease of use for large-scale multi-agent simulations through distributed mechanisms, flexible environments, and user-friendly tools.

2024-07.title: FunAudioLLM: Voice Understanding and Generation Foundation Models for Natural Interaction Between Humans and LLMs
2024-07.summary: FunAudioLLM enhances voice interactions by integrating SenseVoice for multilingual speech recognition, emotion detection, and audio event detection with CosyVoice for natural speech generation across languages, timbres, and styles.

2024-07.title: SlowFast-LLaVA: A Strong Training-Free Baseline for Video Large Language Models
2024-07.summary: SlowFast-LLaVA captures detailed spatial and temporal features in videos using a two-stream design, outperforming existing training-free methods and matching fine-tuned Video LLMs.

2024-07.title: Associative Recurrent Memory Transformer
2024-07.summary: The Associative Recurrent Memory Transformer effectively handles long sequences by combining transformer self-attention with segment-level recurrence, achieving high accuracy in long-context tasks like BABILong.

2024-07.title: MMEvalPro: Calibrating Multimodal Benchmarks Towards Trustworthy and Efficient Evaluation
2024-07.summary: MMEvalPro is a benchmark designed to mitigate biases in multimodal evaluations through augmented questions and rigorous metrics, demonstrating greater challenge and trustworthiness for LMM and LLM performance assessments.

2024-07.title: FreeLong: Training-Free Long Video Generation with SpectralBlend Temporal Attention
2024-07.summary: FreeLong enhances long video generation by balancing global and local video features during denoising, improving quality and consistency.

2024-07.title: Knowledge Mechanisms in Large Language Models: A Survey and Perspective
2024-07.summary: The paper examines knowledge mechanisms in Large Language Models, focusing on utilization (memorization, comprehension, application, and creation) and evolution, addressing the fragility of parametric knowledge and potential dark knowledge.

2024-06.title: Depth Anything V2
2024-06.summary: Depth Anything V2 improves monocular depth estimation through synthetic images, larger teacher models, and pseudo-labeled real images, achieving better efficiency and accuracy than Stable Diffusion models.

2024-06.title: The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale
2024-06.summary: FineWeb, a 15-trillion token dataset from Common Crawl snapshots, outperforms other open datasets in LLM training, and its educational subset, FineWeb-Edu, significantly improves performance on knowledge and reasoning benchmarks.

2024-06.title: nabla^2DFT: A Universal Quantum Chemistry Dataset of Drug-Like Molecules and a Benchmark for Neural Network Potentials
2024-06.summary: A new dataset and benchmark, $\nabla^2$DFT, enhances neural network potentials for molecular property prediction, Hamiltonian prediction, and conformational optimization with extensive, diverse molecular data.

2024-06.title: Instruction Pre-Training: Language Models are Supervised Multitask Learners
2024-06.summary: Instruction Pre-Training enhances language models by generating and incorporating instruction-response pairs into unsupervised multitask pre-training.

2024-06.title: Make It Count: Text-to-Image Generation with an Accurate Number of Objects
2024-06.summary: CountGen enhances text-to-image diffusion models by accurately controlling the number of depicted objects using features that carry object identity information, surpassing existing methods on benchmark datasets.

2024-06.title: XLand-100B: A Large-Scale Multi-Task Dataset for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
2024-06.summary: XLand-100B is a large-scale dataset for in-context reinforcement learning, containing extensive learning histories in the XLand-MiniGrid environment.

2024-06.title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2: Breaking the Barrier of Closed-Source Models in Code Intelligence
2024-06.summary: DeepSeek-Coder-V2, a Mixture-of-Experts language model, excels in code-specific tasks by enhancing coding and mathematical reasoning capabilities while expanding language support and context length.

2024-06.title: ShareGPT4Video: Improving Video Understanding and Generation with Better Captions
2024-06.summary: The ShareGPT4Video series enhances video understanding and generation using dense captions and an efficient captioning strategy by addressing temporal and spatial challenges in video annotation.

2024-06.title: Magpie: Alignment Data Synthesis from Scratch by Prompting Aligned LLMs with Nothing
2024-06.summary: Magpie, a self-synthesis method, generates high-quality instruction data from aligned LLMs, enabling competitive performance in alignment benchmarks compared to models fine-tuned with larger, supervised datasets.

2024-06.title: Adam-mini: Use Fewer Learning Rates To Gain More
2024-06.summary: Adam-mini reduces memory usage by optimizing learning rate allocation in parameter blocks, achieving comparable or better performance than AdamW with increased throughput.

2024-06.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
2024-06.summary: A new framework connects state-space models and transformers, leading to a faster architecture for language modeling.

2024-06.title: The Devil is in the Details: StyleFeatureEditor for Detail-Rich StyleGAN Inversion and High Quality Image Editing
2024-06.summary: StyleFeatureEditor combines W-space and F-space for effective image attribute manipulation in StyleGAN, balancing reconstruction quality and detailed editing.

2024-06.title: The Prompt Report: A Systematic Survey of Prompting Techniques
2024-06.summary: A taxonomy and meta-analysis are provided for prompting techniques and vocabulary in GenAI systems, with a focus on natural language prefix-prompting.

2024-06.title: Autoregressive Model Beats Diffusion: Llama for Scalable Image Generation
2024-06.summary: LlamaGen applies the next-token prediction paradigm from large language models to image generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance with various model sizes and conditions.

2024-06.title: Cambrian-1: A Fully Open, Vision-Centric Exploration of Multimodal LLMs
2024-06.summary: Cambrian-1, a vision-centric multimodal LLM family, introduces the Spatial Vision Aggregator (SVA) and a new benchmark CV-Bench to enhance visual grounding and representation learning in multimodal systems.

2024-06.title: LongRAG: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Long-context LLMs
2024-06.summary: The LongRAG framework improves information retrieval and answer extraction by using longer retrieval units and leveraging long-context LLMs, leading to better performance on benchmark datasets.

2024-06.title: MMDU: A Multi-Turn Multi-Image Dialog Understanding Benchmark and Instruction-Tuning Dataset for LVLMs
2024-06.summary: A new benchmark (MMDU) and instruction tuning dataset (MMDU-45k) are introduced to evaluate and enhance large vision-language models' performance in multi-turn and multi-image conversations, highlighting the need for improved conversational instruction tuning data.

2024-06.title: An Image is Worth 32 Tokens for Reconstruction and Generation
2024-06.summary: Transformer-based 1D Tokenizer (TiTok) reduces computational demands and enhances image synthesis efficiency by significantly decreasing token count and outperforming state-of-the-art methods in both speed and quality.

2024-06.title: DreamBench++: A Human-Aligned Benchmark for Personalized Image Generation
2024-06.summary: dreambench++ uses advanced multimodal GPT models to create human-aligned evaluations for generative models in image generation, improving assessment accuracy and efficiency.

2024-06.title: Needle In A Multimodal Haystack
2024-06.summary: NN-NIAH is a benchmark that evaluates MLLMs' comprehension of long multimodal documents across retrieval, counting, and reasoning tasks.

2024-06.title: Mixture-of-Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities
2024-06.summary: A Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) methodology combines multiple large language models (LLMs) to achieve state-of-the-art performance on various evaluations.

2024-06.title: MMLU-Pro: A More Robust and Challenging Multi-Task Language Understanding Benchmark
2024-06.summary: MMLU-Pro extends the MMLU benchmark with more challenging reasoning questions, eliminates trivial ones, and demonstrates better stability and discriminative power for language models.

2024-06.title: DataComp-LM: In search of the next generation of training sets for language models
2024-06.summary: DataComp for Language Models (DCLM) provides a benchmark with a standardized corpus and recipes to improve language models through controlled dataset experiments, showing the importance of data curation for performance and compute efficiency.

2024-06.title: ChartMimic: Evaluating LMM's Cross-Modal Reasoning Capability via Chart-to-Code Generation
2024-06.summary: ChartMimic is a new benchmark assessing large multimodal models' visually-grounded code generation for chart rendering, evaluating multi-level cognitive capabilities with diverse chart types and metrics.

2024-06.title: OMG-LLaVA: Bridging Image-level, Object-level, Pixel-level Reasoning and Understanding
2024-06.summary: OMG-LLaVA integrates pixel-level vision understanding and reasoning capabilities through a universal segmentation method combined with LLM, achieving high performance across multiple benchmarks.

2024-06.title: An Image is Worth More Than 16x16 Patches: Exploring Transformers on Individual Pixels
2024-06.summary: Vanilla Transformers achieve high performance in computer vision tasks by treating individual pixels as tokens, challenging the conventional use of local neighborhoods.

2024-06.title: NaRCan: Natural Refined Canonical Image with Integration of Diffusion Prior for Video Editing
2024-06.summary: A video editing framework combining deformation fields and diffusion priors produces high-quality canonical images for diverse video editing tasks with accelerated training using low-rank adaptation.

2024-06.title: Depth Anywhere: Enhancing 360 Monocular Depth Estimation via Perspective Distillation and Unlabeled Data Augmentation
2024-06.summary: A new depth estimation framework for 360-degree imagery uses pseudo-labels generated by perspective depth models to improve accuracy, especially in zero-shot scenarios.

2024-06.title: BABILong: Testing the Limits of LLMs with Long Context Reasoning-in-a-Haystack
2024-06.summary: BABILong benchmark evaluates large language models' reasoning across long documents, revealing that models use only a small portion of context and that recurrent memory transformers handle longer contexts better.

2024-06.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
2024-06.summary: OpenVLA, a 7B-parameter open-source vision-language-action model, demonstrates strong performance in generalist manipulation and efficient fine-tuning for new tasks, outperforming larger closed models and from-scratch imitation learning methods.

2024-06.title: BigCodeBench: Benchmarking Code Generation with Diverse Function Calls and Complex Instructions
2024-06.summary: Benchmark Bench assesses LLMs' capability to solve practical programming tasks by invoking function calls from various libraries, revealing significant performance gaps compared to human developers.

2024-06.title: CRAG -- Comprehensive RAG Benchmark
2024-06.summary: The Comprehensive RAG Benchmark (CRAG) evaluates RAG solutions with diverse QA tasks, revealing gaps in LLM accuracy and future research directions.

2024-06.title: Transformers meet Neural Algorithmic Reasoners
2024-06.summary: A novel TransNAR model combines Transformer-based language understanding with graph neural network solvers to enhance algorithmic reasoning.

2024-06.title: YouDream: Generating Anatomically Controllable Consistent Text-to-3D Animals
2024-06.summary: YouDream generates high-quality, anatomically consistent 3D animals using a text-to-image diffusion model guided by 2D pose priors, showcasing superior creativity and quality compared to prior methods.

2024-06.title: Step-DPO: Step-wise Preference Optimization for Long-chain Reasoning of LLMs
2024-06.summary: A novel method called Step-DPO enhances LLMs' mathematical reasoning by optimizing individual reasoning steps, achieving significant accuracy improvements with minimal data and training.

2024-06.title: What If We Recaption Billions of Web Images with LLaMA-3?
2024-06.summary: Enhancing image-text pairs through recaptioning with LLaMA-3 improves model performance in vision-language tasks, including zero-shot retrieval and text-to-image generation.

2024-06.title: Octo-planner: On-device Language Model for Planner-Action Agents
2024-06.summary: An on-device Planner-Action framework, utilizing Phi-3 Mini for planning and Octopus for execution, employs model fine-tuning and multi-LoRA training to enhance efficiency and multi-domain handling on resource-constrained devices.

2024-06.title: mDPO: Conditional Preference Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Models
2024-06.summary: mDPO, a multimodal preference optimization method, addresses the unconditional preference problem and enhances model performance in multimodal large language models.
2024-06.org: Language Understanding and Knowledge Acquisition Lab

2024-06.title: MotionClone: Training-Free Motion Cloning for Controllable Video Generation
2024-06.summary: MotionClone, a training-free framework, uses motion cloning to control text-to-video generation, yielding superior motion fidelity, textual alignment, and temporal consistency.

2024-06.title: Seed-TTS: A Family of High-Quality Versatile Speech Generation Models
2024-06.summary: Seed-TTS is a family of large-scale TTS models that generate high-quality speech with in-context learning, superior controllability, and a non-autoregressive variant using diffusion-based architecture that does not rely on pre-estimated phoneme durations.

2024-06.title: HARE: HumAn pRiors, a key to small language model Efficiency
2024-06.summary: A principle for leveraging human priors in data construction is proposed to improve small language models, demonstrating favorable performance on large benchmarks in resource-constrained settings.

2024-06.title: Bootstrapping Language Models with DPO Implicit Rewards
2024-06.summary: A novel method using the implicit reward model from Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to iteratively improve the alignment of large language models, achieving superior performance without external feedback.

2024-06.title: Samba: Simple Hybrid State Space Models for Efficient Unlimited Context Language Modeling
2024-06.summary: Samba, a hybrid architecture combining State Space Models and Sliding Window Attention, efficiently handles long-range context with lower computational complexity and better memory recall than pure attention or SSM models.

2024-06.title: PowerInfer-2: Fast Large Language Model Inference on a Smartphone
2024-06.summary: PowerInfer-2 is a framework that enhances the high-speed inference of large language models on smartphones by utilizing heterogeneous resources and optimizing matrix computations through neuron cluster processing.

2024-06.title: Block Transformer: Global-to-Local Language Modeling for Fast Inference
2024-06.summary: The Block Transformer architecture enhances inference throughput by applying global-to-local modeling to autoregressive transformers, reducing inference bottlenecks through hierarchical processing and block-level self-attention.

2024-06.title: McEval: Massively Multilingual Code Evaluation
2024-06.summary: A multilingual code benchmark covering 40 programming languages with 16K test samples is introduced to advance code language model research, along with a multilingual coder model and instruction corpora.

2024-06.title: BitsFusion: 1.99 bits Weight Quantization of Diffusion Model
2024-06.summary: A weight quantization method reduces the size of diffusion-based image generation models while improving generation quality.

2024-06.title: Evaluating D-MERIT of Partial-annotation on Information Retrieval
2024-06.summary: Evaluating retrieval models on partially-annotated datasets can lead to misleading rankings, and more comprehensive annotation improves evaluation reliability.

2024-06.title: Judging the Judges: Evaluating Alignment and Vulnerabilities in LLMs-as-Judges
2024-06.summary: LLM-as-a-judge method for evaluating LLMs shows promise but varies in performance and alignment with human judges, with smaller models like JudgeLM-7B sometimes outperforming larger ones in ranking tasks.

2024-06.title: TroL: Traversal of Layers for Large Language and Vision Models
2024-06.summary: The TroL model efficiently reduces the size of large language and vision models while maintaining or surpassing performance through a layer traversal technique that reuses layers token-wise.

2024-05.title: Your Transformer is Secretly Linear
2024-05.summary: Transformer decoders exhibit near-perfect linear relationships between layers, which can be reduced with cosine-similarity-based regularization, leading to improved performance on benchmarks.

2024-05.title: Chameleon: Mixed-Modal Early-Fusion Foundation Models
2024-05.summary: Chameleon is a mixed-modal early-fusion token-based model that achieves state-of-the-art performance across various tasks, including image captioning, text generation, and long-form mixed-modal generation, using a unified architecture.

2024-05.title: Prometheus 2: An Open Source Language Model Specialized in Evaluating Other Language Models
2024-05.summary: Prometheus 2 is an advanced open-source evaluator LM that aligns closely with human and proprietary LM judgments, supporting both direct assessment and pairwise ranking with customizable criteria.

2024-05.title: LoRA Land: 310 Fine-tuned LLMs that Rival GPT-4, A Technical Report
2024-05.summary: LoRA fine-tuning reduces computational resources while maintaining high performance across various tasks and models, and LoRAX allows for efficient deployment of multiple LLMs on a single GPU.

2024-05.title: KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
2024-05.summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) outperform Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) in accuracy and interpretability by using learnable activation functions and spline-based weights.

2024-05.title: Octopus v4: Graph of language models
2024-05.summary: The Octopus v4 model uses functional tokens to integrate and direct queries to task-specific open-source language models, achieving SOTA performance with models under 10B parameters.

2024-05.title: An Introduction to Vision-Language Modeling
2024-05.summary: Introduction to vision-language models (VLMs) covering their applications, training, evaluation, and extension to videos, addressing challenges in mapping visual data to language.

2024-05.title: LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less
2024-05.summary: LoRA, a parameter-efficient finetuning method for large language models, underperforms full finetuning in target domains but provides better regularization and maintains diverse generation compared to other techniques.

2024-05.title: Better & Faster Large Language Models via Multi-token Prediction
2024-05.summary: Training large language models to predict multiple future tokens simultaneously enhances their sample efficiency and performance, particularly on generative benchmarks and small algorithmic tasks, with decreased inference time.

2024-05.title: What matters when building vision-language models?
2024-05.summary: Idefics2, a vision-language model with 8 billion parameters, achieves state-of-the-art performance on multimodal benchmarks through extensive experimental validation.

2024-05.title: InstantFamily: Masked Attention for Zero-shot Multi-ID Image Generation
2024-05.summary: InstantFamily uses masked cross-attention and multimodal embeddings to generate images with preserved multi-IDs and high visual coherence.

2024-05.title: RLHF Workflow: From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
2024-05.summary: Online iterative reinforcement learning from human feedback achieves state-of-the-art performance in large language models using open-source datasets and proxy preference models.

2024-05.title: WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild
2024-05.summary: Chatbots such as GPT-4 and ChatGPT are now serving millions of users. Despite their widespread use, there remains a lack of public datasets showcasing how these tools are used by a population of users in practice. To bridge this gap, we offered free access to ChatGPT for online users in exchange for their affirmative, …

2024-05.title: Transformers Can Do Arithmetic with the Right Embeddings
2024-05.summary: Transformers achieve state-of-the-art performance on large arithmetic tasks and other reasoning tasks by addressing positional tracking with embeddings and integrating architectural modifications.
2024-05.org: Tom Goldstein's Lab at University of Maryland, College Park

2024-05.title: Meteor: Mamba-based Traversal of Rationale for Large Language and Vision Models
2024-05.summary: Meteor, an efficient large language and vision model, enhances understanding and answering capabilities by embedding multifaceted rationales using the Mamba architecture, leading to improved vision language performance without increasing model size or using additional vision encoders.

2024-05.title: FIFO-Diffusion: Generating Infinite Videos from Text without Training
2024-05.summary: FIFO-Diffusion generates long text-conditional videos through iterative denoising with latent partitioning and lookahead strategies to minimize the training-inference gap.

2024-05.title: StoryDiffusion: Consistent Self-Attention for Long-Range Image and Video Generation
2024-05.summary: StoryDiffusion, combining consistent self-attention and semantic motion prediction, enables generation of coherent and stable images and videos from textual descriptions.

2024-05.title: Iterative Reasoning Preference Optimization
2024-05.summary: An iterative preference optimization method using a modified DPO loss improves reasoning accuracy on various datasets by optimizing winning and losing reasoning steps in Chain-of-Thought candidates.

2024-05.title: DeepSeek-Prover: Advancing Theorem Proving in LLMs through Large-Scale Synthetic Data
2024-05.summary: Generating extensive Lean 4 proof data from mathematical competition problems improved DeepSeekMath 7B's theorem-proving capabilities over GPT-4 and other methods.

2024-05.title: MAP-Neo: Highly Capable and Transparent Bilingual Large Language Model Series
2024-05.summary: MAP-Neo, a fully open-sourced bilingual LLM with 7B parameters, achieves performance comparable to existing state-of-the-art LLMs, enhancing transparency and fostering innovation in the open research community.

2024-05.title: Phased Consistency Model
2024-05.summary: The Phased Consistency Model (PCM) addresses limitations in Latent Consistency Models (LCM) and outperforms them in high-resolution, text-conditioned image and few-step text-to-video generation.

2024-05.title: MoRA: High-Rank Updating for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
2024-05.summary: MoRA, a high-rank updating method using square matrices, enhances the ability of large language models to learn and memorize new knowledge, especially in memory-intensive tasks, compared to LoRA.

2024-05.title: CAT3D: Create Anything in 3D with Multi-View Diffusion Models
2024-05.summary: CAT3D generates consistent 3D views from limited input using a multi-view diffusion model, enabling fast and accurate 3D reconstruction.

2024-05.title: ConvLLaVA: Hierarchical Backbones as Visual Encoder for Large Multimodal Models
2024-05.summary: ConvLLaVA addresses excessive visual tokens and quadratic complexity in high-resolution multimodal models by using ConvNeXt as a hierarchical backbone, optimizing pretrained ConvNeXt for high resolution, and adding a successive stage for further compression, achieving competitive performance.

2024-05.title: Grokked Transformers are Implicit Reasoners: A Mechanistic Journey to the Edge of Generalization
2024-05.summary: Transformers can learn implicit reasoning through extensive training, with varying degrees of generalization for different reasoning types, and parametric memory proves more effective for complex reasoning tasks compared to non-parametric memory.

2024-05.title: Not All Language Model Features Are Linear
2024-05.summary: Research explores multi-dimensional features in language models, discovering interpretable circular representations in GPT-2, Mistral 7B, and Llama 3 8B, which are used for modular arithmetic tasks.

2024-05.title: OpenRLHF: An Easy-to-use, Scalable and High-performance RLHF Framework
2024-05.summary: OpenRLHF is an open-source RLHF framework that enhances training efficiency and accessibility for researchers and practitioners.

2024-05.title: SUTRA: Scalable Multilingual Language Model Architecture
2024-05.summary: SUTRA, a multilingual Large Language Model architecture, achieves superior performance on multilingual tasks by decoupling conceptual understanding from language-specific processing using a Mixture of Experts framework.

2024-05.title: Jina CLIP: Your CLIP Model Is Also Your Text Retriever
2024-05.summary: A novel multi-task contrastive training method improves CLIP model performance on both text-image and text-text retrieval tasks.

2024-05.title: Matryoshka Multimodal Models
2024-05.summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) such as LLaVA have shown strong performance in visual-linguistic reasoning. These models first embed images into a fixed large number of visual tokens and then feed them into a Large Language Model (LLM). However, this design causes an excessive number of tokens for dense visual scenarios…

2024-05.title: INDUS: Effective and Efficient Language Models for Scientific Applications
2024-05.summary: INDUS, a suite of domain-specific LLMs trained on curated scientific corpora, surpasses general-purpose and existing domain-specific models on specialized NLP tasks and new scientific benchmarks.

2024-05.title: Similarity is Not All You Need: Endowing Retrieval Augmented Generation with Multi Layered Thoughts
2024-05.summary: MetRag enhances retrieval-augmented generation by integrating similarity and utility-oriented thoughts, employing an LLM as a task adaptive summarizer, and leveraging multi-layered thoughts for knowledge-intensive tasks.

2024-05.title: Aya 23: Open Weight Releases to Further Multilingual Progress
2024-05.summary: Aya 23 is a powerful multilingual language model for 23 languages, outperforming previous models on a wide range of tasks.

2024-05.title: Beyond Scaling Laws: Understanding Transformer Performance with Associative Memory
2024-05.summary: A theoretical framework using Hopfield networks explains memorization and performance dynamics in Transformer-based language models, showing bounds on achievable cross-entropy loss.

2024-05.title: Extending Llama-3's Context Ten-Fold Overnight
2024-05.summary: Llama-3-8B-Instruct's context length is extended from 8K to 80K using QLoRA fine-tuning with minimal additional training samples, demonstrating significant potential for further context extension with increased computational resources.

2024-05.title: Reducing Transformer Key-Value Cache Size with Cross-Layer Attention
2024-05.summary: Cross-Layer Attention modifies transformer-based autoregressive large language models to reduce KV cache size while maintaining accuracy, enabling longer sequence lengths and larger batch sizes during inference.

2024-05.title: Grounding DINO 1.5: Advance the "Edge" of Open-Set Object Detection
2024-05.summary: Grounding DINO 1.5, comprising Pro and Edge models, enhances open-set object detection through advanced architectures and large datasets, achieving high performance and efficiency.

2024-05.title: FLAME: Factuality-Aware Alignment for Large Language Models
2024-05.summary: Proposes factuality-aware alignment methods for pre-trained language models to enhance factual accuracy during supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, reducing hallucination.

2024-05.title: Diffusion for World Modeling: Visual Details Matter in Atari
2024-05.summary: DIAMOND, a reinforcement learning agent using a diffusion world model, achieves top performance on Atari 100k by capturing visual details effectively.

2024-05.title: Towards Modular LLMs by Building and Reusing a Library of LoRAs
2024-05.summary: A novel approach using model-based clustering and zero-shot routing improves the generalization of adapters in large language models for new tasks.

2024-05.title: Many-Shot In-Context Learning in Multimodal Foundation Models
2024-05.summary: Multimodal foundation models exhibit significant performance improvements with many-shot in-context learning compared to few-shot, with Gemini 1.5 Pro showing higher data efficiency and better batch processing capabilities across various domains.

2024-05.title: Stacking Your Transformers: A Closer Look at Model Growth for Efficient LLM Pre-Training
2024-05.summary: A depthwise stacking operator called $G_{\text{stack}}$ accelerates LLM pre-training, improving performance with less computational expense and providing guidelines for effective use.

2024-05.title: Self-Play Preference Optimization for Language Model Alignment
2024-05.summary: A self-play method called SPPO for language model alignment achieves state-of-the-art performance by approximating Nash equilibrium policy in a constant-sum game setting, outperforming other approaches with limited data.

2024-05.title: A Careful Examination of Large Language Model Performance on Grade School Arithmetic
2024-05.summary: Evaluation of large language models on a new math benchmark, GSM1k, reveals that many models exhibit signs of overfitting to the existing GSM8k benchmark, leading to performance drops on GSM1k.

2024-05.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
2024-05.summary: Octo, a large transformer-based policy trained on extensive robotic datasets, demonstrates versatility and efficient fine-tuning for diverse robotic platforms and tasks.

2024-05.title: NeMo-Aligner: Scalable Toolkit for Efficient Model Alignment
2024-05.summary: NeMo-Aligner is a toolkit for aligning large language models with human values using scalable techniques like RLHF, DPO, SteerLM, and SPIN, optimized for use with hundreds of GPUs and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

2024-05.title: Zamba: A Compact 7B SSM Hybrid Model
2024-05.summary: Zamba, a 7B SSM-transformer hybrid model, achieves competitive performance with minimal parameter cost and efficient inference by combining a Mamba backbone with a shared attention module.

2024-05.title: AutoCoder: Enhancing Code Large Language Model with AIEV-Instruct
2024-05.summary: AutoCoder, a Large Language Model surpassing GPT-4 Turbo and GPT-4o, uses a novel training method \textsc{AIEV-Instruct} to enhance code interpretation and execution validation.

2024-05.title: MotionLCM: Real-time Controllable Motion Generation via Latent Consistency Model
2024-05.summary: MotionLCM generates real-time controllable human motions using text and control signals by extending latent diffusion models with a Motion ControlNet.

2024-05.title: The Road Less Scheduled
2024-05.summary: A new schedule-free method achieves state-of-the-art performance in optimization without requiring a stopping time or additional hyper-parameters, by unifying scheduling and iterate averaging.

2024-04.title: Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone
2024-04.summary: Phi-3-mini, a compact 3.8 billion parameter language model, achieves competitive performance with larger models through an enhanced training dataset and alignment.

2024-04.title: OpenELM: An Efficient Language Model Family with Open-source Training and Inference Framework
2024-04.summary: OpenELM, an open language model, uses layer-wise scaling to enhance accuracy and is released with comprehensive training and evaluation frameworks, enabling transparent and reproducible research.

2024-04.title: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model
2024-04.summary: Jamba, a hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE model, achieves state-of-the-art performance with high throughput and minimal memory usage, supporting large context lengths.

2024-04.title: Leave No Context Behind: Efficient Infinite Context Transformers with Infini-attention
2024-04.summary: A novel Infini-attention mechanism allows Transformer-based LLMs to handle infinitely long inputs with limited memory and compute, enabling efficient long-context modeling and fast inference.

2024-04.title: Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models
2024-04.summary: Transformer-based models can dynamically allocate computational resources to specific positions in input sequences, leading to efficient performance with reduced FLOPs.

2024-04.title: ReFT: Representation Finetuning for Language Models
2024-04.summary: Representation Finetuning (ReFT) methods, exemplified by Low-rank Linear Subspace ReFT (LoReFT), achieve high efficiency and performance by adapting representations in frozen base models, outperforming state-of-the-art Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning (PEFT) methods.

2024-04.title: Rho-1: Not All Tokens Are What You Need
2024-04.summary: Rho-1, a novel language model using Selective Language Modeling, improves efficiency and performance by selectively training on useful tokens rather than all tokens in the corpus.

2024-04.title: Learn Your Reference Model for Real Good Alignment
2024-04.summary: A new method, Trust Region DPO (TR-DPO), is proposed to improve policy alignment in reinforcement learning, outperforming Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) by up to 19% on key datasets by updating the reference policy during training.

2024-04.title: Ferret-UI: Grounded Mobile UI Understanding with Multimodal LLMs
2024-04.summary: Ferret-UI, a multimodal large language model tailored for mobile UI screens, enhances understanding and interaction through region annotations and a comprehensive dataset of UI tasks, outperforming existing models including GPT-4V.

2024-04.title: LayerSkip: Enabling Early Exit Inference and Self-Speculative Decoding
2024-04.summary: LayerSkip, an end-to-end method, accelerates large language model inference through layer dropout and self-speculative decoding without auxiliary layers.

2024-04.title: OmniFusion Technical Report
2024-04.summary: The OmniFusion model, leveraging pretrained LLMs and visual adapters, demonstrates superior performance across multiple visual-language benchmarks compared to open-source alternatives.

2024-04.title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
2024-04.summary: Visual AutoRegressive (VAR) modeling improves image generation performance and speed over autoregressive and diffusion transformer models, achieving superior results in image quality, data efficiency, and scalability.

2024-04.title: Replacing Judges with Juries: Evaluating LLM Generations with a Panel of Diverse Models
2024-04.summary: Evaluating Large Language Models using a Panel of smaller evaluators outperforms single large evaluators with reduced bias and cost.

2024-04.title: LLM2Vec: Large Language Models Are Secretly Powerful Text Encoders
2024-04.summary: LLM2Vec transforms decoder-only LLMs into effective text encoders using bidirectional attention, masked next token prediction, and unsupervised contrastive learning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on text embedding tasks.

2024-04.title: Megalodon: Efficient LLM Pretraining and Inference with Unlimited Context Length
2024-04.summary: Megaldon, an enhanced neural architecture, provides efficient long-sequence modeling by combining and improving upon components from mega and transformer models, achieving better pretraining efficiency and performance.

2024-04.title: Direct Nash Optimization: Teaching Language Models to Self-Improve with General Preferences
2024-04.summary: A Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) algorithm is introduced for post-training large language models using preference feedback, achieving state-of-the-art performance with polynomial parameters.

2024-04.title: Multi-Head Mixture-of-Experts
2024-04.summary: MH-MoE enhances SMoE by splitting tokens into sub-tokens processed by diverse experts in parallel, improving expert activation, context understanding, and overfitting, and demonstrating effectiveness across various modeling tasks.

2024-04.title: How Far Are We to GPT-4V? Closing the Gap to Commercial Multimodal Models with Open-Source Suites
2024-04.summary: InternVL 1.5, an open-source multimodal language model, improves visual understanding and high-resolution image processing through continuous learning, dynamic tile division, and a high-quality bilingual dataset, achieving state-of-the-art results in several benchmarks.

2024-04.title: Octopus v2: On-device language model for super agent
2024-04.summary: A new on-device method improves the performance of a large language model, matching GPT-4's accuracy and latency while reducing context length and enhancing deployment on edge devices.

2024-04.title: Toward Self-Improvement of LLMs via Imagination, Searching, and Criticizing
2024-04.summary: AlphaLLM enhances Large Language Models through integration with Monte Carlo Tree Search and critic models, improving performance in complex reasoning tasks without additional annotations.

2024-04.title: Make Your LLM Fully Utilize the Context
2024-04.summary: FILM-7B enhances long-context processing by using information-intensive training with synthesized datasets, improving retrieval and performance on real-world tasks without compromising short-context performance.

2024-04.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
2024-04.summary: OSWorld provides a scalable, real computer environment for evaluating multimodal agents across various operating systems and tasks, highlighting significant gaps in current LLM/VLM capabilities.

2024-04.title: Language Models as Compilers: Simulating Pseudocode Execution Improves Algorithmic Reasoning in Language Models
2024-04.summary: Think-and-Execute is a novel framework that enhances algorithmic reasoning in large language models by decomposing the reasoning process into task-level logic expressed as pseudocode and instance-specific execution.

2024-04.title: ControlNet++: Improving Conditional Controls with Efficient Consistency Feedback
2024-04.summary: ControlNet++ enhances text-to-image generation controllability through pixel-level cycle consistency optimization using an efficient noise-disturbed reward strategy.

2024-04.title: RecurrentGemma: Moving Past Transformers for Efficient Open Language Models
2024-04.summary: RecurrentGemma, using Griffin architecture, achieves excellent language performance with efficient memory usage and fewer training tokens compared to Gemma-2B.

2024-04.title: Gecko: Versatile Text Embeddings Distilled from Large Language Models
2024-04.summary: Gecko is a compact and versatile text embedding model that distills knowledge from large language models to achieve strong retrieval performance on benchmarks.

2024-04.title: Advancing LLM Reasoning Generalists with Preference Trees
2024-04.summary: Eurus, a suite of reasoning-optimized large language models, achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks through UltraInteract, a large-scale, high-quality alignment dataset, and a novel reward modeling objective.

2024-04.title: How Good Are Low-bit Quantized LLaMA3 Models? An Empirical Study
2024-04.summary: LLaMA3 performance degrades significantly when quantized to low bit-width, highlighting challenges in low-bit quantization for large language models.

2024-04.title: AutoCrawler: A Progressive Understanding Web Agent for Web Crawler Generation
2024-04.summary: AutoCrawler combines LLMs with crawlers to efficiently handle diverse and changing web environments using a hierarchical HTML structure for progressive learning.

2024-04.title: TransformerFAM: Feedback attention is working memory
2024-04.summary: Feedback Attention Memory (FAM) enhances Transformer architecture by enabling long-context processing without additional weights, significantly improving performance on large sequences across various model sizes.

2024-04.title: RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
2024-04.summary: RULER is a comprehensive benchmark that extends beyond simple retrieval tasks to evaluate long-context language models' performance on diverse tasks and context lengths.

2024-04.title: Reka Core, Flash, and Edge: A Series of Powerful Multimodal Language Models
2024-04.summary: Reka Core, Flash, and Edge are multimodal language models that achieve state-of-the-art performance across text, image, video, and audio tasks, offering high efficiency and competitive results relative to their compute class.

2024-04.title: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions
2024-04.summary: A hierarchical instruction framework for LLMs increases robustness against malicious prompts by selectively prioritizing system instructions over user inputs.

2024-04.title: Eagle and Finch: RWKV with Matrix-Valued States and Dynamic Recurrence
2024-04.summary: Eagle and Finch, improvements over RWKV-4, use multi-headed matrix-valued states and dynamic recurrence for enhanced expressivity and efficiency, trained on a multilingual corpus.

2024-04.title: PLLaVA : Parameter-free LLaVA Extension from Images to Videos for Video Dense Captioning
2024-04.summary: Pooling LLaVA improves video-language pre-trained models by smoothing high-norm visual features, achieving state-of-the-art performance in video question-answering, captioning, and benchmark tasks.

2024-04.title: Dynamic Typography: Bringing Words to Life
2024-04.summary: Dynamic Typography generates coherent and semantically meaningful text animations using neural displacement fields, end-to-end optimization, and perceptual loss regularization, outperforming baseline methods.

2024-04.title: Pre-training Small Base LMs with Fewer Tokens
2024-04.summary: Inheritune leverages transformer blocks from large language models and minimal data to create smaller, efficient base models with performance competitive to larger models.

2024-04.title: JetMoE: Reaching Llama2 Performance with 0.1M Dollars
2024-04.summary: JetMoE-8B, a cost-effective large language model with 8 billion parameters, achieves impressive performance using a Sparsely-gated Mixture-of-Experts architecture, demonstrating efficient use of resources and computational savings.

2024-04.title: Long-context LLMs Struggle with Long In-context Learning
2024-04.summary: LIConBench evaluates long-context LLMs on extreme-label classification tasks with sequences up to 50K tokens, highlighting performance dips beyond 20K tokens and favoring of recent labels.

2024-04.title: FlowMind: Automatic Workflow Generation with LLMs
2024-04.summary: FlowMind uses Large Language Models with a generic prompt recipe to generate automatic workflows, addressing spontaneous tasks and ensuring data integrity, and it is evaluated using a new financial dataset NCEN-QA.

2024-04.title: Transformer-Lite: High-efficiency Deployment of Large Language Models on Mobile Phone GPUs
2024-04.summary: Transformer-Lite optimizes LLM deployment on device GPUs through various techniques to achieve significant speedups in prefill and decoding over CPU and GPU-based methods.

2024-04.title: Pegasus-v1 Technical Report
2024-04.summary: Pegasus-1 is a multimodal language model designed for video content comprehension, handling spatiotemporal information and demonstrated in benchmarks for video conversation, zero-shot video question answering, and video summarization.

2024-04.title: MagicTime: Time-lapse Video Generation Models as Metamorphic Simulators
2024-04.summary: MagicTime enhances Text-to-Video synthesis by integrating real-world physics knowledge through metamorphic time-lapse videos, using the MagicAdapter, Dynamic Frames Extraction, and Magic Text-Encoder techniques.

2024-04.title: Ferret-v2: An Improved Baseline for Referring and Grounding with Large Language Models
2024-04.summary: Ferret-v2 improves on Ferret by incorporating flexible high-resolution grounding, multi-granularity visual encoding with DINOv2, and a three-stage training paradigm, leading to enhanced visual understanding and performance.

2024-04.title: FlashSpeech: Efficient Zero-Shot Speech Synthesis
2024-04.summary: FlashSpeech, using latent consistency model and adversarial consistency training, achieves fast and high-quality zero-shot speech synthesis with enhanced prosody generation.

2024-04.title: InternLM-XComposer2-4KHD: A Pioneering Large Vision-Language Model Handling Resolutions from 336 Pixels to 4K HD
2024-04.summary: InternLM-XComposer2-4KHD enhances high-resolution understanding capabilities in LVLMs up to 4K, surpassing existing models with dynamic patch configuration and consistent performance improvements.

2024-04.title: CoMat: Aligning Text-to-Image Diffusion Model with Image-to-Text Concept Matching
2024-04.summary: CoMat, an end-to-end diffusion model fine-tuning strategy with an image-to-text concept matching mechanism, improves text-to-image alignment in SDXL without additional data.

2024-04.title: Getting it Right: Improving Spatial Consistency in Text-to-Image Models
2024-04.summary: The paper introduces SPRIGHT, a dataset focused on spatial relationships, and fine-tuning methods that significantly improve spatial consistency in text-to-image models.

2024-04.title: Groma: Localized Visual Tokenization for Grounding Multimodal Large Language Models
2024-04.summary: Groma, a Multimodal Large Language Model, utilizes region-level visual tokenization to enhance visual understanding and localization accuracy in image-grounded tasks.

2024-04.title: Video2Game: Real-time, Interactive, Realistic and Browser-Compatible Environment from a Single Video
2024-04.summary: Video2Game converts real-world scenes into realistic interactive environments by combining neural radiance fields, mesh distillation, and physics modeling.

2024-03.title: GaLore: Memory-Efficient LLM Training by Gradient Low-Rank Projection
2024-03.summary: Gradient Low-Rank Projection (GaLore) improves memory efficiency for training large language models without sacrificing performance, enabling pre-training of 7B models on consumer GPUs.

2024-03.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
2024-03.summary: LlamaFactory is a unified framework enabling efficient fine-tuning of large language models across various tasks using a web-based user interface.

2024-03.title: StarCoder 2 and The Stack v2: The Next Generation
2024-03.summary: StarCoder2, a large language model for code developed through a collaboration with Software Heritage, outperforms other models of similar size on various benchmarks and matches or outperforms larger models in specific areas.

2024-03.title: MM1: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Multimodal LLM Pre-training
2024-03.summary: A study of Multimodal Large Language Models finds a mix of pre-training data and image encoder design crucial for SOTA performance on multimodal benchmarks.

2024-03.title: Design2Code: How Far Are We From Automating Front-End Engineering?
2024-03.summary: Evaluates the performance of multimodal LLMs, including GPT-4V and Gemini Pro Vision, on converting visual designs to code using a new Design2Code task and benchmarks.

2024-03.title: SaulLM-7B: A pioneering Large Language Model for Law
2024-03.summary: SaulLM-7B, a large language model with 7 billion parameters, excels in legal text comprehension and generation using instructional fine-tuning on a legal corpus.

2024-03.title: Stealing Part of a Production Language Model
2024-03.summary: A model-stealing attack is introduced that can extract detailed information such as the embedding projection layer from black-box language models with minimal cost.

2024-03.title: The Unreasonable Ineffectiveness of the Deeper Layers
2024-03.summary: Layer pruning of pre-trained LLMs with parameter-efficient finetuning methods shows minimal performance degradation and significant resource savings in both finetuning and inference.

2024-03.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking
2024-03.summary: Quiet-STaR is an extension of the Self-Taught Reasoner that teaches language models to infer and generate rationales for each token, improving their ability to predict difficult tokens and answer questions without task-specific fine-tuning.

2024-03.title: Mora: Enabling Generalist Video Generation via A Multi-Agent Framework
2024-03.summary: A new multi-agent framework Mora replicates Sora's generalist video generation capabilities using several advanced visual AI agents, achieving similar performance across various tasks.

2024-03.title: MoAI: Mixture of All Intelligence for Large Language and Vision Models
2024-03.summary: MoAI, a new LLVM, integrates outputs from external CV models to enhance VL tasks without expanding model size or curating extra datasets.

2024-03.title: LLM Agent Operating System
2024-03.summary: AIOS, an operating system embedding large language models, addresses resource allocation, context switching, and concurrency challenges for intelligent agents, demonstrating reliability and efficiency.

2024-03.title: RAFT: Adapting Language Model to Domain Specific RAG
2024-03.summary: Retrieval Augmented FineTuning (RAFT) enhances pre-trained large language models' in-domain performance by filtering out irrelevant documents and citing relevant passages.

2024-03.title: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
2024-03.summary: Improved noise sampling techniques and a transformer-based architecture enhance rectified flow models for high-resolution text-to-image synthesis, outperforming existing methods.

2024-03.title: Fast High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
2024-03.summary: Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation (LADD) simplifies the training and improves the performance of diffusion models by using generative features from latent diffusion models, enabling fast and high-resolution image synthesis.

2024-03.title: ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect
2024-03.summary: A new layer pruning method called ShortGPT significantly improves model pruning performance by removing redundant layers based on Block Influence scores.

2024-03.title: Yi: Open Foundation Models by 01.AI
2024-03.summary: The Yi model family, based on transformer architecture, showcases strong performance across benchmarks and modalities through optimized data and scalable infrastructure.

2024-03.title: PERL: Parameter Efficient Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
2024-03.summary: Parameter-efficient reinforcement learning using LoRA in RLHF matches conventional RLHF performance with reduced computational cost and memory usage.

2024-03.title: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
2024-03.summary: Gemini 1.5 Pro, a multimodal mixture-of-experts model, achieves near-perfect recall and state-of-the-art performance in long-context tasks, including QA and ASR, surpassing previous models in token prediction and translation capabilities.

2024-03.title: Evolutionary Optimization of Model Merging Recipes
2024-03.summary: An evolutionary algorithm automates model merging, discovering effective combinations of open-source models without additional training data or compute, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and culturally-aware tasks.

2024-03.title: Unlocking the conversion of Web Screenshots into HTML Code with the WebSight Dataset
2024-03.summary: A synthetic dataset of HTML code and screenshots is introduced to enhance the ability of vision-language models to convert screenshots into HTML code.

2024-03.title: Griffin: Mixing Gated Linear Recurrences with Local Attention for Efficient Language Models
2024-03.summary: Hawk and Griffin, models incorporating gated linear recurrences, achieve high performance with lower computational resources and better hardware efficiency compared to existing architectures.

2024-03.title: ViTAR: Vision Transformer with Any Resolution
2024-03.summary: ViTAR enhances Vision Transformers' scalability across resolutions through dynamic token integration and fuzzy positional encoding, improving accuracy and reducing computational costs.

2024-03.title: Adding NVMe SSDs to Enable and Accelerate 100B Model Fine-tuning on a Single GPU
2024-03.summary: Fuyou enables efficient fine-tuning of large models on low-end GPUs by optimizing SSD-CPU communication and computation, achieving higher GPU utilization compared to ZeRO-Infinity.

2024-03.title: Uni-SMART: Universal Science Multimodal Analysis and Research Transformer
2024-03.summary: Uni-SMART, a multimodal analysis model, outperforms LLMs in understanding scientific literature with diverse content and has applications in patent infringement and chart analysis.

2024-03.title: MathVerse: Does Your Multi-modal LLM Truly See the Diagrams in Visual Math Problems?
2024-03.summary: MathVerse is a comprehensive visual math benchmark with CoT evaluation to assess MLLMs' true understanding and reasoning quality from visual diagrams.

2024-03.title: Simple and Scalable Strategies to Continually Pre-train Large Language Models
2024-03.summary: Simple continual learning strategies, including learning rate re-warming, re-decaying, and data replay, can match the performance of full re-training for large language models with much lower computational cost.

2024-03.title: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
2024-03.summary: Gemma, a family of lightweight and high-performing language models, outperforms similarly sized open models across text-based tasks and emphasizes the importance of responsible model development and safety.

2024-03.title: Chronos: Learning the Language of Time Series
2024-03.summary: Chronos, a framework using pretrained transformer-based models for time series forecasting, outperforms classical methods and achieves comparable zero-shot performance on unseen datasets using tokenized time series data.

2024-03.title: Beyond Language Models: Byte Models are Digital World Simulators
2024-03.summary: bGPT, a model using next byte prediction, simulates various digital processes with high accuracy, matching specialized models in performance and offering insights into algorithm and hardware behavior.

2024-03.title: Mini-Gemini: Mining the Potential of Multi-modality Vision Language Models
2024-03.summary: Mini-Gemini enhances multi-modality Vision Language Models through high-resolution visual tokens, high-quality datasets, and VLM-guided generation, achieving leading performance in zero-shot benchmarks.

2024-03.title: DeepSeek-VL: Towards Real-World Vision-Language Understanding
2024-03.summary: DeepSeek-VL is an open-source vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art performance in real-world applications by combining a hybrid vision encoder with effective pretraining strategies to preserve language model capabilities.

2024-03.title: Teaching Large Language Models to Reason with Reinforcement Learning
2024-03.summary: Multiple RLHF algorithms, including Expert Iteration, PPO, and Return-Conditioned RL, similarly improve LLM reasoning with similar sample complexity, with Expert Iteration slightly outperforming others.

2024-03.title: Branch-Train-MiX: Mixing Expert LLMs into a Mixture-of-Experts LLM
2024-03.summary: Branch-Train-MiX (BTX) method enhances Large Language Models by asynchronously training experts in parallel and integrating them using Mixture-of-Expert layers with token-level routing for improved accuracy and efficiency.

2024-03.title: VisionLLaMA: A Unified LLaMA Interface for Vision Tasks
2024-03.summary: A LLaMA-like vision transformer, VisionLLaMA, is introduced for processing 2D images and achieves state-of-the-art performance in various vision tasks.

2024-03.title: ELLA: Equip Diffusion Models with LLM for Enhanced Semantic Alignment
2024-03.summary: ELLA, an Efficient Large Language Model Adapter, enhances text-to-image diffusion models by integrating powerful Large Language Models through a Timestep-Aware Semantic Connector, improving dense prompt comprehension and generation quality.

2024-03.title: Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference
2024-03.summary: Chatbot Arena, an open platform, evaluates LLMs based on human preferences using pairwise comparisons and crowdsourced votes, confirming its credibility through diverse and accurate data analysis.

2024-03.title: PixArt-Σ: Weak-to-Strong Training of Diffusion Transformer for 4K Text-to-Image Generation
2024-03.summary: PixArt-\Sigma, a Diffusion Transformer model, generates high-quality 4K images more efficiently than existing models using improved data and novel token compression techniques.

2024-03.title: sDPO: Don't Use Your Data All at Once
2024-03.summary: A stepwise direct preference optimization approach improves the alignment of large language models with human preferences and enhances their performance.

2024-03.title: DreamReward: Text-to-3D Generation with Human Preference
2024-03.summary: A framework called DreamReward uses human preference feedback to enhance text-to-3D generation, producing high-fidelity and aligned 3D models.

2024-03.title: VideoAgent: Long-form Video Understanding with Large Language Model as Agent
2024-03.summary: VideoAgent, an agent-based system using a large language model, significantly enhances long-form video understanding through interactive reasoning and efficient zero-shot accuracy on EgoSchema and NExT-QA benchmarks.

2024-03.title: VLOGGER: Multimodal Diffusion for Embodied Avatar Synthesis
2024-03.summary: VLOGGER generates audio-driven human videos from a single image using a diffusion-based method that includes 3D motion and text-to-image models, outperforming existing methods in quality, identity, and consistency.

2024-03.title: NaturalSpeech 3: Zero-Shot Speech Synthesis with Factorized Codec and Diffusion Models
2024-03.summary: NaturalSpeech 3, using factorized diffusion models, outperforms other TTS systems by generating disentangled speech attributes in a zero-shot manner.

2024-03.title: InternLM2 Technical Report
2024-03.summary: InternLM2 is an open-source LLM that outperforms predecessors through innovative pre-training and optimization techniques, including Supervised Fine-Tuning and Conditional Online Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback.

2024-03.title: Cobra: Extending Mamba to Multi-Modal Large Language Model for Efficient Inference
2024-03.summary: Cobra, a linear-complexity multimodal large language model, integrates the Mamba language model with visual modality, achieving competitive performance and faster inference speed compared to existing state-of-the-art models.

2024-03.title: Larimar: Large Language Models with Episodic Memory Control
2024-03.summary: Larimar, a brain-inspired architecture with distributed episodic memory, enhances LLMs for efficient, fast, and accurate knowledge updates, fact editing, and context length generalization.

2024-03.title: Panda-70M: Captioning 70M Videos with Multiple Cross-Modality Teachers
2024-03.summary: A large-scale dataset of video-text pairs, automatically curated and annotated using multimodal models, significantly improves performance in video captioning, retrieval, and generation tasks.

2024-03.title: mPLUG-DocOwl 1.5: Unified Structure Learning for OCR-free Document Understanding
2024-03.summary: A Unified Structure Learning framework is introduced to enhance Visual Document Understanding by integrating structure-aware parsing and multi-grained text localization tasks using a vision-to-text module H-Reducer, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.

2024-03.title: Alignment Studio: Aligning Large Language Models to Particular Contextual Regulations
2024-03.summary: An Alignment Studio architecture empowers developers to tailor language models to specific values, social norms, laws, and guidelines by integrating Framers, Instructors, and Auditors.

2024-03.title: Learning and Leveraging World Models in Visual Representation Learning
2024-03.summary: Image World Models extend Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to predict global photometric transformations, offering adaptable and high-performance representations through fine-tuning.

2024-02.title: The Era of 1-bit LLMs: All Large Language Models are in 1.58 Bits
2024-02.summary: A 1-bit LLM variant, BitNet b1.58, achieves comparable performance to full-precision models with reduced computational costs and introduces new scaling laws and hardware design opportunities.

2024-02.title: EMO: Emote Portrait Alive - Generating Expressive Portrait Videos with Audio2Video Diffusion Model under Weak Conditions
2024-02.summary: EMO, a direct audio-to-video synthesis framework, enhances realism and expressiveness in talking head video generation by capturing nuanced audio-facial relationships without intermediate models.

2024-02.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
2024-02.summary: DeepSeekMath 7B improves mathematical reasoning through enhanced data pre-training and Group Relative Policy Optimization, achieving high scores on MATH benchmark without external tools.

2024-02.title: MobileLLM: Optimizing Sub-billion Parameter Language Models for On-Device Use Cases
2024-02.summary: MobileLLM leverages deep, thin architectures and advanced techniques to achieve high accuracy in sub-billion parameter models suitable for mobile devices.

2024-02.title: Self-Discover: Large Language Models Self-Compose Reasoning Structures
