2024-02.summary: SELF-DISCOVER is a framework enabling LLMs to generate task-specific reasoning structures, enhancing performance on complex reasoning tasks with reduced computational cost.

2024-02.title: LongRoPE: Extending LLM Context Window Beyond 2 Million Tokens
2024-02.summary: LongRoPE extends pre-trained LLMs' context window to 2048k tokens with minimal fine-tuning costs and maintains original performance.

2024-02.title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Without Prompting
2024-02.summary: LLMs can perform chain-of-thought reasoning through top-k decoding without manual prompt engineering, outperforming greedy decoding and showing higher confidence in answers.

2024-02.title: Neural Network Diffusion
2024-02.summary: Diffusion models can generate high-performing neural network parameters using an autoencoder, producing new subsets of network parameters with comparable or improved performance.

2024-02.title: Sora: A Review on Background, Technology, Limitations, and Opportunities of Large Vision Models
2024-02.summary: A comprehensive review of Sora, a text-to-video generative AI model, including its underlying technologies, applications, challenges, and future directions in video generation and human-AI interaction.

2024-02.title: OLMo: Accelerating the Science of Language Models
2024-02.summary: OLMo, an open-sourced language model, provides comprehensive access to training data, code, and architecture, facilitating research and innovation in language modeling.

2024-02.title: OpenCodeInterpreter: Integrating Code Generation with Execution and Refinement
2024-02.summary: OpenCodeInterpreter, an open-source system for generating, executing, and refining code, achieves high performance on benchmarks through execution and human feedback, reducing the gap with proprietary systems like GPT-4 Code Interpreter.

2024-02.title: FinTral: A Family of GPT-4 Level Multimodal Financial Large Language Models
2024-02.summary: FinTral, a multimodal LLM enhanced through domain-specific pretraining, instruction fine-tuning, and RLAIF, outperforms ChatGPT-3.5 and GPT-4 in financial analysis tasks with exceptional zero-shot performance.

2024-02.title: Linear Transformers with Learnable Kernel Functions are Better In-Context Models
2024-02.summary: A modification to the Based model kernel enhances its in-context learning capabilities, outperforming existing subquadratic architectures in language modeling tasks on the Pile dataset.

2024-02.title: Grandmaster-Level Chess Without Search
2024-02.summary: A large-scale transformer model trained on a vast dataset of chess games outperforms traditional chess engines and other state-of-the-art models without domain-specific tweaks.

2024-02.title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments
2024-02.summary: Genie, a 11B parameter unsupervised generative model, creates action-controllable virtual worlds from unlabelled videos using spatiotemporal tokenization and autoregressive dynamics, enabling agent training from unseen video behaviors.

2024-02.title: Training-Free Consistent Text-to-Image Generation
2024-02.summary: ConsiStory achieves state-of-the-art text-to-image subject consistency without fine-tuning by using shared internal activations, attention blocks, and feature injection.

2024-02.title: Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research
2024-02.summary: Dolma, a three trillion token English corpus, and its open-source data curation toolkit facilitate open research in language model pretraining by providing detailed insights into data curation practices.

2024-02.title: BASE TTS: Lessons from building a billion-parameter Text-to-Speech model on 100K hours of data
2024-02.summary: BASE TTS, a large-scale text-to-speech model, demonstrates advanced naturalness and emergent abilities using autoregressive Transformers and novel speech tokenization techniques.

2024-02.title: ChatMusician: Understanding and Generating Music Intrinsically with LLM
2024-02.summary: ChatMusician, an open-source LLM with intrinsic musical abilities, outperforms GPT-4 in music generation and understanding tasks using text-compatible music notation.

2024-02.title: More Agents Is All You Need
2024-02.summary: A sampling-and-voting method enhances large language models' performance by increasing the number of agents, with effectiveness tied to task difficulty.

2024-02.title: Generative Representational Instruction Tuning
2024-02.summary: GrIT allows large language models to excel at both generative and embedding tasks through task instruction, leading to new state-of-the-art performance without sacrificing efficiency.

2024-02.title: Synthetic Data (Almost) from Scratch: Generalized Instruction Tuning for Language Models
2024-02.summary: GLAN, a general method for instruction tuning of LLMs, uses a taxonomy of human knowledge to generate synthetic instruction data, achieving strong performance across diverse tasks without task-specific training data.

2024-02.title: Aya Dataset: An Open-Access Collection for Multilingual Instruction Tuning
2024-02.summary: The initiative builds a human-curated instruction-following dataset spanning 65 languages and creates the largest multilingual collection of instruction-following instances through templating and translating existing datasets across 114 languages, contributing datasets and platforms for participatory research.

2024-02.title: BiLLM: Pushing the Limit of Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
2024-02.summary: BiLLM, a 1-bit post-training quantization scheme for pretrained LLMs, achieves high-accuracy inference with reduced computational and memory requirements.

2024-02.title: YOLOv9: Learning What You Want to Learn Using Programmable Gradient Information
2024-02.summary: The paper addresses data loss in deep networks through programmable gradient information (PGI) and introduces the Generalized Efficient Layer Aggregation Network (GELAN) to improve parameter utilization and achieve competitive results in object detection.

2024-02.title: FiT: Flexible Vision Transformer for Diffusion Model
2024-02.summary: The Flexible Vision Transformer adapts to varied image resolutions and aspect ratios through dynamic tokenization and extrapolation techniques, outperforming traditional methods.

2024-02.title: Aya Model: An Instruction Finetuned Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
2024-02.summary: Aya, a multilingual generative language model supporting over 50% lower-resourced languages, excels in both generative and discriminative tasks across 99 languages, and provides extensive evaluations and open-source resources.

2024-02.title: Beyond A*: Better Planning with Transformers via Search Dynamics Bootstrapping
2024-02.summary: Searchformer, a Transformer model, outperforms traditional $A^*$ search by optimizing Sokoban puzzle solutions with fewer steps and demonstrates superior performance on maze navigation and more complex tasks.

2024-02.title: Specialized Language Models with Cheap Inference from Limited Domain Data
2024-02.summary: The study evaluates various machine learning approaches under constrained inference and training budgets, demonstrating that hyper-networks and mixture of experts perform well with large pretraining budgets, while small models trained on importance sampled datasets are better with large specialization budgets.

2024-02.title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
2024-02.summary: The RAPTOR model enhances retrieval-augmented language models by recursively embedding, clustering, and summarizing text chunks, leading to better performance on question-answering tasks involving complex reasoning.

2024-02.title: Nemotron-4 15B Technical Report
2024-02.summary: Nemotron-4 15B, a large multilingual language model, excels in English, multilingual, and coding tasks, demonstrating superior performance in multilingual capabilities compared to larger and specialized models.

2024-02.title: AnyGPT: Unified Multimodal LLM with Discrete Sequence Modeling
2024-02.summary: AnyGPT is a multimodal language model using discrete representations to process and generate content across various modalities with performance on par with specialized models.

2024-02.title: OS-Copilot: Towards Generalist Computer Agents with Self-Improvement
2024-02.summary: OS-Copilot framework enables FRIDAY, a self-improving generalist agent, to automate a wide range of computer tasks with enhanced generalization and minimal supervision.

2024-02.title: ScreenAI: A Vision-Language Model for UI and Infographics Understanding
2024-02.summary: ScreenAI, a vision-language model optimized with a flexible patching strategy, achieves state-of-the-art performance on UI and infographic tasks with 5B parameters.

2024-02.title: StepCoder: Improve Code Generation with Reinforcement Learning from Compiler Feedback
2024-02.summary: StepCoder, a reinforcement learning framework, enhances code generation by breaking tasks into subtasks and optimizing only executed code segments, using the APPS+ dataset for training.

2024-02.title: Speculative Streaming: Fast LLM Inference without Auxiliary Models
2024-02.summary: Speculative Streaming is a method that incorporates drafting into a target language model, enhancing decoding speed without quality loss while using fewer parameters.

2024-02.title: In Search of Needles in a 10M Haystack: Recurrent Memory Finds What LLMs Miss
2024-02.summary: Recursively augmented GPT-2 fine-tuning significantly extends the processing capability of generative models to handle long document sequences beyond $10^6$ elements.

2024-02.title: VideoPrism: A Foundational Visual Encoder for Video Understanding
2024-02.summary: VideoPrism, a pretrained video encoder, achieves top performance across various video understanding tasks by utilizing global-local distillation and token shuffling of semantic video embeddings enhanced with associated text.

2024-02.title: How to Train Data-Efficient LLMs
2024-02.summary: Data-efficient methods like Ask-LLM and Density sampling improve model quality and training efficiency in large language models by optimizing data selection and coverage.

2024-02.title: World Model on Million-Length Video And Language With RingAttention
2024-02.summary: Large-scale training of a transformer model for long video and language sequences using RingAttention and masked sequence packing improves performance on retrieval and long-form understanding tasks.

2024-02.title: FuseChat: Knowledge Fusion of Chat Models
2024-02.summary: FuseChat extends the FuseLLM framework for knowledge fusion of chat LLMs through lightweight fine-tuning and parameter merging, achieving superior performance across various domains.

2024-02.title: A Human-Inspired Reading Agent with Gist Memory of Very Long Contexts
2024-02.summary: ReadAgent, an LLM-based prompting system, enhances effective context length up to 20x through memory episodes and gist memories, outperforming baselines on long-document reading comprehension tasks.

2024-02.title: OpenMathInstruct-1: A 1.8 Million Math Instruction Tuning Dataset
2024-02.summary: A new math instruction tuning dataset, OpenMathInstruct-1, leverages the Mixtral model to achieve competitive performance on math reasoning benchmarks using open-source LLMs.

2024-02.title: MegaScale: Scaling Large Language Model Training to More Than 10,000 GPUs
2024-02.summary: MegaScale is a production system designed to train large language models at scale using more than 10,000 GPUs, focusing on efficiency, stability, and fault tolerance through advanced observability and diagnostic tools.

2024-02.title: Mixtures of Experts Unlock Parameter Scaling for Deep RL
2024-02.summary: Incorporating Soft MoE modules into value-based networks enhances scalability and performance across different training regimes and model sizes in reinforcement learning.

2024-02.title: WebLINX: Real-World Website Navigation with Multi-Turn Dialogue
2024-02.summary: A benchmark and retrieval-inspired model for efficient conversational web navigation by digital agents across diverse real-world websites is introduced, highlighting challenges in generalization to unseen sites.

2024-02.title: Direct Language Model Alignment from Online AI Feedback
2024-02.summary: Online AI feedback improves direct alignment from preferences methods by providing real-time feedback from a model, outperforming both offline DAP and RLHF methods.

2024-02.title: TravelPlanner: A Benchmark for Real-World Planning with Language Agents
2024-02.summary: TravelPlanner is a new benchmark for evaluating the planning capabilities of language agents in complex, real-world travel planning scenarios, demonstrating that current models still struggle with information gathering and constraint management.

2024-02.title: Infini-gram: Scaling Unbounded n-gram Language Models to a Trillion Tokens
2024-02.summary: Modernized n-gram models, specifically $\infty$-gram models, enhance text analysis and neural LLMs by providing high accuracy in next-token prediction and reducing language modeling perplexities.

2024-02.title: SPAR: Personalized Content-Based Recommendation via Long Engagement Attention
2024-02.summary: The SPAR framework enhances content recommendations by using pretrained language models, poly-attention layers, and large language models to effectively process long user engagement histories and predict user-item interactions.

2024-01.title: DocLLM: A layout-aware generative language model for multimodal document understanding
2024-01.summary: DocLLM extends large language models for visual document understanding by focusing on bounding box information and disentangled matrices for multimodal attention, achieving state-of-the-art performance on document intelligence tasks.

2024-01.title: Mixtral of Experts
2024-01.summary: Mixtral 8x7B, a Sparse Mixture of Experts language model, achieves superior performance across benchmarks by using a selective architecture that leverages fewer active parameters.

2024-01.title: Self-Rewarding Language Models
2024-01.summary: A study on Self-Rewarding Language Models shows that using LLM-as-a-Judge prompting for iterative DPO training enhances both instruction-following and self-reward generation, leading to superior performance compared to existing systems.

2024-01.title: TinyLlama: An Open-Source Small Language Model
2024-01.summary: TinyLlama, a compact 1.1B language model, leverages FlashAttention to achieve high performance in downstream tasks with enhanced computational efficiency.

2024-01.title: Improving Text Embeddings with Large Language Models
2024-01.summary: A method using synthetic data and contrastive loss achieves high-quality text embeddings without labeled data, and sets state-of-the-art results when combined with labeled data.

2024-01.title: Lumiere: A Space-Time Diffusion Model for Video Generation
2024-01.summary: A text-to-video diffusion model using Space-Time U-Net architecture generates realistic, diverse, and coherent videos through a single pass, achieving state-of-the-art results and supporting various content creation and editing tasks.

2024-01.title: Scaling Up to Excellence: Practicing Model Scaling for Photo-Realistic Image Restoration In the Wild
2024-01.summary: SUPIR, an advanced image restoration method combining generative prior and model scaling, achieves high-quality results and flexible restoration guided by textual prompts.

2024-01.title: DeepSeek-Coder: When the Large Language Model Meets Programming -- The Rise of Code Intelligence
2024-01.summary: DeepSeek-Coder, a series of open-source code models trained from scratch, outperforms both open-source and closed-source models across multiple benchmarks.

2024-01.title: MoE-Mamba: Efficient Selective State Space Models with Mixture of Experts
2024-01.summary: A combination of Mixture of Experts (MoE) with State Space Models (SSMs) improves model efficiency and performance compared to both standalone SSMs and MoE-enhanced Transformers.

2024-01.title: SliceGPT: Compress Large Language Models by Deleting Rows and Columns
2024-01.summary: SliceGPT, a novel post-training sparsification method, reduces model parameters by up to 25% without significant performance decrease, optimizing inference speed and GPU usage on large language models.

2024-01.title: TrustLLM: Trustworthiness in Large Language Models
2024-01.summary: This study assesses the trustworthiness of large language models across various dimensions, including truthfulness, safety, fairness, robustness, privacy, and machine ethics, finding a positive correlation with utility and highlighting differences between proprietary and open-source models.

2024-01.title: Diffuse to Choose: Enriching Image Conditioned Inpainting in Latent Diffusion Models for Virtual Try-All
2024-01.summary: Diffuse to Choose is a diffusion-based inpainting model that balances real-time performance with high-fidelity detail preservation and semantic accuracy.

2024-01.title: Self-Play Fine-Tuning Converts Weak Language Models to Strong Language Models
2024-01.summary: A novel self-play fine-tuning method (SPIN) enhances Large Language Models by generating its own training data and refining its policy, achieving performance on par with models trained using direct preference optimization and additional human data.

2024-01.title: DeepSeekMoE: Towards Ultimate Expert Specialization in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
2024-01.summary: The DeepSeekMoE architecture improves expert specialization in Mixture-of-Experts models by segmenting experts and isolating shared ones, achieving better performance and computational efficiency compared to GShard and other models.

2024-01.title: Understanding LLMs: A Comprehensive Overview from Training to Inference
2024-01.summary: The paper reviews techniques for cost-efficient training and deployment of large language models, covering aspects like data preprocessing, parallel training, model fine-tuning, and inference optimizations including model compression and memory scheduling.

2024-01.title: Depth Anything: Unleashing the Power of Large-Scale Unlabeled Data
2024-01.summary: Depth Anything is a robust monocular depth estimation model built on a large-scale dataset with data augmentation and auxiliary supervision strategies, achieving state-of-the-art results on various datasets and enhancing depth-conditioned ControlNet.

2024-01.title: Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model
2024-01.summary: A new vision backbone using bidirectional Mamba blocks (Vim) outperforms established vision transformers like DeiT in terms of performance and efficiency on high-resolution image tasks.

2024-01.title: Medusa: Simple LLM Inference Acceleration Framework with Multiple Decoding Heads
2024-01.summary: Medusa enhances Large Language Model inference by adding parallel decoding heads and using tree-based attention to predict multiple tokens simultaneously, achieving significant speedup with minimal latency.

2024-01.title: MambaByte: Token-free Selective State Space Model
2024-01.summary: MambaByte, a token-free byte-level autoregressive model, demonstrates computational efficiency and competitive performance compared to subword token-based models, with the added benefit of fast inference due to linear length scaling.

2024-01.title: InstantID: Zero-shot Identity-Preserving Generation in Seconds
2024-01.summary: InstantID is a diffusion model-based solution for personalized image synthesis that uses a single facial image and integrates with pre-trained models while maintaining high face fidelity and efficiency.

2024-01.title: DeepSeek LLM: Scaling Open-Source Language Models with Longtermism
2024-01.summary: DeepSeek LLM, an open-source language model project, develops a large dataset and employs SFT and DPO to achieve performance surpassing LLaMA-2 70B and GPT-3.5 in various benchmarks and open-ended evaluations.

2024-01.title: InternLM-XComposer2: Mastering Free-form Text-Image Composition and Comprehension in Vision-Language Large Model
2024-01.summary: InternLM-XComposer2, a vision-language model, excels in free-form text-image creation and understanding using Partial LoRA, surpassing existing models and matching GPT-4V and Gemini Pro in multimodal benchmarks.

2024-01.title: MoE-LLaVA: Mixture of Experts for Large Vision-Language Models
2024-01.summary: MoE-LLaVA, a sparse Large Vision-Language Model architecture, improves performance and reduces hallucinations with fewer active parameters compared to larger models.

2024-01.title: Rephrasing the Web: A Recipe for Compute and Data-Efficient Language Modeling
2024-01.summary: Web Rephrase Augmented Pre-training (WRAP) improves large language model pre-training efficiency and performance by incorporating synthetic rephrases styled like Wikipedia or question-answer format into the training dataset.

2024-01.title: LLaMA Beyond English: An Empirical Study on Language Capability Transfer
2024-01.summary: A comprehensive study on transferring English-dominant LLMs to non-English languages using LLaMA demonstrates that comparable performance can be achieved with minimal pretraining data across various language capabilities and response quality metrics.

2024-01.title: LLaMA Pro: Progressive LLaMA with Block Expansion
2024-01.summary: A new post-pretraining method using expanded Transformer blocks for Large Language Models improves knowledge without catastrophic forgetting, yielding LLaMA Pro-8.3B that excels in general tasks, programming, and mathematics.

2024-01.title: Blending Is All You Need: Cheaper, Better Alternative to Trillion-Parameters LLM
2024-01.summary: A combination of smaller chat AI models, through a method called blending, can achieve performance comparable to or better than large single models with lower computational resources.

2024-01.title: PALP: Prompt Aligned Personalization of Text-to-Image Models
2024-01.summary: Prompt-aligned personalization improves text alignment and enhances personalized image creation with complex prompts by using score distillation sampling.

2024-01.title: MagicVideo-V2: Multi-Stage High-Aesthetic Video Generation
2024-01.summary: MagicVideo-V2 generates high-fidelity and smooth videos from text using an integrated pipeline that includes text-to-image, video motion generation, and frame interpolation modules, outperforming existing systems in user evaluations.

2024-01.title: MM-LLMs: Recent Advances in MultiModal Large Language Models
2024-01.summary: A survey examining the design, performance, and future directions of MultiModal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) to enhance reasoning and MM task capabilities.

2024-01.title: PIXART-δ: Fast and Controllable Image Generation with Latent Consistency Models
2024-01.summary: PIXART-{\delta} integrates Latent Consistency Model (LCM) and ControlNet into PIXART-{\alpha} for accelerated, high-quality text-to-image synthesis with efficient training and inference.

2024-01.title: Weaver: Foundation Models for Creative Writing
2024-01.summary: Weaver, a family of specialized large language models, achieves superior writing capabilities through pre-training and fine-tuning methods, surpasses GPT-4 in various writing tasks, and supports retrieval-augmented generation and tool usage.

2024-01.title: Spotting LLMs With Binoculars: Zero-Shot Detection of Machine-Generated Text
2024-01.summary: A novel LLM detector using contrasting scores from two pre-trained models achieves high accuracy in identifying machine-generated text without any training data.

2024-01.title: YOLO-World: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
2024-01.summary: YOLO-World enhances YOLO with open-vocabulary detection using vision-language modeling and a re-parameterizable network, achieving high accuracy and speed.

2024-01.title: Masked Audio Generation using a Single Non-Autoregressive Transformer
2024-01.summary: MAGNeT is a single-stage, non-autoregressive transformer for audio generation that uses masked spans during training, a rescoring method, and a hybrid approach to achieve fast generation.

2024-01.title: Motion-I2V: Consistent and Controllable Image-to-Video Generation with Explicit Motion Modeling
2024-01.summary: Motion-I2V, a diffusion-based framework for image-to-video generation, achieves consistency and controllability through explicit motion modeling and trajectory prediction.

2024-01.title: VMamba: Visual State Space Model
2024-01.summary: VMamba, a novel state space model architecture, combines global receptive fields and dynamic weights from ViTs with linear complexity, outperforming established models as image resolution increases.

2024-01.title: Transformers are Multi-State RNNs
2024-01.summary: Decoder-only transformers can be conceptualized as finite multi-state RNNs, and a new cache compression technique, TOVA, significantly reduces their computational cost while maintaining high performance.

2024-01.title: LLM Augmented LLMs: Expanding Capabilities through Composition
2024-01.summary: CALM, a composition method for large language models, enhances capabilities by integrating cross-attention with specialized models, demonstrating improvements on translation and coding tasks.

2024-01.title: Contrastive Preference Optimization: Pushing the Boundaries of LLM Performance in Machine Translation
2024-01.summary: Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO) enhances moderate-sized LLMs in machine translation, enabling them to match or exceed state-of-the-art model performance.

2024-01.title: Scalable Pre-training of Large Autoregressive Image Models
2024-01.summary: Autoregressive pre-training for vision models (AIM) scales similarly to LLMs, showing improved performance with more data and parameters, and does not exhibit performance saturation.

2024-01.title: From GPT-4 to Gemini and Beyond: Assessing the Landscape of MLLMs on Generalizability, Trustworthiness and Causality through Four Modalities
2024-01.summary: A qualitative study evaluates the generalizability, trustworthiness, and causal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs across text, code, image, and video modalities to understand their reliability for downstream applications.

2024-01.title: Large Language Models are Superpositions of All Characters: Attaining Arbitrary Role-play via Self-Alignment
2024-01.summary: Ditto, a self-alignment method, enhances the role-playing capabilities of open-source large language models by fine-tuning them on a large generated dataset, achieving performance comparable to proprietary chatbots.

2024-01.title: DocGraphLM: Documental Graph Language Model for Information Extraction
2024-01.summary: A new framework, DocGraphLM, combines pre-trained language models with graph semantics to improve information extraction and question answering on documents with complex layouts.

2024-01.title: ChatQA: Building GPT-4 Level Conversational QA Models
2024-01.summary: ChatQA uses a two-stage instruction tuning method with a dense retriever to improve zero-shot conversational QA performance, outperforming GPT-4 on multiple datasets.

2024-01.title: LARP: Language-Agent Role Play for Open-World Games
2024-01.summary: LARP is a language agent framework for open-world games, incorporating memory and decision-making capabilities to enhance interaction and coherence in a diverse range of applications.

2024-01.title: Meta-Prompting: Enhancing Language Models with Task-Agnostic Scaffolding
2024-01.summary: Meta-prompting enhances language model performance by organizing and integrating multiple expert instances to handle complex tasks, demonstrating superiority over traditional methods in zero-shot settings.

2024-01.title: BlockFusion: Expandable 3D Scene Generation using Latent Tri-plane Extrapolation
2024-01.summary: BlockFusion, a diffusion-based model, generates and expands 3D scenes using latent tri-plane representations and a 2D layout conditioning mechanism.

2024-01.title: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models
2024-01.summary: WebVoyager, a Large Multimodal Model, enhances web agent performance by handling multiple modalities and real-world web interactions, achieving high success rates in practical tasks.

2024-01.title: Small Language Model Meets with Reinforced Vision Vocabulary
2024-01.summary: Vary-toy, a smaller version of Vary using Qwen-1.8B, enhances vision vocabulary through object detection and achieves competitive performance on visual question answering tasks.

2023-12.title: LLM in a flash: Efficient Large Language Model Inference with Limited Memory
2023-12.summary: Efficient inference for large language models on devices with limited DRAM by optimizing data transfer and access from flash memory.

2023-12.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
2023-12.summary: Mamba, a novel SSM-based model, outperforms Transformers in inference speed and scalability across various modalities by selectively propagating information and using efficient hardware-aware algorithms.

2023-12.title: Magicoder: Source Code Is All You Need
2023-12.summary: Magicoder, using OSS-Instruct to incorporate open-source code snippets, achieves superior performance on coding benchmarks while reducing bias in synthetic data generation.

2023-12.title: StreamDiffusion: A Pipeline-level Solution for Real-time Interactive Generation
2023-12.summary: StreamDiffusion, a real-time diffusion pipeline, enhances interactive image generation by implementing batching denoising, residual classifier-free guidance, and stochastic similarity filtering, which boost throughput and reduce energy consumption.

2023-12.title: PhotoMaker: Customizing Realistic Human Photos via Stacked ID Embedding
2023-12.summary: PhotoMaker is an efficient personalized text-to-image generation method that encodes ID images into a unified embedding, achieving high ID fidelity, speed improvements, and generalization capabilities with an ID-oriented data pipeline.

2023-12.title: SOLAR 10.7B: Scaling Large Language Models with Simple yet Effective Depth Up-Scaling
2023-12.summary: A novel technique, depth up-scaling (DUS), efficiently enhances large language models (LLMs) without complex changes, building SOLAR 10.7B that outperforms existing open-source models in various NLP tasks, including instruction-following.

2023-12.title: LLM360: Towards Fully Transparent Open-Source LLMs
2023-12.summary: LLM360 initiative promotes full transparency and reproducibility in LLM training by open-sourcing training code, data, model checkpoints, and intermediate results.

2023-12.title: Amphion: An Open-Source Audio, Music and Speech Generation Toolkit
2023-12.summary: Amphion is a toolkit for audio, music, and speech generation that includes model visualizations, vocoders, and evaluation metrics to support reproducible research and training for researchers.

2023-12.title: AppAgent: Multimodal Agents as Smartphone Users
2023-12.summary: A novel LLM-based multimodal agent learns to operate smartphone apps through autonomous exploration or imitation, demonstrating proficiency across diverse tasks.

2023-12.title: WaveCoder: Widespread And Versatile Enhanced Instruction Tuning with Refined Data Generation
2023-12.summary: A Generator-Discriminator framework using LLMs generates high-quality instruction data, enhancing the fine-tuning of code-related tasks and model generalization.

2023-12.title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
2023-12.summary: Gemini, a family of multimodal models, achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks, including human-expert performance on MMLU, through advanced cross-modal reasoning and language understanding.

2023-12.title: VideoPoet: A Large Language Model for Zero-Shot Video Generation
2023-12.summary: VideoPoet is a language model that synthesizes high-quality video and audio from diverse inputs using a transformer architecture, showcasing superior zero-shot video generation capabilities.

2023-12.title: PowerInfer: Fast Large Language Model Serving with a Consumer-grade GPU
2023-12.summary: PowerInfer, a high-speed LLM inference engine for personal computers, enhances efficiency using hotspot neuron analysis, GPU-CPU hybrid computation, adaptive predictors, and neuron-aware sparse operators, achieving performance close to server-grade GPUs.

2023-12.title: StemGen: A music generation model that listens
2023-12.summary: A transformer-based, non-autoregressive model generates musically coherent audio by responding to context, achieving audio quality comparable to text-conditioned models.

2023-12.title: Kandinsky 3.0 Technical Report
2023-12.summary: Kandinsky 3.0, a large-scale text-to-image model based on latent diffusion, improves quality and realism through a larger architecture and advanced text understanding.

2023-12.title: ReST meets ReAct: Self-Improvement for Multi-Step Reasoning LLM Agent
2023-12.summary: A ReAct-style LLM agent with iterative training using reinforcement learning and self-distillation improves complex question-answering performance with fewer parameters.

2023-12.title: SwitchHead: Accelerating Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts Attention
2023-12.summary: SwitchHead reduces memory and compute for Transformers by using Mixture-of-Experts layers, matching performance with significant speedup.

2023-12.title: TinyGSM: achieving >80% on GSM8k with small language models
2023-12.summary: A synthetic dataset of math problems paired with solutions enables small language models to achieve high accuracy in mathematical reasoning, outperforming larger models.

2023-12.title: SparQ Attention: Bandwidth-Efficient LLM Inference
2023-12.summary: SparQ Attention reduces memory bandwidth requirements in LLM attention blocks, enhancing inference throughput without accuracy loss.

2023-12.title: StarVector: Generating Scalable Vector Graphics Code from Images
2023-12.summary: StarVector integrates CodeLLMs and vision models to generate complex SVGs by aligning visual and code tokens, enhancing visual quality and complexity handling.

2023-12.title: VMC: Video Motion Customization using Temporal Attention Adaption for Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
2023-12.summary: The VMC framework enhances video generation by tuning temporal attention layers in diffusion models to accurately reproduce and diversify motion with a motion distillation objective.

2023-12.title: DreaMoving: A Human Dance Video Generation Framework based on Diffusion Models
2023-12.summary: DreaMoving is a diffusion-based framework that generates high-quality, customized human dance videos by controlling motion and preserving identity.

2023-12.title: Principled Instructions Are All You Need for Questioning LLaMA-1/2, GPT-3.5/4
2023-12.summary: Guiding principles streamline querying and prompting of large language models, enhancing understanding and effectiveness across different scales.

2023-12.title: Generative Multimodal Models are In-Context Learners
2023-12.summary: A large-scale generative multimodal model with 37 billion parameters demonstrates strong few-shot in-context learning and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multimodal tasks through scaling-up and instruction tuning.

2023-12.title: Schrodinger Bridges Beat Diffusion Models on Text-to-Speech Synthesis
2023-12.summary: Bridge-TTS introduces a novel text-to-speech system using a clean deterministic prior in diffusion models, significantly improving synthesis quality and sampling efficiency over existing methods.

2023-12.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization: Eliciting Strong Capabilities With Weak Supervision
2023-12.summary: Naive finetuning of strong pretrained models with weak supervision can improve performance but is insufficient to match full model capabilities, highlighting challenges for aligning superhuman models.

2023-12.title: Chain of Code: Reasoning with a Language Model-Augmented Code Emulator
2023-12.summary: Chain of Code (CoC) enhances language models' reasoning capabilities by using pseudocode and selective code emulation, enabling them to tackle complex semantic and logical tasks more effectively.

2023-12.title: Alpha-CLIP: A CLIP Model Focusing on Wherever You Want
2023-12.summary: Alpha-CLIP enhances CLIP by adding an auxiliary alpha channel for attentive region suggestion, enabling precise control over image content across various tasks like open-world recognition and multimodal generation.

2023-12.title: ImageDream: Image-Prompt Multi-view Diffusion for 3D Generation
2023-12.summary: ImageDream is a multi-view diffusion model for 3D object generation that uses image prompts to produce high-quality 3D models with improved visual geometry accuracy.

2023-12.title: CogAgent: A Visual Language Model for GUI Agents
2023-12.summary: CogAgent, a visual language model with strong GUI understanding and navigation capabilities, outperforms LLM-based methods in both PC and Android GUI tasks using only screenshots.

2023-12.title: Analyzing and Improving the Training Dynamics of Diffusion Models
2023-12.summary: Modifications to network layers in the ADM diffusion model architecture improve training stability and synthesis quality, reducing FID from 2.41 to 1.81, and a novel method for post-hoc EMA parameter tuning is introduced.

2023-12.title: Unified-IO 2: Scaling Autoregressive Multimodal Models with Vision, Language, Audio, and Action
2023-12.summary: A unified autoregressive multimodal model handles image, text, audio, and action by tokenizing inputs into a shared space and processing them with a transformer architecture, achieving state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks.

2023-12.title: TinyGPT-V: Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model via Small Backbones
2023-12.summary: TinyGPT-V, built on Phi-2 with vision modules from BLIP-2 or CLIP, offers high performance with low computational requirements, enabling efficient multimodal large language modeling.

2023-12.title: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars
2023-12.summary: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars model high-fidelity head avatars with real-time relighting capabilities using 3D Gaussians for geometry and learnable radiance transfer for appearance.

2023-12.title: FaceStudio: Put Your Face Everywhere in Seconds
2023-12.summary: A hybrid guidance framework for identity-preserving image synthesis efficiently generates stylistic portraits by combining stylized images, facial images, and textual prompts.

2023-12.title: The Unlocking Spell on Base LLMs: Rethinking Alignment via In-Context Learning
2023-12.summary: A study explores the effectiveness of alignment tuning in large language models, suggesting that superficial methods like in-context learning can achieve strong performance without traditional supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning.

2023-12.title: Generative AI for Math: Part I -- MathPile: A Billion-Token-Scale Pretraining Corpus for Math
2023-12.summary: A new large-scale, high-quality math-centric corpus named MathPile has been introduced to enhance mathematical reasoning abilities of language models.

2023-12.title: DREAM-Talk: Diffusion-based Realistic Emotional Audio-driven Method for Single Image Talking Face Generation
2023-12.summary: DREAM-Talk is a two-stage diffusion-based framework generating expressive emotional talking faces with accurate lip-sync from single portrait images.

2023-12.title: Beyond Human Data: Scaling Self-Training for Problem-Solving with Language Models
2023-12.summary: Self-training with scalar feedback using expectation-maximization improves language model performance on tasks with verifiable answers, reducing reliance on human data.

2023-12.title: Make-A-Character: High Quality Text-to-3D Character Generation within Minutes
2023-12.summary: The Make-A-Character (Mach) framework uses large language and vision models to create realistic, 3D avatars from text descriptions efficiently, enabling customization and seamless integration with existing CG pipelines.

2023-12.title: Zero-Shot Metric Depth with a Field-of-View Conditioned Diffusion Model
2023-12.summary: A generic diffusion model with log-scale depth parameterization and FOV conditioning achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot metric depth estimation by handling indoor and outdoor scenes effectively and reducing relative error significantly.

2023-12.title: Fairy: Fast Parallelized Instruction-Guided Video-to-Video Synthesis
2023-12.summary: Fairy, an adaptation of image-editing diffusion models for video editing, uses anchor-based cross-frame attention to enhance temporal coherence and efficiency, outperforming existing methods.

2023-12.title: Distributed Inference and Fine-tuning of Large Language Models Over The Internet
2023-12.summary: A decentralized system pools idle compute resources to enable efficient inference and fine-tuning of large language models over a consumer-grade network, showcasing significant performance improvements.

2023-12.title: FreeInit: Bridging Initialization Gap in Video Diffusion Models
2023-12.summary: FreeInit addresses the temporal consistency and unnatural dynamics issues in diffusion-based video generation by refining spatial-temporal low-frequency components during inference, improving subject appearance and consistency.

2023-12.title: Gaussian Head Avatar: Ultra High-fidelity Head Avatar via Dynamic Gaussians
2023-12.summary: The method uses controllable 3D Gaussians and a fully learned MLP-based deformation field for high-fidelity 3D head avatar modeling under sparse views, employing geometry-guided initialization with implicit SDF and Deep Marching Tetrahedra for stability and high rendering quality.

2023-12.title: DreamTuner: Single Image is Enough for Subject-Driven Generation
2023-12.summary: DreamTurner uses a novel approach by injecting reference information through subject encoders and self-subject-attention layers to enhance subject-driven image generation, balancing subject learning and model capabilities.

2023-12.title: DreamTalk: When Expressive Talking Head Generation Meets Diffusion Probabilistic Models
2023-12.summary: DreamTalk enables expressive talking head generation using diffusion models with specialized components for denoising, lip-sync, and style prediction.

2023-12.title: X-Adapter: Adding Universal Compatibility of Plugins for Upgraded Diffusion Model
2023-12.summary: X-Adapter upgrades text-to-image diffusion models like SDXL to work with existing plugins without retraining, through feature remapping and a null-text training strategy.

2023-12.title: Merlin:Empowering Multimodal LLMs with Foresight Minds
2023-12.summary: A novel MLLM, Merlin, is introduced which incorporates future modeling through FPT and FIT, enhancing foresight and future reasoning capabilities.

2023-12.title: MobileSAMv2: Faster Segment Anything to Everything
2023-12.summary: A new approach improves MobileSAM's efficiency for the SegEvery task by directly generating valid masks, boosting performance and reducing computation time.

2023-11.title: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants
2023-11.summary: GAIA benchmarks general AI assistants using real-world questions that challenge both reasoning and multi-modality handling, showcasing a significant gap between human and AI performance.

2023-11.title: Exponentially Faster Language Modelling
2023-11.summary: FastBERT achieves significant inference speedup over BERT by selectively engaging a small fraction of neurons using fast feedforward networks.

2023-11.title: Florence-2: Advancing a Unified Representation for a Variety of Vision Tasks
2023-11.summary: A new prompt-based vision foundation model, Florence-2, is introduced for diverse vision and vision-language tasks, achieving strong zero-shot and fine-tuning capabilities with comprehensive annotations.

2023-11.title: LCM-LoRA: A Universal Stable-Diffusion Acceleration Module
2023-11.summary: LCMs enhance text-to-image generation by distilling from LDMs using LoRA for reduced memory and superior quality, and introduce LCM-LoRA as a plug-in accelerator for various tasks.

2023-11.title: Orca 2: Teaching Small Language Models How to Reason
2023-11.summary: Orca 2 enhances smaller language models' reasoning abilities by teaching them diverse solution strategies, outperforming larger models on complex reasoning tasks.

2023-11.title: Make Pixels Dance: High-Dynamic Video Generation
2023-11.summary: PixelDance, a diffusion model-based approach, generates high-dynamic videos by incorporating image instructions for first and last frames alongside text instructions, surpassing current text-to-video methods in complexity and motion.

2023-11.title: The Chosen One: Consistent Characters in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
2023-11.summary: A new automated method generates consistent characters from text prompts by iteratively refining a set of similar images.

2023-11.title: Distil-Whisper: Robust Knowledge Distillation via Large-Scale Pseudo Labelling
2023-11.summary: Distil-Whisper, a smaller and faster variant of the Whisper model, achieves nearly the same performance with fewer resources and is optimized for low-latency environments.

2023-11.title: FusionFrames: Efficient Architectural Aspects for Text-to-Video Generation Pipeline
2023-11.summary: A new two-stage latent diffusion model generates videos from text, achieving high quality and efficiency in keyframe synthesis and interpolation.

2023-11.title: LucidDreamer: Domain-free Generation of 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
2023-11.summary: LucidDreamer generates domain-free 3D scenes using diffusion-based generative models and Gaussian splats, producing highly detailed results.
