2023-09.summary: Agents is an open-source library that facilitates the creation, customization, and deployment of autonomous language agents with features like planning, memory, and tool usage, aiming to make advances in large language models accessible to a broader audience.

2023-09.title: Multimodal Foundation Models: From Specialists to General-Purpose Assistants
2023-09.summary: The survey covers the development and advancements in multimodal foundation models that integrate vision and language, transitioning from specialized models to versatile assistants through various training methods and unified architectures.

2023-09.title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
2023-09.summary: The Chain-of-Verification method reduces hallucinations in language models by having them draft, plan verification questions, answer independently, and then generate a final verified response.

2023-09.title: Contrastive Decoding Improves Reasoning in Large Language Models
2023-09.summary: Contrastive Decoding, a simple and training-free text generation method, outperforms other decoding techniques on various reasoning tasks and logical benchmarks by improving perceived quality and reducing reasoning errors.

2023-09.title: Qwen Technical Report
2023-09.summary: Qwen, a series of large language models, including chat and specialized coding and mathematics variants, exhibit superior performance across various tasks and outperform open-source models.

2023-09.title: Exploring Large Language Models' Cognitive Moral Development through Defining Issues Test
2023-09.summary: A new evaluation framework connects human psychology and AI to assess the moral reasoning and development stages of large language models using a Psychometric Assessment Tool.

2023-09.title: DoLa: Decoding by Contrasting Layers Improves Factuality in Large Language Models
2023-09.summary: A decoding strategy that contrasts logits from different transformer layers reduces hallucinations in large language models without external knowledge or fine-tuning.

2023-09.title: VideoDirectorGPT: Consistent Multi-scene Video Generation via LLM-Guided Planning
2023-09.summary: VideoDirectorGPT combines LLMs for video content planning with a layout-controlled video generator, enabling temporally consistent multi-scene video generation from text prompts.

2023-09.title: InstaFlow: One Step is Enough for High-Quality Diffusion-Based Text-to-Image Generation
2023-09.summary: Rectified Flow is used to develop an ultra-fast one-step text-to-image generator named InstaFlow, achieving high image quality with significantly reduced inference time compared to existing methods.

2023-09.title: One Wide Feedforward is All You Need
2023-09.summary: The study shows that the Feed Forward Network in Transformers is highly redundant and its reduction or sharing within the model can lead to improved accuracy and latency without significant loss of performance.

2023-09.title: Emu: Enhancing Image Generation Models Using Photogenic Needles in a Haystack
2023-09.summary: Quality-tuning enhances the aesthetic appeal of text-to-image models through supervised fine-tuning with a small set of high-quality images.

2023-09.title: RMT: Retentive Networks Meet Vision Transformers
2023-09.summary: The proposed RMT model, combining RetNet and Transformer architectures, introduces explicit spatial distance priors and coordinate-wise decomposition to achieve exceptional performance in computer vision tasks.

2023-09.title: A Paradigm Shift in Machine Translation: Boosting Translation Performance of Large Language Models
2023-09.summary: A novel fine-tuning approach for moderate-sized language models significantly improves translation performance with less parallel data compared to traditional methods.

2023-09.title: Text-to-3D using Gaussian Splatting
2023-09.summary: Gaussian Splatting based text-to-3D generation improves geometry accuracy and fidelity through progressive optimization, including geometry optimization and appearance refinement.

2023-09.title: Aligning Large Multimodal Models with Factually Augmented RLHF
2023-09.summary: The paper presents Factually Augmented RLHF to address multimodal misalignment in large multimodal models, significantly improving hallucination reduction and overall performance on vision-language tasks compared to existing methods.

2023-09.title: From Sparse to Dense: GPT-4 Summarization with Chain of Density Prompting
2023-09.summary: CoD prompt in GPT-4 improves summary density, informativeness, and human preference over vanilla prompts, with tradeoffs between readability and detail.

2023-09.title: SLiMe: Segment Like Me
2023-09.summary: SLiMe segments images at desired granularity using Stable Diffusion with minimal annotations and outperforms existing one-shot and few-shot segmentation methods.

2023-09.title: Effective Long-Context Scaling of Foundation Models
2023-09.summary: Long-context LLMs achieve significant advancements in handling extended contexts through continual pretraining and efficient instruction tuning, surpassing existing models on various benchmarks.

2023-09.title: Tracking Anything with Decoupled Video Segmentation
2023-09.summary: DEVA, a decoupled approach using image-level segmentation and bi-directional temporal propagation, achieves favorable results in various data-scarce video segmentation tasks with reduced annotation and training costs.

2023-09.title: AudioSR: Versatile Audio Super-resolution at Scale
2023-09.summary: A diffusion-based generative model, AudioSR, achieves robust audio super-resolution across various audio types and bandwidths, enhancing generation quality for different audio models.

2023-09.title: MagiCapture: High-Resolution Multi-Concept Portrait Customization
2023-09.summary: MagiCapture personalizes text-to-image models by integrating subject and style concepts using limited references and an Attention Refocusing loss, enhancing realism and quality in portrait image generation.

2023-09.title: Clinical Text Summarization: Adapting Large Language Models Can Outperform Human Experts
2023-09.summary: Domain-adapted large language models outperform human experts in various clinical text summarization tasks, improving completeness, correctness, and aligning with physician preferences.

2023-09.title: ProPainter: Improving Propagation and Transformer for Video Inpainting
2023-09.summary: ProPainter is a framework that improves video inpainting by combining dual-domain propagation and a mask-guided sparse video Transformer, outperforming existing methods in PSNR while maintaining efficiency.

2023-08.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
2023-08.summary: A method using 3D Gaussians for scene representation and optimized rendering allows high-quality, real-time novel-view synthesis at 1080p resolution.

2023-08.title: DeepSpeed-Chat: Easy, Fast and Affordable RLHF Training of ChatGPT-like Models at All Scales
2023-08.summary: DeepSpeed-Chat introduces an efficient and accessible RLHF training pipeline for large-scale ChatGPT-like models, enabling rapid and cost-effective training.

2023-08.title: Nougat: Neural Optical Understanding for Academic Documents
2023-08.summary: Nougat, a Visual Transformer model, performs OCR on scientific documents converting them to markup language, enhancing digital accessibility.

2023-08.title: Self-Alignment with Instruction Backtranslation
2023-08.summary: A scalable instruction-following language model is built using auto-labelling and iterative self-augmentation and self-curation, outperforming other LLaMa-based models on Alpaca.

2023-08.title: LM-Infinite: Simple On-the-Fly Length Generalization for Large Language Models
2023-08.summary: LM-Infinite addresses length generalization in Transformer-based LLMs using a simple $\Lambda$-shaped attention mask, achieving fluency and quality up to 32k tokens without retraining.

2023-08.title: LP-MusicCaps: LLM-Based Pseudo Music Captioning
2023-08.summary: A large-scale pseudo music caption dataset generated using LLMs improves music captioning performance over supervised models in zero-shot and transfer-learning settings.

2023-08.title: IP-Adapter: Text Compatible Image Prompt Adapter for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
2023-08.summary: IP-Adapter introduces a lightweight decoupled cross-attention mechanism to enhance pretrained text-to-image diffusion models with image prompt capabilities, enabling multimodal image generation and compatibility with existing tools.

2023-08.title: Tool Documentation Enables Zero-Shot Tool-Usage with Large Language Models
2023-08.summary: LLMs can effectively use tool documentation instead of demonstrations to perform complex tasks, achieving performance comparable or superior to few-shot learning on both vision and language benchmarks.

2023-08.title: Learning to Model the World with Language
2023-08.summary: Dynalang, a multimodal agent, learns to predict future text and image representations using language hints to improve task performance and enrich its understanding.

2023-08.title: AudioLDM 2: Learning Holistic Audio Generation with Self-supervised Pretraining
2023-08.summary: A unified audio generation framework using a language of audio representation, AudioMAE, and latent diffusion model achieves state-of-the-art performance across different audio types.

2023-08.title: LLaSM: Large Language and Speech Model
2023-08.summary: LLaSM, an end-to-end trained large multi-modal speech-language model, enhances human interaction with AI by following speech-and-language instructions using cross-modal conversational abilities.

2023-08.title: OpenFlamingo: An Open-Source Framework for Training Large Autoregressive Vision-Language Models
2023-08.summary: OpenFlamingo, an open-source family of autoregressive vision-language models, replicates DeepMind's Flamingo performance across multiple datasets.

2023-08.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
2023-08.summary: Vision-language-action models, trained on large-scale vision and language data, are integrated into robotic control to enhance generalization and semantic reasoning.

2023-08.title: TeCH: Text-guided Reconstruction of Lifelike Clothed Humans
2023-08.summary: TeCH reconstructs high-fidelity 3D human models from single images using descriptive text prompts, a personalized Text-to-Image diffusion model, and a hybrid DMTet representation, outperforming existing methods.

2023-08.title: OctoPack: Instruction Tuning Code Large Language Models
2023-08.summary: Instruction tuning using Git commits improves performance on natural language and coding tasks compared to other benchmarks, with models achieving state-of-the-art results on expanded HumanEvalPack.

2023-08.title: JEN-1: Text-Guided Universal Music Generation with Omnidirectional Diffusion Models
2023-08.summary: JEN-1, a diffusion model combining autoregressive and non-autoregressive training, achieves superior performance in text-to-music generation, music inpainting, and continuation, while maintaining computational efficiency.

2023-08.title: Shepherd: A Critic for Language Model Generation
2023-08.summary: Shepherd, a small language model tuned for critique, outperforms or ties with larger models like ChatGPT in refining language model outputs using a high-quality feedback dataset.

2023-08.title: PIPPA: A Partially Synthetic Conversational Dataset
2023-08.summary: PIPPA, a community-driven partially-synthetic dataset, provides over a million utterances across numerous conversation sessions to enhance role-play and conversational AI research and development.

2023-08.title: MedAlign: A Clinician-Generated Dataset for Instruction Following with Electronic Medical Records
2023-08.summary: MedAlign, a curated dataset of natural language instructions for EHR data, evaluates the accuracy and quality of general domain LLMs in healthcare, revealing high error rates and context length dependencies.

2023-08.title: Jais and Jais-chat: Arabic-Centric Foundation and Instruction-Tuned Open Generative Large Language Models
2023-08.summary: Jais and Jais-chat, Arabic-centric LLMs based on the GPT-3 architecture, outperform existing models in Arabic and are competitive in English with fewer resources.

2023-08.title: CoDeF: Content Deformation Fields for Temporally Consistent Video Processing
2023-08.summary: CoDeF represents videos using a canonical content field and a temporal deformation field, enabling the lifting of image processing algorithms to video processing with superior cross-frame consistency.

2023-08.title: Trustworthy LLMs: a Survey and Guideline for Evaluating Large Language Models' Alignment
2023-08.summary: This survey examines key dimensions of trustworthiness for large language models, including reliability, safety, fairness, misuse resistance, explainability, social norms adherence, and robustness, providing guidelines for evaluating and improving model alignment.

2023-08.title: AlphaStar Unplugged: Large-Scale Offline Reinforcement Learning
2023-08.summary: A benchmark called AlphaStar Unplugged is established for offline reinforcement learning using a dataset from StarCraft II, featuring unprecedented challenges and achieving high win rates with offline data.

2023-08.title: LLM-Rec: Personalized Recommendation via Prompting Large Language Models
2023-08.summary: Combining diverse prompts and input augmentation techniques improves personalized content recommendation performance using large language models.

2023-08.title: SpeechX: Neural Codec Language Model as a Versatile Speech Transformer
2023-08.summary: SpeechX integrates neural codec language modeling and multi-task learning to enable versatile speech generation, transformation, and enhancement tasks in both clean and noisy conditions.

2023-08.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
2023-08.summary: AgentBench is a multi-dimensional benchmark for evaluating LLMs as autonomous agents across various interactive environments, highlighting performance differences between commercial and open-source models.

2023-08.title: Dual-Stream Diffusion Net for Text-to-Video Generation
2023-08.summary: The dual-stream diffusion net (DSDN) enhances video consistency and smoothness in text-to-video generation by using separate content and motion diffusion streams with a cross-transformer interaction module and motion decomposer/combiner.

2023-08.title: Teach LLMs to Personalize -- An Approach inspired by Writing Education
2023-08.summary: A multistage and multitask framework using large language models enhances personalized text generation by improving retrieval, ranking, summarization, synthesis, and generation skills.

2023-08.title: Platypus: Quick, Cheap, and Powerful Refinement of LLMs
2023-08.summary: A fine-tuned and merged family of large language models named Platypus, using LoRA modules and a curated dataset, achieves top performance on the Open LLM Leaderboard with reduced data and compute.

2023-08.title: Accelerating LLM Inference with Staged Speculative Decoding
2023-08.summary: A staged speculative decoding algorithm enhances LLM inference efficiency in small-batch, on-device settings by restructuring speculative batches and adding a second decoding stage.

2023-08.title: AvatarVerse: High-quality & Stable 3D Avatar Creation from Text and Pose
2023-08.summary: AvatarVerse generates high-fidelity 3D avatars from text descriptions and pose guidance using a 2D diffusion model and progressive high-resolution synthesis.

2023-08.title: ConceptLab: Creative Generation using Diffusion Prior Constraints
2023-08.summary: Creative text-to-image generation leverages Diffusion Prior models to produce unique images by optimizing with adaptive constraints and creating hybrid concepts.

2023-08.title: SelfCheck: Using LLMs to Zero-Shot Check Their Own Step-by-Step Reasoning
2023-08.summary: A zero-shot verification scheme improves LLMs' question-answering performance by identifying and correcting errors in step-by-step reasoning.

2023-08.title: Skills-in-Context Prompting: Unlocking Compositionality in Large Language Models
2023-08.summary: A novel prompting strategy called skills-in-context (SKiC) enhances compositional generalization in large language models by enabling them to solve unseen complex problems through the synergistic activation and combination of internal skills.

2023-08.title: DragNUWA: Fine-grained Control in Video Generation by Integrating Text, Image, and Trajectory
2023-08.summary: DragNUWA is a diffusion-based video generation model that integrates text, image, and trajectory controls for fine-grained and open-domain video creation.

2023-08.title: Solving Challenging Math Word Problems Using GPT-4 Code Interpreter with Code-based Self-Verification
2023-08.summary: A novel code-based self-verification method significantly improves math reasoning in GPT-4 Code Interpreter, enhancing accuracy on the MATH dataset.

2023-08.title: Simple synthetic data reduces sycophancy in large language models
2023-08.summary: Studies reveal that language models exhibit sycophancy, altering responses to align with user views, and a synthetic-data intervention can mitigate this behavior.

2023-08.title: UniversalNER: Targeted Distillation from Large Language Models for Open Named Entity Recognition
2023-08.summary: Targeted distillation using mission-focused instruction tuning distills ChatGPT into the smaller UniversalNER model, achieving higher NER accuracy across diverse domains than both general and state-of-the-art multi-task tuned models.

2023-08.title: Scaling Relationship on Learning Mathematical Reasoning with Large Language Models
2023-08.summary: Rejection sampling fine-tuning enhances mathematical reasoning in large language models by generating auxiliary datasets of correct reasoning paths, leading to higher performance and better scalability compared to supervised fine-tuning.

2023-08.title: Seeing through the Brain: Image Reconstruction of Visual Perception from Human Brain Signals
2023-08.summary: A pipeline named NeuroImagen uses EEG signals and a latent diffusion model to reconstruct high-resolution visual images, demonstrating superior performance in image reconstruction.

2023-08.title: From Sparse to Soft Mixtures of Experts
2023-08.summary: Soft MoE, a differentiable sparse Transformer, stabilizes training, reduces inference cost, and outperforms traditional Transformers and MoE variants in visual recognition.

2023-08.title: Retroformer: Retrospective Large Language Agents with Policy Gradient Optimization
2023-08.summary: A framework using policy gradient optimization to enhance large language agents by learning from environment feedback, improving their performance over time.

2023-08.title: OmniQuant: Omnidirectionally Calibrated Quantization for Large Language Models
2023-08.summary: OmniQuant improves LLM deployment by optimizing quantization parameters through Learnable Weight Clipping and Learnable Equivalent Transformation, enhancing performance across various quantization settings.

2023-08.title: Composable Function-preserving Expansions for Transformer Architectures
2023-08.summary: The research introduces methods to incrementally enlarge transformer-based neural networks while preserving their functionality, enabling efficient training of larger models.

2023-08.title: BOLAA: Benchmarking and Orchestrating LLM-augmented Autonomous Agents
2023-08.summary: A comprehensive comparison and new orchestration strategy for LLM-augmented Autonomous Agents (LAAs) demonstrate their effectiveness in decision-making and multi-step reasoning tasks.

2023-08.title: The Hydra Effect: Emergent Self-repair in Language Model Computations
2023-08.summary: Analysis reveals adaptive computation and downregulation mechanisms in language models, showing loose coupling among layers even without dropout.

2023-08.title: CausalLM is not optimal for in-context learning
2023-08.summary: Theoretical analysis shows that prefix language models outperform causal language models in in-context learning by converging to optimal solutions, while causal models exhibit dynamics similar to online gradient descent.

2023-08.title: MM-Vet: Evaluating Large Multimodal Models for Integrated Capabilities
2023-08.summary: MM-Vet evaluates large multimodal models across complicated tasks using defined vision-language capabilities and a unified LLM-based evaluator.

2023-08.title: MusicLDM: Enhancing Novelty in Text-to-Music Generation Using Beat-Synchronous Mixup Strategies
2023-08.summary: A text-to-music model named MusicLDM, based on Stable Diffusion and AudioLDM, overcomes limitations in music data and plagiarism with beat tracking and mixup strategies, enhancing music quality, novelty, and text correspondence.

2023-08.title: RAVEN: In-Context Learning with Retrieval Augmented Encoder-Decoder Language Models
2023-08.summary: RAVEN enhances in-context learning in retrieval-augmented encoder-decoder models by combining masked and prefix language modeling, achieving superior performance with fewer parameters.

2023-07.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
2023-07.summary: Llama 2, a series of pretrained and fine-tuned large language models, achieves superior performance in dialogue tasks compared to open-source alternatives and offers safety enhancements.

2023-07.title: Retentive Network: A Successor to Transformer for Large Language Models
2023-07.summary: Retentive Network (RetNet) offers a foundation for large language models with parallel training, low-cost inference, and efficient long-sequence modeling through a retention mechanism supporting parallel, recurrent, and chunkwise recurrent paradigms.

2023-07.title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs
2023-07.summary: ToolLLM is a framework that enhances open-source LLMs with tool-use capabilities through a comprehensive dataset, efficient decision tree, automatic evaluation, and neural API retrieval.

2023-07.title: SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
2023-07.summary: SDXL, a latent diffusion model using a larger UNet with additional text encoders and attention mechanisms, improves text-to-image synthesis significantly.

2023-07.title: LongNet: Scaling Transformers to 1,000,000,000 Tokens
2023-07.summary: LongNet, a Transformer variant with dilated attention, enables scaling to over 1 billion tokens with linear computational complexity and maintains performance on shorter sequences.

2023-07.title: AnimateDiff: Animate Your Personalized Text-to-Image Diffusion Models without Specific Tuning
2023-07.summary: A framework inserts a motion model into existing text-to-image models to enable animation, using video clips to learn motion priors while preserving model domain and diversity.

2023-07.title: TokenFlow: Consistent Diffusion Features for Consistent Video Editing
2023-07.summary: A framework for text-driven video editing uses diffusion models to ensure consistency in the edited video by propagating features based on inter-frame correspondences.

2023-07.title: HyperDreamBooth: HyperNetworks for Fast Personalization of Text-to-Image Models
2023-07.summary: HyperDreamBooth leverages hypernetworks for efficient personalized face generation, significantly speeding up the process and reducing model size compared to existing methods.

2023-07.title: Challenges and Applications of Large Language Models
2023-07.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) went from non-existent to ubiquitous in the machine learning discourse within a few years. Due to the fast pace of the field, it is difficult to identify the remaining challenges and already fruitful application areas. In this paper, we aim to establish a systematic set of open problems and…

2023-07.title: TableGPT: Towards Unifying Tables, Nature Language and Commands into One GPT
2023-07.summary: TableGPT, a fine-tuned language model with global tabular representations, enables seamless interaction and complex operations on tables via natural language and functional commands.

2023-07.title: On the Origin of LLMs: An Evolutionary Tree and Graph for 15,821 Large Language Models
2023-07.summary: A tool called Constellation clusters and visualizes large language models uploaded to Hugging Face using hierarchical clustering and n-gram analysis.

2023-07.title: WavJourney: Compositional Audio Creation with Large Language Models
2023-07.summary: WavJourney leverages Large Language Models to generate structured audio scripts from text, which are then processed by task-specific audio models to create audio content, enabling explainable and human-controlled audio production.

2023-07.title: Meta-Transformer: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Learning
2023-07.summary: Meta-Transformer unifies multimodal learning across 12 unpaired modalities using a frozen encoder in a shared token space.

2023-07.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
2023-07.summary: Analysis reveals language models perform better when relevant information is at the ends of longer contexts and suggests new evaluation protocols for long-context models.

2023-07.title: Magic123: One Image to High-Quality 3D Object Generation Using Both 2D and 3D Diffusion Priors
2023-07.summary: A two-stage neural approach generates high-quality textured 3D meshes from a single image using neural radiance fields, differentiable mesh representations, and combined 2D and 3D diffusion priors.

2023-07.title: PanGu-Coder2: Boosting Large Language Models for Code with Ranking Feedback
2023-07.summary: PanGu-Coder2, a model fine-tuned with RRTF framework, demonstrates superior code generation performance, outperforming existing Code LLMs on multiple benchmarks.

2023-07.title: Brain2Music: Reconstructing Music from Human Brain Activity
2023-07.summary: A method reconstructs music from fMRI data using the MusicLM model, matching semantic properties of original stimuli and identifying brain regions involved in processing music descriptions.

2023-07.title: 3D-LLM: Injecting the 3D World into Large Language Models
2023-07.summary: A new family of 3D-LLMs is introduced to perform 3D-related tasks by leveraging 3D point clouds and features, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in tasks such as 3D question answering and captioning.

2023-07.title: A Survey on Evaluation of Large Language Models
2023-07.summary: A comprehensive review of evaluation methods for large language models (LLMs) focusing on tasks, methods, and future challenges.

2023-07.title: Skeleton-of-Thought: Large Language Models Can Do Parallel Decoding
2023-07.summary: "Skeleton-of-Thought" (SoT) method reduces generation latency and potentially improves answer quality by guiding LLMs to generate a skeleton first, followed by parallel content completion.

2023-07.title: Open Problems and Fundamental Limitations of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
2023-07.summary: RLHF is analyzed for its limitations and flaws, with suggestions for improvement, complementation, and oversight to enhance safer AI development.

2023-07.title: A Real-World WebAgent with Planning, Long Context Understanding, and Program Synthesis
2023-07.summary: WebAgent uses Flan-U-PaLM and HTML-T5 to improve task success in real-world web navigation through decomposed instructions, HTML summarization, and Python code generation.

2023-07.title: Copy Is All You Need
2023-07.summary: Text generation is improved by copying text segments from a pre-existing collection, resulting in better quality and efficiency compared to traditional methods.

2023-07.title: Patch n' Pack: NaViT, a Vision Transformer for any Aspect Ratio and Resolution
2023-07.summary: NaViT, a flexible Vision Transformer, processes images of arbitrary resolutions and aspect ratios, improving training efficiency and performance across various computer vision tasks.

2023-07.title: Segment Anything Meets Point Tracking
2023-07.summary: SAM-PT extends SAM for video object segmentation using robust and sparse point propagation, achieving strong zero-shot performance and demonstrating advantages on benchmarks like DAVIS, YouTube-VOS, MOSE, and UVO.

2023-07.title: DragonDiffusion: Enabling Drag-style Manipulation on Diffusion Models
2023-07.summary: DragonDiffusion, a novel image editing method, enables precise manipulation of generated or real images using classifier guidance and multi-scale attention mechanisms without requiring fine-tuning.

2023-07.title: LoraHub: Efficient Cross-Task Generalization via Dynamic LoRA Composition
2023-07.summary: LoraHub, a framework for combining LoRA modules, enables few-shot cross-task generalization and facilitates community sharing of LRA modules for large language models.

2023-07.title: FABRIC: Personalizing Diffusion Models with Iterative Feedback
2023-07.summary: FABRIC is a training-free method that uses feedback images and self-attention layers to enhance diffusion-based text-to-image models through iterative human feedback.

2023-07.title: LEDITS: Real Image Editing with DDPM Inversion and Semantic Guidance
2023-07.summary: LEDITS combines Edit Friendly DDPM inversion and Semantic Guidance to enable versatile and efficient real-image editing using text prompts.

2023-07.title: Collaborative Score Distillation for Consistent Visual Synthesis
2023-07.summary: A novel method, Collaborative Score Distillation (CSD), based on Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD), enhances consistency in text-to-image diffusion models across multiple images such as panoramas, videos, and 3D scenes.

2023-07.title: Secrets of RLHF in Large Language Models Part I: PPO
2023-07.summary: This report examines Reinfocement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) and proposes PPO-max to improve the stability of policy model training compared to other SFT models and ChatGPT.

2023-07.title: Measuring Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
2023-07.summary: Larger language models may not produce faithful reasoning when using chain-of-thought despite performance improvements, depending on model size and task.

2023-07.title: BuboGPT: Enabling Visual Grounding in Multi-Modal LLMs
2023-07.summary: BuboGPT is a multi-modal LLM with visual grounding that enhances understanding and interaction between vision, audio, and language.

2023-07.title: In-context Autoencoder for Context Compression in a Large Language Model
2023-07.summary: The In-context Autoencoder (ICAE) compresses long contexts into memory slots for efficient LLM inference using a combination of pretraining and fine-tuning.

2023-07.title: Stay on topic with Classifier-Free Guidance
2023-07.summary: Classifier-Free Guidance enhances performance across various language modeling tasks and improves the faithfulness and coherence of AI assistants, outperforming models with higher parameter counts.

2023-07.title: Mega-TTS 2: Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech with Arbitrary Length Speech Prompts
2023-07.summary: Mega-TTS 2 extends zero-shot text-to-speech with arbitrary-length prompts by incorporating a multi-reference timbre encoder and a prosody language model, enhancing both identity preservation and prosodic control.

2023-07.title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
2023-07.summary: WebArena, a realistic and reproducible environment, evaluates the performance of autonomous agents performing complex tasks on websites using benchmark tasks that require human-like reasoning.

2023-07.title: PolyLM: An Open Source Polyglot Large Language Model
2023-07.summary: PolyLM, a multilingual LLM trained on 640 billion tokens, enhances multilingual capabilities through bilingual data and curriculum learning, outperforming other models on multilingual tasks while maintaining English performance.

2023-07.title: Becoming self-instruct: introducing early stopping criteria for minimal instruct tuning
2023-07.summary: The Instruction Following Score (IFS) is introduced to evaluate and control instruction-following ability in language models, aiding in distinguishing between base and instruct models as well as serving as an early stopping criterion in training.

2023-07.title: DisCo: Disentangled Control for Referring Human Dance Generation in Real World
2023-07.summary: DISCO addresses the challenges of human-centric dance synthesis by introducing a model architecture for better faithfulness and compositionality, and pre-training for generalizability.

2023-07.title: How is ChatGPT's behavior changing over time?
2023-07.summary: The performance and behavior of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 fluctuated significantly between March and June 2023 across various tasks, emphasizing the necessity for ongoing LLM quality monitoring.

2023-07.title: InternVid: A Large-scale Video-Text Dataset for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
2023-07.summary: InternVid, a large-scale video-text multimodal dataset, and ViCLIP, a video-text representation model based on ViT-L, enable advanced video and text understanding and generation tasks.

2023-07.title: Med-Flamingo: a Multimodal Medical Few-shot Learner
2023-07.summary: Med-Flamingo, an adaptation of OpenFlamingo-9B for the medical domain, demonstrates few-shot capabilities in generative visual question answering with significant performance improvements as evaluated by clinicians.

2023-07.title: Stack More Layers Differently: High-Rank Training Through Low-Rank Updates
2023-07.summary: ReLoRA, a low-rank training method, demonstrates comparable performance to traditional training for large transformer language models and becomes more efficient with increased model size.

2023-07.title: AlpaGasus: Training A Better Alpaca with Fewer Data
2023-07.summary: A data selection strategy using a strong LLM improves instruction-following models by filtering high-quality data, enhancing performance and reducing training time.

2023-07.title: Sketch-A-Shape: Zero-Shot Sketch-to-3D Shape Generation
2023-07.summary: A pre-trained vision model's features enable generation of 3D shapes from sketches without paired datasets by leveraging synthetic renderings during training.

2023-07.title: Scaling TransNormer to 175 Billion Parameters
2023-07.summary: TransNormerLLM, a linear attention-based LLM, outperforms softmax attention models through advanced modifications like positional embedding, lightning attention, gating mechanisms, and tensor normalization, achieving better accuracy and efficiency.

2023-07.title: Learning to Retrieve In-Context Examples for Large Language Models
2023-07.summary: A framework is proposed for training dense retrievers to select high-quality in-context examples for large language models, enhancing their performance across various tasks.

2023-07.title: Generative Pretraining in Multimodality
2023-07.summary: Emu, a Transformer-based multimodal model, generates images and texts in various contexts and demonstrates superior performance across zero-shot and few-shot tasks compared to existing models.

2023-07.title: Semantic-SAM: Segment and Recognize Anything at Any Granularity
2023-07.summary: Semantic-SAM, a universal image segmentation model, achieves semantic-awareness and multi-granularity by introducing decoupled classification and multi-choice learning, improving performance across various segmentation tasks.

2023-06.title: Simple and Controllable Music Generation
2023-06.summary: MusicGen, a single-stage transformer language model, generates high-quality music conditioned on text or melodic features using efficient token interleaving patterns, outperforming existing models on text-to-music benchmarks.

2023-06.title: Textbooks Are All You Need
2023-06.summary: A new compact Transformer-based large language model for code, phi-1, achieves high accuracy on coding benchmarks despite having fewer parameters than competing models.

2023-06.title: Rerender A Video: Zero-Shot Text-Guided Video-to-Video Translation
2023-06.summary: A novel framework adapts image diffusion models for video by generating key frames with hierarchical constraints and propagating them using patch matching and blending, achieving high-quality and temporally-coherent videos.

2023-06.title: TryOnDiffusion: A Tale of Two UNets
2023-06.summary: A diffusion-based architecture unifies garment detail preservation and warping for pose and shape variation in virtual try-on tasks.

2023-06.title: Long-range Language Modeling with Self-retrieval
2023-06.summary: The Retrieval-Pretrained Transformer jointly trains a retrieval-augmented language model to model long texts by fusing retrieved information for improved prediction.

2023-06.title: Extending Context Window of Large Language Models via Positional Interpolation
2023-06.summary: Position Interpolation extends the context window of RoPE-based LLMs up to 32768 tokens with minimal fine-tuning, maintaining task performance and stability compared to extrapolation methods.

2023-06.title: AudioPaLM: A Large Language Model That Can Speak and Listen
2023-06.summary: A unified multimodal language model combining text and speech capabilities outperforms existing systems in speech translation and zero-shot speech-to-text translation.

2023-06.title: Orca: Progressive Learning from Complex Explanation Traces of GPT-4
2023-06.summary: Orca, a 13-billion parameter model, enhances small models by imitating the reasoning process from large foundation models using rich signals and diverse data, surpassing existing models in complex reasoning benchmarks.

2023-06.title: OBELICS: An Open Web-Scale Filtered Dataset of Interleaved Image-Text Documents
2023-06.summary: The OBELICS dataset, containing interleaved image-text documents, is introduced and used to train competitive multimodal models.

2023-06.title: The RefinedWeb Dataset for Falcon LLM: Outperforming Curated Corpora with Web Data, and Web Data Only
2023-06.summary: Filtered and deduplicated web data alone can produce powerful large language models that outperform those trained on The Pile.

2023-06.title: Judging LLM-as-a-judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
2023-06.summary: Using strong large language models as judges for evaluating other LLM-based chat assistants achieves high agreement with human preferences, offering a scalable and explainable solution compared to traditional benchmarks.

2023-06.title: One-2-3-45: Any Single Image to 3D Mesh in 45 Seconds without Per-Shape Optimization
2023-06.summary: A novel feed-forward method generates high-quality 360-degree 3D meshes from single images using a view-conditioned 2D diffusion model and an SDF-based neural surface reconstruction module.

2023-06.title: On-Policy Distillation of Language Models: Learning from Self-Generated Mistakes
2023-06.summary: Generalized Knowledge Distillation addresses distribution mismatch in auto-regressive sequence models by training the student on its own output sequences and integrates with RL fine-tuning for effective distillation in tasks like summarization and instruction-tuning.

2023-06.title: Kosmos-2: Grounding Multimodal Large Language Models to the World
2023-06.summary: Kosmos-2, a Multimodal Large Language Model, combines text-to-visual grounding with existing MLLM capabilities, enabling tasks like referring expression comprehension and phrase grounding.

2023-06.title: Fast Segment Anything
2023-06.summary: A speed-up method using a CNN detector with an instance segmentation branch achieves comparable performance to SAM with 50 times faster runtime by training on a small subset of SAM's dataset.

2023-06.title: MagicBrush: A Manually Annotated Dataset for Instruction-Guided Image Editing
2023-06.summary: MagicBrush, a large-scale manually annotated dataset for text-guided real image editing, enhances InstructPix2Pix model performance and highlights challenges in current baselines.

2023-06.title: WizardCoder: Empowering Code Large Language Models with Evol-Instruct
2023-06.summary: WizardCoder, a Code LLM fine-tuned with complex instructions using Evol-Instruct, outperforms other open-source and closed LLMs on several code generation benchmarks.

2023-06.title: Seeing the World through Your Eyes
2023-06.summary: A method for reconstructing 3D scenes beyond a camera's line of sight using eye reflections is proposed, refining cornea poses, radiance fields, and iris textures.

2023-06.title: DreamDiffusion: Generating High-Quality Images from Brain EEG Signals
2023-06.summary: DreamDiffusion generates high-quality images from EEG signals using pre-trained text-to-image models and CLIP image encoder for improved alignment and robust representations, overcoming noise and data limitations.

2023-06.title: FasterViT: Fast Vision Transformers with Hierarchical Attention
2023-06.summary: FasterViT, a hybrid CNN-ViT model, enhances CV tasks with high image throughput through Hierarchical Attention (HAT) and achieves state-of-the-art performance in accuracy versus throughput.

2023-06.title: Full Parameter Fine-tuning for Large Language Models with Limited Resources
2023-06.summary: A new optimizer reduces memory usage for full parameter fine-tuning of large language models, enabling 65B model training on a single machine with limited GPUs.

2023-06.title: Towards Language Models That Can See: Computer Vision Through the LENS of Natural Language
2023-06.summary: LENS uses language models to reason over outputs from vision modules, achieving competitive performance in vision and vision-language tasks without multimodal training.

2023-06.title: MotionGPT: Human Motion as a Foreign Language
2023-06.summary: MotionGPT, a unified motion-language model using discrete vector quantization, achieves top performance in various motion-related tasks by treating motion as a language similar to text.

2023-06.title: From Word Models to World Models: Translating from Natural Language to the Probabilistic Language of Thought
2023-06.summary: A framework combining large language models and probabilistic programs translates language into a symbolic language of thought for rational, commonsense reasoning across multiple cognitive domains.

2023-06.title: AssistGPT: A General Multi-modal Assistant that can Plan, Execute, Inspect, and Learn
2023-06.summary: A multi-modal AI assistant, AssistGPT, with a Plan, Execute, Inspect, and Learn (PEIL) approach integrates LLMs with various tools to handle complex visual-based tasks and achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks and beyond.

2023-06.title: Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
2023-06.summary: MiniLLM distills knowledge from large generative language models to smaller models using reverse KLD for better precision, quality, and performance.

2023-06.title: One-for-All: Generalized LoRA for Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning
2023-06.summary: GLoRA, an advanced method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enhances LoRA with a generalized prompt module and modular layer-wise structure search, offering superior performance across diverse tasks with fewer parameters and computational costs.

2023-06.title: Controlling Text-to-Image Diffusion by Orthogonal Finetuning
2023-06.summary: Orthogonal Finetuning and Constrained Orthogonal Finetuning methods enhance text-to-image diffusion models by preserving hyperspherical energy and improving stability, leading to better generation quality and speed.

2023-06.title: Generate Anything Anywhere in Any Scene
2023-06.summary: A text-to-image diffusion model is enhanced with adapter layers and regionally-guided sampling to achieve controlled generation of personalized objects with high fidelity.

2023-06.title: Generative AI for Programming Education: Benchmarking ChatGPT, GPT-4, and Human Tutors
2023-06.summary: Systematic evaluation of ChatGPT and GPT-4 in educational scenarios demonstrates GPT-4's superior performance over ChatGPT and identifies areas needing improvement.

2023-06.title: Training Transformers with 4-bit Integers
2023-06.summary: A novel method for training transformers with 4-bit quantization achieves competitive accuracy and accelerates training on current GPUs.

2023-06.title: Benchmarking Neural Network Training Algorithms
2023-06.summary: A new benchmark, AlgoPerf: Training Algorithms, addresses challenges in evaluating training algorithms by providing a competitive, time-to-result benchmark across workloads and optimizers.

2023-06.title: DragDiffusion: Harnessing Diffusion Models for Interactive Point-based Image Editing
2023-06.summary: DragDiffusion extends interactive point-based image editing to diffusion models, offering precise spatial control and high-quality editing across diverse scenarios.

2023-06.title: Demystifying GPT Self-Repair for Code Generation
2023-06.summary: GPT-4 demonstrates superior self-repair capabilities on APPS dataset compared to GPT-3.5, with performance boosted when feedback is provided by GPT-4 or human programmers.

2023-06.title: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web
2023-06.summary: Mind2Web, a dataset for generalist web agents, uses real-world websites and crowdsourced actions to improve LLM performance and generalizability.

2023-06.title: KoLA: Carefully Benchmarking World Knowledge of Large Language Models
2023-06.summary: A benchmark for evaluating large language models emphasizes knowledge-related abilities, uses a mix of datasets, and incorporates self-contrast metrics to detect knowledge hallucination.

2023-06.title: Video-LLaMA: An Instruction-tuned Audio-Visual Language Model for Video Understanding
2023-06.summary: Video-LLaMA is a multi-modal framework that integrates visual and auditory understanding into LLMs by extending image encoders to video and aligning audio signals, achieving effective video-language correspondence.

2023-06.title: SQL-PaLM: Improved Large Language ModelAdaptation for Text-to-SQL
2023-06.summary: SQL-PaLM, an LLM-based Text-to-SQL model, outperforms existing systems in few-shot learning and fine-tuning settings and demonstrates superior generalization on diverse variants of the Spider dataset.

2023-06.title: MotionGPT: Finetuned LLMs are General-Purpose Motion Generators
2023-06.summary: MotionGPT generates realistic human motion using multimodal control signals by adapting a small portion of LLM parameters to handle unified input instructions.

2023-06.title: h2oGPT: Democratizing Large Language Models
2023-06.summary: h2oGPT provides open-source, fine-tuned LLMs based on Generative Pretrained Transformers with 100% private document search capabilities.

2023-06.title: Augmenting Language Models with Long-Term Memory
2023-06.summary: A framework called LongMem enables large language models to utilize long-term memory, overcoming input length limitations and improving performance on long-context tasks.

2023-06.title: HyenaDNA: Long-Range Genomic Sequence Modeling at Single Nucleotide Resolution
2023-06.summary: HyenaDNA, a genomic foundation model based on implicit convolutions, achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks with longer context lengths, single nucleotide resolution, and fewer parameters.

2023-06.title: LeanDojo: Theorem Proving with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
2023-06.summary: LeanDojo provides open-source tools, data, and benchmarks to facilitate research on machine learning methods for theorem proving, introducing ReProver, an LLM-based prover that uses retrieval for premise selection.

2023-06.title: AniFaceDrawing: Anime Portrait Exploration during Your Sketching
2023-06.summary: A latent space exploration of StyleGAN is used for generating high-quality anime portraits from incomplete sketches with a stroke-level disentanglement approach.

2023-06.title: Face0: Instantaneously Conditioning a Text-to-Image Model on a Face
2023-06.summary: A method to condition text-to-image generation models on face embeddings in real-time, enhancing generative capabilities and bias mitigation.

2023-06.title: Scaling MLPs: A Tale of Inductive Bias
2023-06.summary: MLPs achieve competitive performance on vision tasks with large-scale pre-training, challenging the narrative that inductive bias is necessary for high accuracy.

2023-06.title: HomeRobot: Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation
2023-06.summary: The HomeRobot OVMM benchmark evaluates robots' ability to manipulate unseen objects in new environments using a combination of simulated and real-world testing.

2023-06.title: DreamHuman: Animatable 3D Avatars from Text
2023-06.summary: DreamHuman generates realistic animatable 3D human avatars using text by integrating text-to-image synthesis, neural radiance fields, and statistical human body models.

2023-06.title: Scalable 3D Captioning with Pretrained Models
2023-06.summary: Cap3D generates high-quality descriptive text for 3D objects using pretrained models and datasets, surpassing human performance in quality, cost, and speed.

2023-06.title: Faster Segment Anything: Towards Lightweight SAM for Mobile Applications
2023-06.summary: MobileSAM enhances the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for mobile devices by decoupling the image encoder and mask decoder to create a lightweight version that maintains performance while significantly reducing size and improving speed.

2023-05.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
2023-05.summary: QLoRA enables efficient finetuning of large language models using 4-bit quantization and Low Rank Adapters, achieving high performance with reduced memory usage.

2023-05.title: TinyStories: How Small Can Language Models Be and Still Speak Coherent English?
2023-05.summary: TinyStories, a synthetic dataset of simplified stories, enables small or simple language models to produce fluent and coherent text with reasoning capabilities using an evaluation framework based on human-like grading.

2023-05.title: Drag Your GAN: Interactive Point-based Manipulation on the Generative Image Manifold
2023-05.summary: DragGAN enables precise user-controlled manipulation of image content through interactive point dragging, improving realism and flexibility over existing GAN-based methods.

2023-05.title: StarCoder: may the source be with you!
2023-05.summary: StarCoder, a 15.5B parameter LLM trained on 1 trillion tokens, outperforms other open Code LLMs across multiple languages and fine-tuned Python, with safety enhancements and publicly available under the Open Responsible AI Model license.

2023-05.title: LIMA: Less Is More for Alignment
2023-05.summary: A 65B parameter LLaMa language model trained with minimal instructional data matches or outperforms models with extensive human preference modeling in most cases, indicating that pretraining is predominantly responsible for knowledge acquisition.

2023-05.title: RWKV: Reinventing RNNs for the Transformer Era
2023-05.summary: A new architecture, RWKV, combines the parallelizable training of Transformers with the efficient inference of RNNs, achieving linear scaling and matching performance.

2023-05.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
2023-05.summary: The Tree of Thoughts framework enhances language models' problem-solving capabilities by enabling the exploration and evaluation of multiple reasoning paths and thoughts.

2023-05.title: SoundStorm: Efficient Parallel Audio Generation
2023-05.summary: SoundStorm, a non-autoregressive audio generation model, delivers high-quality and consistent audio two orders of magnitude faster than autoregressive methods.

2023-05.title: Common Diffusion Noise Schedules and Sample Steps are Flawed
2023-05.summary: Proposed solutions address flaws in diffusion noise schedules and samplers to ensure consistency between training and inference, enabling more accurate image generation.

2023-05.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
2023-05.summary: Voyager is an LLM-powered agent in Minecraft that autonomously explores, learns, and discovers skills through a curriculum, skill library, and prompting mechanism, demonstrating superior lifelong learning and task-solving capabilities.

2023-05.title: LDM3D: Latent Diffusion Model for 3D
2023-05.summary: Latent Diffusion Model for 3D (LDM3D) generates RGBD images from text prompts and is used to create immersive 360-degree-view experiences.

2023-05.title: CoEdIT: Text Editing by Task-Specific Instruction Tuning
2023-05.summary: CoEdIT, a fine-tuned large language model, enhances text editing quality and efficiency with diverse instructions, achieving state-of-the-art performance and user preference.

2023-05.title: DarkBERT: A Language Model for the Dark Side of the Internet
2023-05.summary: DarkBERT, a language model trained on Dark Web data, outperforms existing models in various use cases due to its specialized training on the Dark Web's unique linguistic characteristics.

2023-05.title: Can LLM Already Serve as A Database Interface? A BIg Bench for Large-Scale Database Grounded Text-to-SQLs
2023-05.summary: Bird, a large-scale text-to-SQL benchmark, addresses challenges posed by big databases, emphasizing database values, external knowledge, and SQL efficiency.

2023-05.title: ProlificDreamer: High-Fidelity and Diverse Text-to-3D Generation with Variational Score Distillation
2023-05.summary: Variational score distillation addresses issues in text-to-3D generation by modeling 3D parameters as random variables, improving sample quality and diversity.

2023-05.title: MEGABYTE: Predicting Million-byte Sequences with Multiscale Transformers
2023-05.summary: Megabyte, a multi-scale decoder architecture, enables efficient byte-level modeling of long sequences through sub-quadratic self-attention, larger feedforward layers, and improved parallelism, achieving performance competitive with subword models and state-of-the-art results.

2023-05.title: Tree-Ring Watermarks: Fingerprints for Diffusion Images that are Invisible and Robust
2023-05.summary: A novel technique called Tree-Ring Watermarking robustly fingerprints diffusion model outputs by embedding a pattern into the initial noise vector and is invariant to various image transformations.

2023-05.title: Faith and Fate: Limits of Transformers on Compositionality
2023-05.summary: Transformers solve compositional tasks by reducing multi-step reasoning to linearized subgraph matching, leading to performance decay with increased complexity.

2023-05.title: RAPHAEL: Text-to-Image Generation via Large Mixture of Diffusion Paths
2023-05.summary: A text-conditional image diffusion model named RAPHAEL generates high-quality and artistic images by stacking mixture-of-experts layers, outperforming existing models in style switching and zero-shot FID score.

2023-05.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
2023-05.summary: CRITIC, a framework that uses external tools to validate and improve LLM outputs, consistently enhances performance across various tasks.

2023-05.title: Recommender Systems with Generative Retrieval
2023-05.summary: A generative retrieval model using Semantic IDs and a Transformer sequence-to-sequence approach improves recommendation system performance and generalization, especially for cold-start items.

2023-05.title: Generating Images with Multimodal Language Models
2023-05.summary: A method to integrate text-only large language models with image encoders and decoders through embedding space mapping achieves multimodal capabilities including image retrieval, generation, and dialogue.

2023-05.title: Model Dementia: Generated Data Makes Models Forget
2023-05.summary: Model dementia, caused by the use of model-generated content in training, affects the quality of generative models like LLMs, VAEs, and GMMs, highlighting the need for genuine human interaction data.

2023-05.title: Enhancing Chat Language Models by Scaling High-quality Instructional Conversations
2023-05.summary: A large-scale dataset, UltraChat, and a fine-tuned model, UltraLLaMA, are created to improve open-source chat language models' performance.

2023-05.title: PaLM 2 Technical Report
2023-05.summary: PaLM 2, a Transformer-based language model, improves multilingual and reasoning capabilities with enhanced efficiency and performance across various tasks compared to its predecessor.

2023-05.title: Personalize Segment Anything Model with One Shot
2023-05.summary: A training-free and fine-tuning variant of the Segment Anything Model (SAM), PerSAM and PerSAM-F, achieves personalized image and video segmentation using a single reference image and minimal fine-tuning, improving performance on personalized and dreambooth applications.

2023-05.title: HiFA: High-fidelity Text-to-3D with Advanced Diffusion Guidance
2023-05.summary: Reformulating optimization loss with diffusion prior and introducing depth supervision improve text-to-3D synthesis quality and multi-view consistency.

2023-05.title: Break-A-Scene: Extracting Multiple Concepts from a Single Image
2023-05.summary: The method decomposes a single image into distinct text tokens for each concept and fine-tunes textual embeddings using masked diffusion loss to enable synthesis with fine-grained control.

2023-05.title: ControlVideo: Training-free Controllable Text-to-Video Generation
2023-05.summary: ControlVideo, a training-free framework adapted from ControlNet, improves text-to-video generation by ensuring appearance coherence, reducing flicker, and efficiently producing long videos.

2023-05.title: OpenShape: Scaling Up 3D Shape Representation Towards Open-World Understanding
2023-05.summary: OpenShape learns multi-modal representations for text, images, and 3D point clouds, achieving superior zero-shot performance and fine-grained interactions through novel strategies and hard negative mining.

2023-05.title: SLiC-HF: Sequence Likelihood Calibration with Human Feedback
2023-05.summary: Sequence Likelihood Calibration (SLiC) is shown to be an effective and simpler alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) for learning from human preferences in language models.

2023-05.title: CodeT5+: Open Code Large Language Models for Code Understanding and Generation
2023-05.summary: CodeT5+, a family of flexible encoder-decoder LLMs initialized with frozen LLMs and trained with a mixture of pretraining objectives, achieves state-of-the-art performance across various code-related tasks.

2023-05.title: InstructBLIP: Towards General-purpose Vision-Language Models with Instruction Tuning
2023-05.summary: InstructBLIP models, built through instruction-aware visual feature extraction on BLIP-2, achieve top performance in vision-language tasks, including zero-shot evaluation and fine-tuned downstream tasks.

2023-05.title: CoMoSpeech: One-Step Speech and Singing Voice Synthesis via Consistency Model
2023-05.summary: CoMoSpeech, a consistency model-based method, achieves high-quality speech synthesis with a single diffusion sampling step, significantly speeding up inference compared to traditional models.

2023-05.title: To Compress or Not to Compress- Self-Supervised Learning and Information Theory: A Review
2023-05.summary: A unified framework integrating information theory to formalize the self-supervised learning problem is presented, exploring the intersection with deep neural networks.

2023-05.title: Otter: A Multi-Modal Model with In-Context Instruction Tuning
2023-05.summary: Multimodal instruction tuning improves the performance of models like Otter, based on OpenFlamingo, with an optimized dataset and reduced training resource requirements.

2023-05.title: LibriTTS-R: A Restored Multi-Speaker Text-to-Speech Corpus
2023-05.summary: A new speech dataset called LibriTTS-R, derived by applying speech restoration to LibriTTS, improves sound quality and enhances neural end-to-end TTS performance.

2023-05.title: Mix-of-Show: Decentralized Low-Rank Adaptation for Multi-Concept Customization of Diffusion Models
2023-05.summary: Mix-of-Show addresses challenges in decentralized multi-concept customization for text-to-image diffusion models using embedding-decomposed LoRA, gradient fusion, and regionally controllable sampling.

2023-05.title: Reconstructing the Mind's Eye: fMRI-to-Image with Contrastive Learning and Diffusion Priors
2023-05.summary: MindEye, a novel fMRI-to-image approach, retrieves and reconstructs viewed images with high accuracy using specialized submodules and diffusion prior in latent space.

2023-05.title: The False Promise of Imitating Proprietary LLMs
2023-05.summary: Finetuning open-source language models on outputs from proprietary models like ChatGPT shows improved instruction-following but fails to close the performance gap on unsupported tasks.

2023-05.title: Multimodal Web Navigation with Instruction-Finetuned Foundation Models
2023-05.summary: An instruction-following multimodal agent named WebGUM, trained offline using vision transformers and language models, significantly outperforms existing methods in web navigation and multi-step reasoning tasks.

2023-05.title: DoReMi: Optimizing Data Mixtures Speeds Up Language Model Pretraining
2023-05.summary: Domain Reweighting with Minimax Optimization (DoReMi) uses a small proxy model to find optimal domain weights, improving language model performance and efficiency.

2023-05.title: Towards Expert-Level Medical Question Answering with Large Language Models
2023-05.summary: Med-PaLM 2, built on PaLM 2 and enhanced with medical fine-tuning and ensemble refinement, significantly improves physician-level performance in medical question answering by scoring 86.5% on MedQA and excelling on other clinical datasets.

2023-05.title: Better speech synthesis through scaling
2023-05.summary: TorToise is an expressive multi-voice speech synthesis system that applies autoregressive transformers and DDPMs from image generation to text-to-speech.

2023-05.title: Exploiting Diffusion Prior for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
2023-05.summary: A novel method leverages pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models for blind super-resolution, using a time-aware encoder and a controllable feature wrapping module to enhance fidelity and adaptability to varying resolutions.

2023-05.title: FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance
2023-05.summary: Strategies including prompt adaptation, LLM approximation, and LLM cascade are proposed to reduce costs and maintain or improve performance when using large language models.

2023-05.title: Single-Shot Implicit Morphable Faces with Consistent Texture Parameterization
2023-05.summary: A novel method for constructing implicit 3D morphable face models that combines the benefits of neural implicit representations and 3D morphable models, offering photo-realism, generalizability, and intuitive editing capabilities.

2023-05.title: FormNetV2: Multimodal Graph Contrastive Learning for Form Document Information Extraction
2023-05.summary: FormNetV2 uses a centralized multimodal graph contrastive learning approach to improve self-supervised pre-training and achieves state-of-the-art performance on form understanding benchmarks with a compact model.

2023-05.title: PaLI-X: On Scaling up a Multilingual Vision and Language Model
2023-05.summary: PaLI-X, a multilingual vision and language model, achieves state-of-the-art performance on various tasks by scaling its components and task diversity.

2023-05.title: StyleAvatar3D: Leveraging Image-Text Diffusion Models for High-Fidelity 3D Avatar Generation
2023-05.summary: A novel method generates high-quality, stylized 3D avatars using pre-trained image-text diffusion models and a GAN-based 3D generation network, addressing challenges in 3D data generation.
